title: Rainshadow Washed Guatemala Coffee
description: These single-origin beans come from Huehuetenango, Guatemala, and are roasted to bring out notes of red apple, cocoa, and toasted almond. The washed-process coffee has a rounded body that works well in a drip brewer or pour-over. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Keep the beans sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing for the freshest cup.

title: Evening Orchard Herbal Tea
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf blend of chamomile, dried apple, lemon balm, and a little cinnamon, made for a quiet cup after dinner. The bright orchard aroma gives way to a gentle, softly spiced finish. Each tin contains 2.5 ounces of tea, enough for about 25 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes, then strain and serve plain or with a spoonful of honey.

title: Copperline Electric Gooseneck Kettle
description: This electric gooseneck kettle gives you steady control when pouring for pour-over coffee or steeping loose tea. Its 1-liter stainless steel body has a brushed finish, a balanced handle, and a narrow spout designed for a measured stream. The base includes adjustable temperature settings from 140°F to 212°F and a keep-warm function for up to 30 minutes. Set it on a level counter, fill below the marked maximum, and use the handle to pour with care.

title: Speckle Stoneware Cappuccino Cup Set
description: These two handmade stoneware cups have a warm ivory glaze scattered with charcoal speckles and a comfortable, rounded profile. Each cup holds 8 ounces, a practical size for cappuccino, tea, or a small filter coffee. The sturdy ceramic walls help keep drinks warm between sips, while the smooth rims make them pleasant to drink from. They are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup and arrive as a matching pair, ready for everyday use at the kitchen table.

title: Blue Enamel Braising Pot
description: Built for slow braises, soups, and one-pot meals, this 5-quart enameled cast iron pot distributes heat evenly and moves from stovetop to oven with ease. The deep navy enamel interior resists staining and does not require seasoning. A fitted lid helps retain moisture, and wide loop handles make the pot easier to lift with oven mitts. Suitable for gas, electric, and induction cooktops, it is oven safe to 450°F; hand washing is recommended to protect the finish.

title: Olivewood Coffee Scoop and Clip
description: Measure your morning coffee and close the bag with one compact tool. This scoop is carved from olivewood with visible natural grain and holds approximately one tablespoon of ground coffee. A stainless steel spring clip is attached at the handle end, so it can secure a folded bag between uses. The smooth wood is comfortable to hold and easy to rinse; dry it promptly and avoid soaking or putting it in the dishwasher to help preserve the finish.

title: Brown Butter Shortbread Bites
description: These crisp, buttery shortbread bites are made in small batches with browned butter, wheat flour, cane sugar, and a pinch of sea salt. The toasted, nutty flavor pairs naturally with black tea or a cup of medium-roast coffee. Each resealable pouch contains 6 ounces of bite-size cookies, convenient for sharing or keeping beside the kettle. Store at room temperature in a dry place and enjoy within two weeks of opening for the best texture.

title: Weekend Pour-Over Tasting Box
description: A ready-to-brew sampler for exploring three distinct coffees at home. The box includes three 4-ounce bags of whole beans: a bright washed Ethiopian coffee, a balanced Colombian lot, and a chocolate-forward Brazilian roast. It also contains a simple tasting card with space to note grind size and flavor impressions. Brew each coffee in a pour-over, French press, or drip machine, and adjust the grind to suit your equipment. Beans are packed fresh and should be used within a month of opening.

title: The Everyday Brew Kitchen
description: This practical cookbook brings coffee and tea into the rhythm of home cooking, with recipes for cardamom morning buns, tea-poached pears, coffee-rubbed vegetables, and simple syrups for cold drinks. It includes 80 recipes, clear ingredient lists, and notes on brewing strengths where a drink is part of the dish. The hardback edition measures 8 by 10 inches and lies open on a kitchen counter. Use it for weekend baking projects or small additions to an everyday breakfast.

title: Paper Cone Filter Refill, 200 Pack
description: A practical refill for cone-style pour-over brewers, this pack contains 200 unbleached paper filters sized for standard 02 drippers. The folded seam sits neatly against the brewer wall, while the paper helps catch fine grounds for a clean, easy-drinking cup. Rinse each filter with hot water before adding coffee to reduce paper flavor and warm the dripper. Store the stack in a dry cupboard, and check your brewer size before ordering to ensure a proper fit.

title: Cedar Ridge Honey Process Coffee
description: Sweet and balanced whole-bean coffee from small farms in Huila, Colombia. The honey process brings out notes of ripe peach, panela, and cocoa, with a rounded body that works well as a daily cup. Roasted in small batches for filter brewing, French press, or espresso. Choose a 12-ounce bag for a first taste or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Store sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing.

title: Jasmine Pearl Green Tea
description: Hand-rolled green tea pearls scented with fresh jasmine blossoms for a gently floral cup. As the pearls unfurl, they release a mellow, lightly sweet flavor with a clean finish. This loose-leaf tea is packed in a resealable 2-ounce pouch, enough for multiple infusions depending on your preferred strength. Steep about one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for two to three minutes. Enjoy on its own or alongside a light breakfast.

title: Morrow Hand Grinder
description: A compact manual coffee grinder for dialing in fresh grounds at home or on the road. Its stainless-steel burrs adjust across settings for pour-over, French press, and AeroPress, while the aluminum body provides a secure, comfortable grip. The catch cup holds enough grounds for one or two servings, and the removable handle makes the grinder easy to pack. Brush away loose grounds after use and keep the burr assembly dry between brews.

title: Ochre Ribbed Stoneware Tea Cup
description: A small stoneware cup with a warm ochre glaze and tactile vertical ribs. The 8-ounce capacity suits tea, cortado, or a short filter coffee, and the gently rounded rim feels comfortable in the hand. Each cup is fired for everyday use and has subtle variations in glaze and surface that make every piece distinct. Safe for the microwave and dishwasher. Measures approximately 3.25 inches tall and pairs easily with neutral table linens and simple serving ware.

title: Carbon Steel Crepe Pan
description: This lightweight carbon steel pan is sized for thin crepes, breakfast pancakes, and quick-seared flatbreads. Its 10-inch cooking surface heats quickly and develops a natural nonstick patina with regular seasoning and use. A low sloped edge makes it easy to loosen and flip delicate foods, while the riveted handle offers a steady grip. Suitable for gas and electric stovetops; dry thoroughly after washing and apply a thin coat of oil before storing.

title: Stainless Steel Citrus Zester
description: A fine-toothed stainless-steel zester for adding bright citrus zest to cakes, sauces, tea, and savory dishes. The narrow grating surface also works for hard cheese, ginger, and whole nutmeg. A nonslip handle gives you control while working over a bowl or cutting board, and the protective cover keeps the teeth guarded in a utensil drawer. Rinse promptly after use or place it in the dishwasher. Measures 12 inches long, including the handle.

title: Maple Cardamom Coffee Syrup
description: A small-batch coffee syrup made with pure maple syrup, green cardamom, and a touch of cane sugar. Stir a spoonful into hot or iced coffee, drizzle over oatmeal, or brush onto warm pastries for a lightly spiced finish. The 8-ounce glass bottle has a pour-friendly neck and a screw cap for storage after opening. Shake gently before use and refrigerate once opened. Its mellow sweetness pairs especially well with medium-roast coffee and steamed milk.

title: Slow Morning Coffee and Tea Gift Set
description: A ready-to-give assortment for unhurried mornings, packed in a recyclable kraft box with paper cushioning. Inside are a 6-ounce bag of whole-bean medium-roast coffee, a 1-ounce pouch of loose-leaf breakfast tea, and a pair of dark chocolate oat biscuits. The coffee offers notes of toasted almond and brown sugar, while the tea brews into a brisk, malty cup. Includes a brew guide and a blank gift note card. Coffee is best enjoyed within four weeks of roasting.

title: A Table for Two: Simple Seasonal Suppers
description: A practical cookbook for cooking small, satisfying dinners without a long ingredient list. The hardcover edition includes 80 recipes organized by season, from spring pea and herb toast to winter lentils with roasted squash. Each recipe includes serving guidance for two, clear timing, and notes for using common pantry staples. Full-color photographs show finished dishes and simple plating ideas. At 192 pages, it fits neatly on a kitchen shelf and makes a useful companion for weeknight cooking or relaxed weekend meals.

title: Brass-Handled Pour-Over Set
description: A ceramic dripper and matching glass server designed for brewing two to four cups of pour-over coffee. The ridged dripper helps guide water through the grounds, while its wide opening fits standard cone filters. The borosilicate glass server holds up to 600 milliliters and features a sturdy brass-toned handle for a comfortable pour. Rinse the dripper between uses and wash the server by hand. Set includes one dripper, one server, and a printed guide to basic pour-over technique.

title: Night Ferry Espresso Blend
description: A full-bodied espresso blend combining Brazil natural and Sumatra wet-hulled coffees, roasted for notes of dark chocolate, toasted hazelnut, and dried fig. The 12-ounce bag contains whole beans with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Pull it as a syrupy straight shot, or pair it with steamed milk for a balanced cappuccino. This medium-dark roast also works well in a moka pot or automatic espresso machine.

title: Lemon Verbena & Silver Needle Tea
description: Delicate silver needle white tea is blended with dried lemon verbena for a gentle cup with soft floral notes and a fresh citrus finish. The loose-leaf tea comes in a 2.5-ounce resealable pouch, enough for approximately 30 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for three to four minutes. Serve it plain to appreciate its light character, or chill it for a crisp afternoon iced tea.

title: Birchwood Lever Espresso Press
description: This compact manual espresso press uses a stainless steel brewing chamber and a smoothly finished birchwood lever handle. It includes a dosing cup, tamper, and two filter baskets for single or double shots. Add finely ground coffee, tamp evenly, and press over a sturdy cup to brew without electricity. The press measures 9 inches tall and is suited to home counters or travel setups with access to hot water. Rinse removable parts after each use.

title: Tidepool Glass Latte Tumbler
description: Made from clear, borosilicate glass, this double-wall tumbler shows off layered lattes while keeping the outer surface comfortable to hold. It holds 12 ounces and has a gently rounded base that fits beneath most home espresso machines. Use it for flat whites, tea, or a small serving of cold brew. The lightweight glass is dishwasher safe on the top rack; avoid sudden temperature changes and inspect it before use if dropped.

title: Hammered Copper Jam Pot
description: Small-batch preserves and fruit compotes cook evenly in this wide, shallow jam pot, made from lined copper with sturdy cast-iron handles. Its 6-quart capacity gives fruit room to bubble without crowding, while the broad base encourages moisture to evaporate during cooking. Use it on gas or electric stovetops with a low-to-medium flame; it is not induction compatible. Hand-wash after cooling and dry thoroughly to keep the exterior bright.

title: Walnut Handle Dough Whisk
description: Bring flour and liquid together with a few quick strokes using this stainless steel dough whisk, finished with a turned walnut handle. The open-loop head moves through thick dough without packing up like a balloon whisk, making it useful for sourdough, pancakes, and muffin batter. It measures 12 inches long, with a comfortable handle for one-handed mixing. Hand-wash and dry promptly; occasional food-safe oil helps maintain the walnut’s natural finish.

title: Dark Chocolate Espresso Hazelnuts
description: Roasted hazelnuts are coated in bittersweet dark chocolate and finished with a light dusting of finely ground espresso. Each 6-ounce pouch offers a crunchy, coffee-forward treat for an afternoon break or a small dessert after dinner. The resealable bag helps keep the nuts crisp between servings. Enjoy them by the handful, scatter them over vanilla ice cream, or serve alongside a cup of black coffee. Contains hazelnuts and may contain traces of other tree nuts.

title: The Countertop Coffee Ritual Box
description: A practical coffee gift set for slow mornings, this box includes a 10-ounce bag of rotating single-origin whole beans, a ceramic dosing bowl, and a cotton brew towel. The beans are selected for approachable filter brewing, with roast and origin details printed on the bag. Use the bowl to weigh or stage grounds, then keep the towel nearby for drips and cleanup. Packed in a kraft gift box with paper padding; a grinder and brewing device are not included.

title: The Home Baker’s Grain & Crumb
description: This 224-page cookbook explores everyday baking with whole grains, from oat-and-rye breakfast loaves to buckwheat crackers and fruit galettes. Recipes include clear ingredient weights, step-by-step instructions, and notes on flour substitutions for home kitchens. A short opening section explains grain textures and how they affect hydration, so readers can adapt familiar bakes with confidence. The hardcover format lies open on a work surface, and a ribbon marker helps keep your place between mixing and proofing.

title: Fluted Porcelain Coffee Dripper
description: This single-cup pour-over dripper is wheel-thrown from glazed porcelain, with internal flutes that guide water through a paper filter toward the center opening. It fits a standard-size mug and brews one to two cups, depending on the coffee dose. Set the dripper over your vessel, add a rinsed cone filter and ground coffee, then pour hot water in slow circles. The 4.5-inch-wide brewer is dishwasher safe and suited to daily manual coffee brewing.

title: Indigo Linen Tea Towel Set
description: These two woven linen tea towels bring a simple indigo stripe to the kitchen while handling everyday drying and serving tasks. Each towel measures 18 by 28 inches and has a hanging loop sewn into one corner. The linen blend becomes softer with washing and is absorbent enough for glassware, tea trays, or covering a bowl of rising dough. Machine-wash cold with like colors and tumble-dry low. Expect a relaxed texture and light creasing, characteristic of linen.

title: Highland Sunrise Peru Coffee
description: Bright, balanced whole-bean coffee grown in the highlands of northern Peru. This medium roast brings notes of red apple, toasted almond, and cocoa, with a clean finish that works well as a daily cup. Choose a 12-ounce or 2-pound bag, both packed in a resealable valve pouch to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for the clearest flavor; the beans suit pour-over, drip, and French press methods.

title: Smoky Lapsang Souchong Loose Leaf Tea
description: A Chinese black tea with a distinctive wood-smoke aroma and a smooth, savory cup. The loose leaves are packed in a 3-ounce tin that keeps them protected from light and kitchen moisture. Steep one teaspoon per cup in freshly boiled water for three to four minutes, adjusting the time for a gentler or more robust brew. Enjoy it plain, or pair it with hearty breakfasts and savory snacks.

title: Stoneware Cold Brew Tower
description: This countertop cold brew tower combines a glazed stoneware base with a borosilicate glass brewing chamber and a stainless steel valve. Its slow-drip design lets water pass through ground coffee at a controlled pace, producing a concentrated brew for serving over ice or diluting with milk. The tower holds up to 24 ounces and includes a reusable metal filter. Disassemble the glass and filter for hand washing after each batch.

title: Moss Green Double-Wall Glass Cup
description: A lightweight borosilicate glass cup with a subtle moss-green tint and an insulated double wall. The 10-ounce capacity suits tea, americanos, or small servings of iced coffee, while the clear inner wall makes layered drinks easy to see. Its rounded shape is comfortable to hold without a handle and helps reduce condensation on the outside. Hand wash to preserve the finish; not intended for stovetop use.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Sourdough Dutch Oven
description: Designed for home bread baking, this 5-quart enameled cast iron Dutch oven retains heat for a well-browned crust and even baking. The dark interior helps show the color of developing loaves, and the tight-fitting lid traps steam during the first stage of baking. Use it in the oven for sourdough, braises, or soups; it is compatible with gas, electric, and induction cooktops. Hand washing is recommended.

title: Beechwood Adjustable Rolling Pin
description: Made from smooth, responsibly sourced beechwood, this rolling pin includes removable thickness rings for rolling dough to an even 2, 4, or 6 millimeters. The 18-inch barrel provides room to work with pie crusts, biscuits, and fresh pasta sheets, while the rings slide off for storage or freehand rolling. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry promptly. Avoid soaking or putting the wood in a dishwasher.

title: Sicilian Pistachio Cream
description: A smooth, spoonable spread made with roasted pistachios, sugar, and a touch of sunflower oil. The 7-ounce glass jar has a sweet, nutty flavor that works on toast, pancakes, and warm pastries, or as a filling for cookies and crepes. Stir before serving if natural oils settle at the surface. Store in a cool, dry place and refrigerate after opening for best texture and freshness.

title: At-Home Espresso Discovery Box
description: A coffee gift set for exploring espresso at home, featuring three 4-ounce bags of whole-bean coffee with distinct roast profiles: a mellow medium roast, a chocolate-forward blend, and a bright seasonal single origin. Each bag includes a short brewing card with dose and extraction suggestions for espresso machines and stovetop brewers. The coffees arrive in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper cushioning, ready to give or keep for a tasting session.

title: The Little Book of Broth and Beans
description: This practical cookbook brings together 75 recipes centered on beans, lentils, and slow-simmered broths. Find weeknight soups, pantry-friendly stews, and simple sides, with notes on soaking, seasoning, and adapting recipes for canned beans. The 192-page paperback includes a compact reference chart for cooking times and suggested flavor pairings. It is suited to cooks building confidence with legumes as well as experienced home cooks looking for flexible everyday meals.

title: Ridgeway Ceramic Burr Coffee Grinder
description: A manual coffee grinder with conical ceramic burrs and a stainless steel adjustment collar for dialing in grind size from fine espresso to coarse French press. Its 30-gram capacity is sized for a few cups at a time, and the clear grounds chamber makes it easy to check your dose. The textured beechwood handle folds down for storage. Brush the burrs clean regularly and avoid rinsing the grinding mechanism.

title: Cocoa Grove Natural Ethiopia Coffee
description: This single-origin coffee comes from small farms in Ethiopia’s Sidama region, where ripe cherries are dried whole for a fruit-forward cup. Expect notes of blueberry, cocoa, and bergamot, with a silky body that works especially well as a pour-over or in a French press. Roasted in small batches and packed as whole beans in a resealable, light-blocking pouch. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a two-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf.

title: Hearthside Toasted Rice Oolong
description: A gently roasted oolong blended with toasted brown rice for a warm, nutty infusion with a soft floral finish. The loose leaves unfurl through multiple steeps, making this a satisfying tea for a slow afternoon or alongside a simple meal. Packaged in a resealable tin to help protect its aroma; each tin contains 3 ounces, enough for roughly 35 cups depending on steeping strength. Brew with water just below boiling for three to four minutes.

title: Stainless Steel Coffee Scale with Timer
description: Measure coffee and water with consistent precision using this compact digital brewing scale. Its stainless steel weighing surface sits beneath a removable silicone mat, while the built-in timer helps track pour-over or espresso shot times. The clear backlit display reads in grams or ounces and supports weights up to 3 kilograms. A rechargeable USB-C battery keeps disposable cells out of the drawer. Use it on a level counter for dialing in recipes at home.

title: Sea Glass Speckled Porcelain Travel Mug
description: Carry your morning coffee in a glazed porcelain mug made for desk-side sipping and short trips out the door. The 12-ounce cup has a softly rounded handle, a speckled sea-glass glaze, and a fitted silicone lid to help reduce splashes. Its straight-sided shape fits most standard car cup holders, while the unglazed foot gives the base a stable feel on a table. Hand-wash the lid; the porcelain mug is dishwasher safe.

title: Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Sauté Pan
description: This 10-inch sauté pan combines a stainless steel cooking surface with an aluminum core for even heat across the base and sides. The deep profile gives vegetables room to toss, and the long riveted handle offers a steady grip when moving the pan from stovetop to oven. It works on induction, gas, and electric cooktops and is oven-safe to 500°F. Use it for browning mushrooms, reducing pan sauces, or cooking a weeknight one-pan meal.

title: Beechwood Matcha Whisk Stand
description: Give a bamboo matcha whisk a place to dry between uses with this simple beechwood whisk stand. Its rounded form supports the whisk over a small central opening, helping the tines keep their shape instead of resting against a countertop. The smooth, unfinished wood is lightweight and compact enough to sit beside a tea bowl or kettle. Rinse and dry the stand by hand, and let it air-dry fully before storing it with other tea tools.

title: Maple Sea Salt Drinking Chocolate
description: Make a rich cup of drinking chocolate with this blend of finely grated dark chocolate, Dutch-process cocoa, maple sugar, and a pinch of flaky sea salt. Stir two tablespoons into hot milk or a plant-based alternative, then whisk until smooth and glossy. The 8-ounce pouch also works as a topping for oatmeal or a baking ingredient in brownies. It contains no artificial flavoring and is packed in a resealable bag to keep the chocolate fragrant between uses.

title: Coffee Bar Essentials Gift Box
description: Set up a thoughtful home coffee station with a curated box of practical brewing accessories. Inside are a stainless steel coffee scoop, a reusable cotton cleaning cloth, a small jar of cinnamon sugar, and a set of tasting cards for noting favorite beans and brew ratios. Items arrive nestled in a kraft gift box with paper padding and a blank note card for a personal message. A useful pick for a new apartment, a coffee-loving host, or a shared office kitchen.

title: The Practical Guide to Sourdough
description: This approachable hardcover cookbook walks through sourdough baking from starter care to shaping and baking. Clear step-by-step instructions cover a basic country loaf, seeded rolls, discard crackers, and a simple skillet flatbread, with timing notes for fitting each recipe around a busy day. The book includes ingredient weights in grams, troubleshooting tips, and a compact glossary of bread terms. Its 176 pages make it a useful reference for first-time bakers and home cooks ready to expand beyond one loaf.

title: Replacement Glass Carafe Lid, Matte Black
description: This replacement lid is designed for the Northline 8-cup glass coffee carafe and helps keep dust out between pours. Made from heat-resistant polypropylene with a matte black finish, it fits securely over the original carafe rim and lifts off easily for cleaning. The lid is sold individually; the carafe is not included. Check the diameter of your existing carafe before ordering, as this part is not intended for universal use. Hand-wash to preserve the finish.

title: Fogline Honey Process Costa Rica Coffee
description: This medium-light roast brings notes of apricot, panela, and almond, with a rounded sweetness that works well as a pour-over or batch brew. The beans are grown in Costa Rica’s Tarrazú region and processed with a short honey fermentation before drying. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Grind just before brewing and store sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Meadow Mint and Nettle Loose Leaf Tea
description: A caffeine-free herbal blend of peppermint, nettle leaf, lemon balm, and a little spearmint for a clean, gently green cup. The loose leaves and herbs come in a 2.5-ounce resealable pouch, enough for roughly 25 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes. Enjoy it hot after a meal or pour it over ice for a refreshing afternoon drink.

title: Walnut Base Ceramic Pour-Over Brewer
description: This single-cup pour-over brewer pairs a glazed ceramic cone with a turned walnut support base. Its three drainage holes encourage a steady drawdown, while the wide opening fits standard size two paper filters. The brewer measures about 5 inches tall and rests securely on most mugs and small carafes. Rinse the ceramic after use and wipe the wooden base dry; the two pieces separate for easier cleaning and storage.

title: Dune Blue Porcelain Tea Bowl
description: Hand-finished porcelain gives this compact tea bowl a smooth rim and a soft blue glaze that fades into a sandy cream base. It holds 10 ounces, making it a comfortable size for tea, coffee, or a small serving of broth. The gently rounded form sits well in the hand, and the unglazed foot adds a subtle contrast. Suitable for the dishwasher and microwave; each bowl has slight glaze variations.

title: Hard-Anodized Deep Skillet with Lid
description: A versatile deep skillet for sautéing vegetables, simmering beans, or finishing a one-pan pasta dinner. The hard-anodized aluminum body heats evenly, while the stainless steel handle stays comfortable to grip as you move the pan from stovetop to oven. A tempered glass lid helps keep an eye on simmering food. Available in 10-inch and 12-inch sizes, it has a durable nonstick interior and is compatible with gas, electric, and ceramic cooktops.

title: Beechwood Bench Scraper with Steel Blade
description: This bench scraper combines a straight stainless steel blade with a smooth beechwood handle for a dependable grip. Use it to divide bread dough, lift chopped vegetables from a cutting board, or clean flour and pastry scraps from a work surface. The blade measures 6 inches wide and includes a printed measurement guide along its upper edge. Hand wash and dry promptly to protect the wood handle and keep the blade ready for daily kitchen work.

title: Smoked Maple Pecan Granola
description: Oats, toasted pecans, pumpkin seeds, and maple syrup bake into crisp clusters with a subtle touch of smoked salt. This small-batch granola comes in a 12-ounce resealable pouch and makes an easy breakfast with yogurt or milk, or a crunchy topping for baked fruit. It is made without artificial flavors and contains tree nuts. Keep the pouch sealed between servings to preserve the texture.

title: Brew and Bake Weekend Gift Crate
description: A ready-to-give collection for slow weekend mornings, packed in a reusable kraft crate. It includes a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a 6-ounce jar of orange blossom honey, a cotton tea towel, and a small batch of oat biscuits. The coffee is roasted for balanced drip brewing, while the honey is a welcome addition to tea or toast. Items are packed with paper cushioning and arrive ready to share.

title: The Seasonal Table: Cooking with Coffee, Tea, and Spice
description: This hardcover cookbook explores coffee and tea as ingredients in everyday cooking, alongside seasonal recipes for brunch, dessert, and relaxed suppers. Find ideas such as coffee-rubbed roast vegetables, black tea poached pears, and cardamom breakfast buns, with practical notes on choosing pantry staples. The book includes 144 pages, full-color food photography, and a sturdy lay-flat binding. It is designed for home cooks who want approachable recipes with a little extra depth.

title: Brushed Steel Milk Pitcher, 20 Ounce
description: Designed for steaming and pouring, this 20-ounce stainless steel pitcher has a balanced handle and a narrow spout for controlled latte art. The brushed finish resists visible fingerprints, and the interior measurement marks help portion milk for one or two drinks. Its capacity suits home espresso machines and small café setups alike. Rinse after use and wash by hand or in the dishwasher. The rounded base makes it easy to swirl milk into a smooth texture.

title: Sunroom Natural Colombia Coffee
description: These whole beans come from small farms in Huila, Colombia, and are processed naturally to bring out notes of ripe peach, cocoa, and panela. Roasted for a balanced cup, they work well in a French press, filter brewer, or espresso machine. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Store sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing for the freshest flavor.

title: Rosehip Hibiscus Citrus Tisane
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf blend of tart hibiscus, rosehip, orange peel, and a touch of lemongrass. Steep one heaping teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes, then enjoy it hot or pour it over ice. The bright red infusion has a lively citrus finish that suits afternoon breaks and after-dinner cups alike. Packed in a resealable 3-ounce pouch to help keep the botanicals aromatic between uses.

title: Compact Stainless Steel Burr Grinder
description: This hand-operated burr grinder offers adjustable settings for everything from coarse French press grounds to a finer pour-over grind. Its stainless steel body and ceramic burr assembly are designed for steady daily use, while the removable handle and catch cup make it easy to pack for travel. The 30-gram capacity is suited to a few cups at a time. Brush away loose grounds after use and avoid rinsing the burr mechanism under water.

title: Cobalt Blue Porcelain Espresso Cups
description: A pair of small porcelain cups made for espresso, cortados, or a measured tasting pour. Each cup holds 3 ounces and has a rounded handle that stays comfortable during a short coffee break. The glossy cobalt glaze is applied by hand, so subtle variations in color make every set distinct. Durable porcelain retains warmth without feeling bulky, and the cups are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup. Set includes two cups.

title: Forged Iron Mini Dutch Oven
description: This 2-quart enameled cast iron pot is sized for a small batch of beans, baked oatmeal, or a side dish for two. A close-fitting lid helps hold in moisture, and the durable enamel interior needs no seasoning before use. The deep forest-green exterior moves neatly from stovetop to oven, with broad handles for a secure grip using mitts. Compatible with gas, electric, and induction cooktops; hand washing is recommended to preserve the finish.

title: Stainless Steel Fine-Mesh Tea Infuser
description: This basket-style infuser gives loose tea leaves room to unfurl while keeping small particles out of the cup. Fine stainless steel mesh fits most mugs and teapots with an opening at least 2.5 inches wide, and the resting lid doubles as a drip tray after steeping. A small handle makes it easy to lift without touching hot water. Rinse after each use or place it in the dishwasher for a quick cleanup.

title: Tahini Sesame Brittle Squares
description: Thin, crisp brittle squares combine toasted sesame seeds with creamy tahini and a pinch of flaky salt. Made in small batches, they offer a nutty crunch alongside coffee, black tea, or an afternoon snack. Each 5-ounce box contains individually wrapped pieces to make sharing simple and help keep the brittle crisp. The recipe contains sesame and may be made in a facility that handles tree nuts. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Sunday Counter Coffee and Biscuit Gift Box
description: A ready-to-gift pairing for slow mornings, featuring a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee and a 6-ounce tin of buttery oat biscuits. The coffee has a chocolate and toasted almond profile suited to drip brewers and French presses. Biscuits arrive packed separately to keep their texture intact, along with a printed brewing card with simple water-to-coffee guidance. Choose whole beans or have the coffee ground for a standard drip machine.

title: The Small-Batch Pickle Pantry
description: A practical cookbook for home cooks who want to preserve seasonal produce without setting up a full canning operation. Inside are 75 recipes for quick pickles, refrigerator relishes, and bright condiments, with clear guidance on brines, preparation, and storage. The 160-page paperback includes ideas for using pickled vegetables in grain bowls, sandwiches, and simple suppers. A helpful addition to a kitchen shelf or a gift for someone with a busy garden.

title: Linen-Wrapped Ceramic Matcha Bowl
description: Hand-thrown stoneware with a wide shape that makes whisking matcha easier and helps keep splashes in the bowl. The warm sand glaze contrasts with an unglazed foot, and small differences in the surface reflect its handcrafted finish. It holds approximately 14 ounces, leaving room for a bamboo whisk and a full serving of tea. Rinse promptly after use and wash by hand; each bowl arrives wrapped in a reusable linen cloth.

title: Acacia Wood Toast Tongs
description: These lightweight acacia tongs make it easier to lift toast, bagels, or warm pastries without reaching into a toaster. Smooth, rounded ends grip slices gently, while the joined handle keeps the pair aligned during use. At 9 inches long, they fit neatly in a utensil drawer and work well beside a breakfast board or serving plate. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and occasionally treat with food-safe mineral oil to maintain the wood.

title: Lantern House Espresso Blend
description: A balanced espresso blend built from Brazil and Honduras coffees, roasted to bring out cocoa, toasted almond, and a gentle dried-fruit sweetness. The whole beans come in a resealable 12-ounce bag with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Pull it as a straight shot, pair it with milk, or brew it in a moka pot for a rich, steady cup. Choose a 12-ounce bag or a two-bag bundle for stocking the home coffee shelf.

title: Apricot Blossom White Tea
description: Delicate white tea leaves are blended with dried apricot pieces and a small amount of calendula for a soft floral aroma and mellow stone-fruit finish. This loose-leaf tea is packed in a 2.5-ounce resealable pouch, enough for roughly 25 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in water just off the boil for three to four minutes. Enjoy it warm in the afternoon or chilled over ice without added sweetener.

title: Foldaway Stainless Steel Coffee Dripper
description: This collapsible pour-over dripper has a stainless steel frame and a food-safe silicone sleeve that folds flat for travel or compact drawer storage. Open the frame over a mug or carafe, add a standard cone filter, and brew one to two cups at a time. The wide base fits most everyday mugs, while the raised ribs help maintain space between the filter and frame for an even drawdown. Rinse clean after use and let it air-dry fully before folding.

title: Cloudline Speckled Stoneware Mug
description: Hand-finished stoneware gives this everyday mug a softly speckled glaze in warm cream with a muted blue rim. It holds 13 ounces, with a rounded handle sized to leave room for a comfortable grip. The gently tapered shape suits coffee, tea, or a small serving of cocoa, and the sturdy foot sits steadily on a desk or kitchen table. Each mug is fired individually, so the glaze pattern and speckle placement vary slightly. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

title: Hammered Aluminum Paella Pan
description: Made from lightweight hammered aluminum, this wide paella pan heats quickly and gives rice a broad surface for an even layer of cooking. The 15-inch pan has shallow sides, two riveted loop handles, and a flat base suited to gas burners and outdoor grills. Use it for paella, seared vegetables, or a generous skillet meal for a group. Hand-wash with warm water and dry promptly; it is not intended for induction cooktops or the dishwasher.

title: Flexible Silicone Jar Spatula Set
description: These two slim spatulas are shaped to reach into jars, narrow bottles, and mixing bowls, helping scrape out nut butter, jam, and batter with less waste. Each has a flexible, heat-resistant silicone head attached to a sturdy nylon handle, with one 10-inch spatula and one 12-inch spatula in the set. The smooth edges bend around curved containers while remaining firm enough for stirring. Both pieces are dishwasher safe and have hanging holes for easy storage.

title: Ginger Lime Candied Orange Peel
description: Thin strips of orange peel are slowly candied, then finished with crystallized ginger and a touch of lime zest for a sweet, citrusy bite with gentle warmth. The 5-ounce pouch is packed in small batches and reseals between servings. Enjoy the peel alongside tea or coffee, chop it into scone dough, or use a few pieces to garnish a dessert plate. Made with orange peel, sugar, ginger, and lime; keep sealed in a cool, dry pantry.

title: The Cozy Counter Tea and Biscuit Box
description: A ready-to-give pairing for a quiet tea break, this box includes a 2-ounce pouch of vanilla rooibos, a 4-ounce tin of lemon oat biscuits, and a stainless steel single-cup infuser. The tea is naturally caffeine-free, with warm vanilla notes that complement the crisp, lightly sweet biscuits. Items arrive nestled in a recyclable kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a blank note card for a short message. Store the tea and biscuits in their sealed containers after opening.

title: A Little More Greens: Weeknight Vegetable Cooking
description: This practical cookbook gathers 85 vegetable-forward recipes for everyday dinners, from charred cabbage with sesame dressing to chickpea and spinach stew. Clear instructions, accessible ingredients, and serving suggestions make it useful for cooks who want more flexible ways to build a meal around produce. The softcover edition measures 7 by 9 inches and includes color photography throughout. Use it for quick weeknight inspiration, or browse the seasonal chapter notes when planning a market-to-table menu.

title: Recycled Glass Coffee Server, 600 ml
description: Made from clear recycled glass, this 600-milliliter server catches pour-over coffee and makes it easy to see how much you have brewed. Its gently curved spout pours cleanly into cups, while the wide handle provides space for a secure grip. The server fits many cone drippers and serves about two to three small cups. Use it for coffee or loose-leaf tea, then wash by hand with a soft sponge. Avoid sudden temperature changes and direct contact with a burner.

title: Citrus Grove Olive Oil Cake Mix
description: This pantry-ready mix makes a tender olive oil cake scented with dried lemon peel and a little rosemary. The 14-ounce pouch contains the dry ingredients; add eggs, olive oil, and milk or a dairy-free alternative, then bake in an 8-inch round pan. Instructions include a simple glaze option and notes for checking doneness. Serve slices with coffee for brunch or alongside tea in the afternoon. Store the unopened pouch in a cool, dry place and use it within six months.

title: Citrus Hearth Rooibos Blend
description: A naturally caffeine-free loose-leaf blend of South African rooibos, dried orange peel, cinnamon, and a touch of calendula. The cup is smooth and gently spiced, with a bright citrus aroma that suits afternoon sipping or an after-dinner pot. Each 3-ounce pouch makes approximately 35 cups, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes. Enjoy it plain, or add a splash of milk for a softer, dessert-like finish.

title: Stainless Steel Gooseneck Kettle
description: This stovetop kettle pairs a narrow gooseneck spout with a balanced handle for steady, controlled pouring over coffee or tea. Its brushed stainless steel body holds 1 liter and has a fitted lid with a heat-resistant knob. The slim spout helps direct water across a coffee bed without flooding the grounds, while the broad base sits securely on most gas and electric stovetops. Hand wash with warm soapy water and dry thoroughly after use. Not intended for induction cooktops.

title: Speckled Clay Espresso Tumbler Pair
description: These two hand-finished stoneware tumblers are sized for espresso, cortados, or a small after-dinner tea. Each cup holds 4 ounces and has a softly tapered shape that feels comfortable to hold without a handle. A warm sand glaze with charcoal speckles gives the pair a relaxed, handmade look; slight variations in color and pattern are part of the finish. The cups are dishwasher and microwave safe. Use them for daily coffee service or set them out alongside a small dessert.

title: Blue Steel Carbon Cookware Skillet
description: A versatile 10-inch carbon steel skillet for searing vegetables, frying eggs, and browning meat. The pan is made from heavy-gauge blue steel with a riveted stainless steel handle and arrives pre-seasoned for an easier start. Its responsive construction heats quickly and develops a naturally slick cooking surface with regular use. Suitable for gas, electric, and induction cooktops, as well as oven finishing. Hand wash, dry promptly, and apply a thin coat of cooking oil before storing to help protect the surface.

title: Stainless Steel Coffee Filter Refill, 100 Pack
description: A practical refill of 100 unbleached paper filters for everyday drip coffee. The flat-bottom filters fit compatible 8- to 12-cup basket-style coffee makers and are made from chlorine-free paper. Rinse the filter with hot water before brewing to reduce any paper taste and help warm the brewer. This compact sleeve is designed to restock a kitchen drawer rather than dress up a gift basket. Check your coffee maker’s basket dimensions before ordering, since filter shapes and sizes vary between machines.

title: Roasted Pear and Ginger Fruit Spread
description: Small-batch fruit spread made with ripe pears, fresh ginger, lemon juice, and cane sugar. The 8-ounce glass jar has a softly textured, spoonable consistency and a warm fruit flavor with a clean ginger finish. Spread it on toast, fold it into plain yogurt, or serve it beside a cheese board and buttery biscuits. Refrigerate after opening and use a clean spoon each time. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts, so please review the label if you have food sensitivities.

title: Morning Brew and Toast Gift Crate
description: A ready-to-give breakfast crate with a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a jar of wildflower honey, and a small bag of flaky sea salt crackers. The coffee has a balanced profile suited to drip brewing and French press, while the honey adds a simple touch for toast or tea. Items arrive packed in a recyclable kraft box with paper cushioning and a printed contents card. A useful choice for a housewarming or thank-you, with pantry staples that can be enjoyed throughout the week.

title: The One-Pot Supper Notebook
description: This compact cookbook collects 60 practical one-pot recipes for home cooks who want dinner with fewer dishes. Chapters cover stovetop beans and grains, oven-baked casseroles, brothy noodles, and simple skillet meals, with clear ingredient lists and timing notes. Recipes use familiar supermarket ingredients and include serving suggestions for leftovers. The paperback measures 7 by 9 inches and includes a lay-flat binding for easier kitchen use. Keep it near the stove for weeknight ideas, or browse the seasonal recipe index when planning a relaxed Sunday meal.

title: Citrus Scale Descaling Solution
description: A concentrated descaling solution for removing mineral buildup from electric kettles, drip coffee makers, and compatible espresso machines. The 250 ml bottle provides five measured treatments, with dilution instructions printed on the label for common appliance types. Its mild citrus scent fades after a thorough rinse, leaving equipment ready for regular use. Follow your machine manufacturer’s care guidance and do not pour the concentrate directly into an appliance without diluting it first. This is a practical maintenance item to keep with cleaning supplies, rather than a decorative gift.

title: Juniper Ridge Medium Roast Coffee
description: This medium-roast whole bean coffee brings together washed coffees from Guatemala and Honduras for a rounded cup with notes of cocoa nib, red apple, and toasted almond. The 12-ounce bag is sealed with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for pour-over, drip, or French press; use a finer grind for espresso. Roasted in small batches and packed without flavorings, it makes an easy everyday coffee for black-coffee drinkers and milk-based drinks alike.

title: Jasmine Cloud Green Tea Pearls
description: Hand-rolled green tea leaves are scented with fresh jasmine blossoms to create fragrant pearls that slowly unfurl in hot water. Each 2-ounce tin contains loose-leaf tea with a soft floral aroma, a clean green finish, and gentle sweetness. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for two to three minutes, then resteep the leaves for another infusion. The compact tin keeps the tea protected from light and makes a thoughtful choice for anyone who enjoys delicate, aromatic brews.

title: Copper Coil Stovetop Gooseneck Kettle
description: Designed for steady, controlled pouring, this 1-liter stovetop kettle has a narrow gooseneck spout and a balanced handle that helps guide water over coffee grounds or tea leaves. Its stainless steel body has a copper-toned exterior finish, with a heat-safe handle and fitted lid. Suitable for gas and electric ranges, it is not intended for induction cooktops. Rinse and dry after use to maintain the finish, and pour slowly for an even extraction when preparing manual brews.

title: Poppy Red Porcelain Cappuccino Cup Set
description: These compact porcelain cups bring a bright pop of color to cappuccinos, flat whites, and afternoon tea. Each set includes two 7-ounce cups with a glossy poppy-red exterior, warm white interiors, and gently rounded handles. The sturdy porcelain holds heat comfortably while remaining easy to lift and sip from. Cups are dishwasher safe for everyday cleanup and nest together for storage. Their vivid glaze pairs well with neutral tableware and makes a cheerful housewarming or coffee-lover gift.

title: Oval Enameled Steel Roasting Pan
description: This lightweight oval roasting pan is made from carbon steel with a durable cream enamel interior and deep forest-green exterior. Measuring 14 inches long, it offers room for a small roast chicken, a tray of root vegetables, or a baked pasta dinner. The broad handles provide a secure grip with oven mitts, while the smooth surface releases food easily and cleans up with warm, soapy water. Use it in the oven up to 450°F; avoid metal utensils to help protect the enamel finish.

title: Olivewood Measuring Spoon Set
description: Four measuring spoons are carved from olivewood, with naturally varied grain that makes each set subtly distinct. The spoons measure 1 tablespoon, 1 teaspoon, 1/2 teaspoon, and 1/4 teaspoon, and a small metal ring keeps them together in a drawer or on a hook. Use them for coffee, baking ingredients, spices, or loose tea. Hand wash and dry promptly; an occasional coat of food-safe mineral oil helps maintain the wood’s smooth surface and warm color.

title: Brown Butter Shortbread Tin
description: These crisp, buttery shortbread rounds are baked with browned butter, a pinch of sea salt, and a touch of vanilla. The 6-ounce reusable tin holds approximately twelve cookies, packed in a paper liner to keep them fresh on the way to the table. Serve with black tea, coffee, or a small scoop of ice cream. Made in small batches with wheat, dairy, and egg, they are best enjoyed within three weeks of opening and stored in a cool, dry place.

title: The Sunday Brew and Brunch Gift Hamper
description: A relaxed brunch pairing in a ready-to-give kraft box, this hamper includes a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a jar of wildflower honey, and a 4-ounce pouch of buttery oat biscuits. The coffee offers a smooth, chocolate-forward cup, while the honey and biscuits make an easy addition to toast or a weekend breakfast spread. Contents are packed in recyclable paper cushioning with a printed card for your message. A good choice for new homes, thank-you gifts, or slow Sunday mornings.

title: Everyday Knife Skills: A Home Cook’s Companion
description: This practical hardcover cookbook focuses on the knife techniques that make daily cooking faster and more confident. Clear step-by-step lessons cover safe grip, sharpening basics, and cuts for onions, herbs, root vegetables, and fruit, followed by simple recipes that put each skill to use. The 176-page book includes full-color photographs, a glossary, and guidance for choosing a chef’s knife and paring knife. Keep it near the prep board for quick reference, whether you are learning to cook or refreshing your kitchen fundamentals.

title: Cinnamon Date Espresso Truffles
description: Soft date centers are blended with espresso and cinnamon, then coated in dark chocolate and finished with a light dusting of cocoa. This 5-ounce box contains eight bite-size truffles, individually nestled in paper cups for easy serving. Pair them with a short espresso or strong black tea after dinner, or set them out alongside a dessert board. Made with dates, chocolate, coffee, and spices, they contain no artificial flavors. Store in a cool, dry place and enjoy within the date printed on the box.

title: Stoneware Matcha and Snack Tray
description: This handmade stoneware tray keeps a whisk, tea scoop, and small bowl of sweets together while you prepare matcha. Its 10-by-5-inch surface has a shallow raised edge and a satin sand glaze marked with subtle iron flecks. Use it as a compact tea-prep station, or carry cups and a small snack from kitchen to table. Each tray is fired for everyday durability and can be washed by hand or in the dishwasher. Slight variations in glaze and form are part of the studio-made finish.

title: Cardamom Cocoa Decaf Coffee
description: This smooth decaffeinated coffee brings together chocolatey notes and a gentle cardamom aroma for an easygoing cup at any hour. The beans are sourced from a small lot in Guatemala and roasted to a medium profile that works well in a French press, drip brewer, or espresso machine. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Store sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing for the freshest flavor.

title: Lemon Verbena and Ginger Herbal Tea
description: A bright, caffeine-free herbal blend of lemon verbena, ginger pieces, lemongrass, and a little licorice root. The citrusy aroma and warming ginger make it a comforting choice after a meal or on a cool afternoon. Each tin contains 2.5 ounces of loose tea, enough for approximately 25 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one heaping teaspoon in freshly boiled water for 5–7 minutes, then strain. Enjoy it plain or add a slice of fresh lemon.

title: Countertop Ceramic Coffee Siphon Brewer
description: Make a clear, aromatic pot of coffee with this tabletop siphon brewer, which uses gentle vapor pressure and a cloth filter to draw brewed coffee into its lower chamber. The set includes borosilicate glass chambers, a stainless steel stand, a reusable cotton filter, and a measuring spoon. Its 20-ounce capacity serves two to three cups. Use with a small butane burner or alcohol burner, sold separately, and handle the heated glass with care. Rinse the cloth filter after each brew.

title: Terracotta Rimmed Matcha Latte Cup
description: Hand-finished stoneware gives this everyday cup a softly textured body and a contrasting unglazed terracotta-colored rim. Its rounded shape feels comfortable in the hand and leaves room for a generous pour of matcha, tea, or coffee. The cup holds 12 ounces and measures about 3.5 inches tall. A clear food-safe glaze lines the interior for easy cleaning, while subtle variations in glaze and shape make each piece distinct. Dishwasher safe; avoid sudden temperature changes.

title: Carbon Steel Crepe and Pancake Pan
description: This lightweight carbon steel pan heats quickly and develops a naturally seasoned cooking surface with regular use. The wide, shallow 10-inch cooking area makes it useful for thin crepes, pancakes, tortillas, and eggs. A long riveted steel handle provides a secure grip, and the pan is suitable for gas, electric, and induction cooktops. Season before first use and dry thoroughly after washing to prevent rust. With proper care, the surface becomes increasingly slick over time.

title: Brass Coffee Scoop with Bag Clip
description: Keep a scoop close at hand with this solid brass coffee measure, designed with a flat spring clip at the end of its handle. The bowl holds approximately two tablespoons, a practical starting measure for a standard mug of drip coffee. Clip it to the folded edge of a coffee bag to help keep beans contained between brews. The scoop is 6 inches long and has a brushed finish that develops a natural patina with use. Hand wash and dry promptly.

title: Black Sesame and Honey Tea Cookies
description: These crisp, small-batch cookies pair toasted black sesame with floral honey for a nutty, lightly sweet bite alongside coffee or tea. Baked with wheat flour, butter, sesame, and local honey, they arrive in a resealable 6-ounce pouch to help preserve their crunch. Serve them with a cup of green tea or crumble over vanilla ice cream. Contains wheat and dairy and is made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: The Slow Morning Coffee and Citrus Box
description: A cheerful gift for a leisurely start to the day, this box pairs a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast Brazil coffee with a jar of orange marmalade and a packet of buttery oat biscuits. The coffee is roasted for a rounded cup with notes of cocoa and toasted almond, while the marmalade brings a bright citrus finish to toast or scones. Items arrive packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a printed brewing card. Coffee is whole bean; grinding is not included.

title: Everyday Tea: Blends for the Kitchen Table
description: This practical hardcover guide explores ways to brew and cook with everyday tea, from black and green varieties to herbal infusions. Inside are recipes for tea-steeped poached pears, iced tea concentrates, savory tea rubs, and simple cakes, alongside notes on water temperature and steeping time. The book measures 7 by 9 inches and includes 144 pages with color photography. It is designed for curious home cooks and tea drinkers who want approachable recipes and useful brewing ideas without specialized equipment.

title: Foldable Silicone Pour-Over Drip Mat
description: Protect your counter while brewing with this flexible silicone mat, shaped with a raised ring to steady a pour-over dripper or small coffee server. The 8-by-6-inch surface catches stray drips and folds for compact storage in a drawer or travel kit. Food-grade, heat-resistant silicone is easy to rinse and dishwasher safe. A shallow channel guides excess water toward the edge, helping keep the brewing area tidy between cups. The mat is sold on its own; dripper and server are not included.

title: Smoked Sea Salt Caramelized Onion Relish
description: Slow-cooked onions, a touch of brown sugar, cider vinegar, and smoked sea salt make a savory-sweet relish for sandwiches and cheese boards. The onions are cooked until soft and glossy, with a balanced tang that works especially well alongside sharp cheddar, grilled sausages, or roasted vegetables. Each glass jar contains 8 ounces. Refrigerate after opening and use a clean spoon when serving. This pantry staple is made in small batches and is a flavorful alternative to chutney or ordinary sandwich spread.

title: Night Ferry Guatemala Huehuetenango Coffee
description: Single-origin whole-bean coffee from Huehuetenango, Guatemala, roasted to a balanced medium profile. Expect notes of red apple, cocoa nib, and toasted almond, with a rounded finish that works well as drip coffee or a carefully pulled espresso. The 12-ounce bag is packed in a resealable, one-way-valve pouch to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing and adjust the dose to suit your preferred method.

title: Blueberry Sage Black Tea
description: A loose-leaf black tea blend pairing brisk Ceylon tea with dried blueberries, fragrant sage, and a touch of orange peel. The cup is full-bodied and gently fruity, suited to breakfast or an afternoon pot. Each 3-ounce tin contains enough tea for about 35 cups, depending on your measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in freshly boiled water for three to four minutes, then serve plain or with a splash of milk.

title: Precision Temperature Pour-Over Kettle
description: This electric gooseneck kettle offers adjustable temperature control for pour-over coffee and delicate teas. The 0.9-liter stainless steel body has a narrow spout for a steady, controlled stream, while the heat-resistant handle stays comfortable during use. Set the temperature between 104°F and 212°F on the base display, or use the hold function to maintain your selection for up to 30 minutes. Includes kettle and powered base; hand-wash the kettle.

title: Ochre Rim Stoneware Tea Cup Set
description: Two handmade stoneware cups with softly rounded walls and a warm ochre rim, designed for tea, cortados, or small servings of coffee. Each cup holds approximately 8 ounces and has a comfortable, handle-free shape that warms easily in the hands. The durable glazed interior is food-safe, and the unglazed foot shows the natural clay body. Small variations in glaze and form are part of the studio-made finish. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

title: Lidded Ceramic Bean Pot
description: A glazed stoneware bean pot for slow-cooked beans, baked grains, and oven-to-table sides. Its 2.5-quart capacity serves four to six, while the fitted lid helps retain moisture during a long bake. The wide opening makes it easy to stir and serve, and the sturdy side handles provide a secure grip with oven mitts. Suitable for conventional ovens up to 450°F; allow the pot to warm gradually and avoid placing it directly on a stovetop burner.

title: Stainless Steel Citrus Zester and Grater
description: Fine stainless steel teeth make quick work of zesting lemons, limes, and oranges, as well as grating hard cheese, ginger, or nutmeg. The 12-inch tool has a nonslip handle and a protective cover for safer drawer storage. Its narrow profile fits over bowls and cutting boards, and the hanging loop keeps it within reach on a kitchen rail. Rinse promptly after use and wash by hand or in the dishwasher.

title: Blackcurrant Cardamom Jam
description: Small-batch blackcurrant jam cooked with whole cardamom pods for a tart, aromatic spread. The fruit-forward texture suits buttered toast, scones, yogurt, and a cheese board, while the warm spice adds depth without overpowering the berries. Each 8-ounce glass jar is sealed for pantry storage; refrigerate after opening and use a clean spoon. Made with blackcurrants, sugar, lemon juice, and cardamom. Contains no artificial colors or flavors.

title: Tea Tasting and Honey Gift Set
description: A ready-to-give assortment for exploring different styles of tea. The box includes three 1-ounce loose-leaf teas—bright breakfast black, floral jasmine green, and calming chamomile blend—along with a 4-ounce jar of wildflower honey and a stainless steel basket infuser. Tasting cards inside provide suggested steeping temperatures and times for each blend. Packed in a recyclable kraft box with paper cushioning; tea selections are sealed separately to keep their aromas distinct.

title: The Everyday Grain Bowl
description: A practical cookbook devoted to satisfying grain bowls for home cooks, with recipes organized around rice, farro, barley, quinoa, and other pantry staples. Chapters cover building a balanced bowl, preparing sauces and dressings, and making toppings ahead for easy weekday meals. The 192-page paperback includes clear ingredient lists, serving guidance, and options for seasonal substitutions. Use it as a starting point for lunch prep or as a flexible guide to turning leftovers into dinner.

title: Single-Origin Decaf Peru Coffee
description: Whole-bean decaf coffee sourced from Peru and gently processed to preserve its sweet, mellow character. A medium-light roast brings out notes of caramel, dried fig, and roasted hazelnut, making it an easy choice for an evening pour-over or French press. The 10-ounce bag is sealed in a resealable freshness pouch. For a balanced cup, start with a medium grind and use about 15 grams of coffee for every 250 grams of water.

title: Copper Lantern Ethiopia Guji Coffee
description: This light-roast whole bean coffee comes from smallholder farms in Ethiopia’s Guji zone, where high-grown cherries develop a lively, floral cup. Expect notes of peach, bergamot, and panela with a clean finish. Each 12-ounce bag is valve-sealed to help preserve freshness and includes a roast date on the back. Grind just before brewing for pour-over, drip, or AeroPress; a medium grind also works well in a batch brewer.

title: Toasted Rice and Pear Oolong
description: A gently roasted oolong blended with toasted brown rice and dried pear for a mellow, rounded cup. The loose-leaf blend comes in a 3-ounce resealable pouch, enough for roughly 35 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for three to four minutes. It’s an easy afternoon tea on its own, or a fragrant companion to fruit and lightly sweet pastries.

title: Ridgeback Stainless Steel French Press
description: Brew full-bodied coffee without paper filters in this brushed stainless steel French press. Its double-wall body helps keep coffee warm at the table, while the fine metal mesh separates grounds cleanly when the plunger is pressed. The 34-ounce capacity makes about four standard cups. A sturdy handle and removable plunger assembly make serving and cleanup straightforward; wash by hand and dry promptly to keep the finish looking its best.

title: Moss Green Stoneware Latte Cup
description: Thrown from durable stoneware and finished in a glossy moss-green glaze, this wide latte cup has a comfortable rounded handle and a stable foot. The 12-ounce capacity suits a milky coffee, a generous tea, or a small serving of cocoa. Each cup is kiln-fired, so subtle variations in glaze and shape are part of its handmade character. Microwave and dishwasher safe for easy everyday use.

title: Blue Carbon Steel Wok
description: This 13-inch blue carbon steel wok is shaped for quick stir-frying, with sloped sides that make tossing vegetables and noodles easy. A long steel handle offers a secure grip at the stove, while the flat base sits steadily on most home cooktops. The pan arrives with a protective coating that should be washed off before seasoning. With regular oil seasoning, its cooking surface develops a naturally slick patina. Hand wash and dry after use.

title: Paper Coffee Filter Refills, 200 Pack
description: A practical refill pack of 200 unbleached paper filters for flat-bottom home drip brewers. The filters are sized for standard eight- to twelve-cup basket-style coffee makers and help keep grounds out of the pot while making cleanup quick. Fold the crimped seam before placing each filter in the brew basket, then discard it with the used grounds after brewing. A straightforward pantry staple for daily coffee routines; brewer compatibility may vary by basket shape.

title: Wildflower Honey Almond Biscotti
description: Twice-baked almond biscotti made with wildflower honey, toasted sliced almonds, and a touch of orange zest. The crisp texture is designed for dunking in coffee or black tea, though the cookies are just as good on their own. Each 6-ounce box contains approximately eight individually wrapped pieces to help keep them fresh between servings. Made in small batches and packed in a recyclable paperboard carton; store in a cool, dry place.

title: Tea and Toasted Almond Morning Box
description: A ready-to-share breakfast pairing with a 2-ounce pouch of breakfast black tea, a small jar of orange marmalade, and a 5-ounce sleeve of toasted almond shortbread. The tea brews a brisk cup that balances the buttery cookies, while the marmalade is suited to toast or pastries. Items are packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a printed contents card. A thoughtful choice for a tea drinker who enjoys a simple morning ritual.

title: The Cast-Iron Skillet Table
description: A practical home-cooking book focused on making the most of a cast-iron skillet, from crisp-edged cornbread to seared vegetables and one-pan suppers. The hardcover includes 72 recipes, clear heat and care guidance, and full-color photographs throughout. Recipes are written for everyday kitchens and include serving notes and straightforward ingredient lists. At 192 pages, it’s a useful reference for cooks learning to season and maintain cast iron as well as those looking for new weeknight ideas.

title: Handblown Amber Glass Tea Tumbler
description: This handblown borosilicate glass tumbler has a warm amber tint and a gently curved profile that feels comfortable in the hand. Its 10-ounce capacity works well for loose-leaf tea, iced coffee, or a small latte. The clear walls let you see the color of your drink, while the sturdy base helps it sit securely on a table. Each tumbler is individually made, so small differences in shape and glass tone are expected. Hand wash recommended.

title: Citrus Peel and Cocoa Nib Coffee
description: This medium-roast blend pairs washed Brazilian beans with a small portion of natural-process coffee for a rounded, chocolate-forward brew. Notes of cocoa nib, dried cherry, and candied citrus peel make it a versatile choice for drip coffee and French press. Available as whole bean or ground to suit your brewing setup, each bag contains freshly roasted coffee sealed in a one-way valve pouch. Choose the 12-ounce bag for regular brewing or the 2-pound bag for a busy coffee station.

title: High Meadow Costa Rica Honey-Process Coffee
description: This medium-light roast comes from a small lot in Costa Rica’s West Valley, where honey processing brings out notes of yellow plum, panela, and toasted almond. The whole beans are roasted in small batches and packed in a resealable 12-ounce bag with a one-way valve. Brew it as a balanced pour-over or use a slightly finer grind for a sweet, rounded espresso. For the clearest fruit notes, start with water just off the boil and adjust to taste.

title: Misty Orchard Sencha Tea
description: Bright Japanese sencha leaves are gently steamed and finished with a clean, grassy aroma and a soft hint of melon. This loose-leaf tea comes in a 70-gram resealable pouch, enough for approximately 30 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water around 175°F for two minutes to keep the flavor fresh and smooth. It makes an easy afternoon cup on its own and pairs well with lightly salted rice crackers.

title: Clearview Ceramic-Drip Coffee Brewer
description: Make a single cup or a small carafe with this glazed ceramic pour-over brewer, sized to sit securely over most mugs and servers. Its spiral interior ribs help maintain an even flow, while the wide opening fits standard flat-bottom paper filters. The brewer measures 5 inches tall and holds up to 16 ounces of water. Use it with medium-ground coffee, pouring slowly in circles; after brewing, rinse it by hand or place it in the dishwasher.

title: Dune Glaze Stoneware Coffee Mug
description: A softly curved everyday mug with a warm sand-colored glaze and a darker, unglazed foot. Each piece is made from sturdy stoneware, with a comfortable handle sized to leave room for a few fingers. The mug holds 12 ounces and measures about 4 inches tall, making it suitable for coffee, tea, or a generous serving of cocoa. Its glazed interior cleans easily, and the mug is safe for both microwave reheating and dishwasher use.

title: Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Saucepan with Glass Lid
description: This 2-quart saucepan pairs a stainless steel cooking surface with an aluminum core for responsive, even heating. A fitted tempered-glass lid lets you check simmering grains, sauces, and soups without lifting the cover, while the riveted handle stays firmly attached through daily use. The pan is compatible with gas, electric, and induction stovetops and measures 6 inches across. Wash by hand for a bright finish; the glass lid is dishwasher safe.

title: Walnut-Handled Stainless Steel Coffee Scoop
description: Measure a consistent scoop of ground coffee with this compact stainless steel spoon, finished with a smooth walnut handle. The bowl holds approximately two tablespoons, a useful starting portion for a single mug, though your preferred brew ratio may vary. A small hanging loop at the end keeps the scoop easy to find beside a grinder or coffee canister. Wipe the wooden handle clean after use and hand-wash the steel bowl; do not soak the handle.

title: Vanilla Bean Drinking Chocolate
description: Rich, finely shaved dark chocolate is blended with cocoa powder, cane sugar, and fragrant ground vanilla bean for a smooth stovetop drinking chocolate. The 8-ounce tin makes about eight servings; whisk two tablespoons into a cup of warm milk or your preferred non-dairy alternative. Keep the tin sealed in a cool, dry cupboard to protect its aroma and texture. The blend is also handy stirred into oatmeal or sprinkled over cappuccino foam.

title: The Pour-Over and Pastry Morning Box
description: A ready-to-give breakfast set for slow mornings, packed with a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a small ceramic brew filter, and a sleeve of six butter-and-orange tea biscuits. The coffee has a mellow chocolate and dried-fruit profile that works well in a pour-over or drip machine. The ceramic filter fits over a standard mug, and the biscuits arrive sealed for freshness. Items are arranged in a recyclable kraft box with paper cushioning and a simple gift card.

title: Crisp & Cozy: Baking with Tea and Coffee
description: This 176-page hardcover cookbook explores home baking with brewed tea, ground coffee, and pantry-friendly flavor pairings. Recipes include black tea ginger loaf, coffee-cardamom morning buns, and a simple tea-steeped custard, with clear instructions and measurements for everyday kitchens. A short opening guide covers how to brew concentrated tea and coffee for batters and fillings. The book measures 8 by 10 inches and lies open easily on a counter while you work.

title: Stonefruit Rooibos and Vanilla Tea
description: South African rooibos is blended with dried peach, apple, and a touch of vanilla for a naturally caffeine-free cup with a rounded, mellow finish. The loose blend comes in a 90-gram tin, providing roughly 35 servings at one teaspoon per cup. Steep in freshly boiled water for five minutes, then enjoy it plain or with a splash of milk. The blend is equally pleasant chilled after brewing, making it a useful option for warm afternoons.

title: Enamel Camp Cup with Folding Handle
description: Lightweight and easy to pack, this enamel-coated steel cup has a folding wire handle that saves space in a picnic basket or camping kit. It holds 12 ounces and is suitable for serving coffee, tea, or soup. The smooth enamel interior rinses clean after use, while the dark rim gives the cup a classic camp-kitchen look. Use it for serving and reheating over a camp stove; avoid microwaves, and let it cool before folding the handle for storage.

title: Red Canyon Colombia Huila Coffee
description: This medium-roast whole bean coffee comes from small farms in Colombia’s Huila region. Expect a rounded cup with notes of panela, red apple, and cocoa, suited to drip brewers, French presses, and espresso. Beans are roasted in small batches and packed in a resealable 12-ounce bag with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing and adjust the dose to suit your preferred method. Choose a 12-ounce or 2-pound bag for home brewing or a well-stocked coffee shelf.

title: Lapsang Souchong Pine-Smoked Black Tea
description: Bold black tea leaves are gently smoke-dried over pinewood for a savory cup with a clean, woodsy aroma. This loose-leaf blend works well on its own or alongside a hearty breakfast, and it can also add depth to a tea-based marinade. Each tin contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for approximately 35 cups depending on your measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for three to four minutes, then strain. Store the sealed tin away from heat and moisture.

title: Glass and Brass Cold Brew Tower
description: Make slow-dripped coffee at home with this countertop cold brew tower, featuring a borosilicate glass water vessel, stainless steel valve, and brushed brass-finish fittings. The adjustable drip control lets you set a steady flow over medium-coarse grounds in the included glass carafe. Its 1-liter capacity yields several servings of concentrate, depending on your recipe. A removable stainless filter is included for easy rinsing after use. The tower stands approximately 18 inches tall and is designed for hand washing.

title: Cobalt Rim Porcelain Flat White Cups
description: These compact porcelain cups are sized for flat whites, cortados, and small tea servings. Each cup holds 6 ounces and has a gently rounded interior that makes pouring milk easier, while the cobalt-blue rim adds a crisp accent to the white glaze. The set includes two cups made from durable glazed porcelain. They are comfortable to hold and stack neatly in a cupboard between uses. Suitable for microwave and dishwasher use; avoid sudden temperature changes to protect the ceramic.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Bread Oven
description: Bake crusty round loaves in this enameled cast iron bread oven, which traps steam during the first stage of baking for a crisp, browned crust. The 5-quart pot has a domed lid, sturdy side handles, and a smooth cream interior that releases baked-on residue with a soak. It measures approximately 10 inches across and works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops as well as in the oven. Preheat gradually, use oven mitts, and hand wash to keep the enamel looking its best.

title: Beechwood Coffee Tamper and Leveler
description: Prepare an even espresso puck with this two-sided tool, featuring a flat stainless steel tamper base on one end and a three-fin coffee leveler on the other. The turned beechwood handle offers a warm, comfortable grip and is finished with food-safe oil. The base measures 58 millimeters across, suitable for many standard espresso portafilters; check your basket diameter before ordering. Use the leveler to distribute grounds, then tamp firmly and evenly. Wipe the metal clean and hand wash the wooden handle.

title: Maple Cardamom Coffee Cake Mix
description: Bring a warmly spiced coffee cake to the table with this dry mix of flour, brown sugar, ground cardamom, and maple sugar. Add butter, eggs, and milk, then bake in an 8-inch round pan for a tender crumb with a fragrant, lightly sweet finish. The 16-ounce pouch includes a separate cinnamon-maple streusel packet and makes one cake, typically serving eight. Keep the unopened mix in a cool, dry cupboard. Contains wheat; prepare according to the printed directions on the package.

title: The At-Home Coffee Tasting Box
description: Explore three brewing profiles with this coffee tasting set, packed in a recyclable kraft box for easy gifting. It includes three 4-ounce bags of whole bean coffee: a bright washed lot, a balanced medium roast, and a deeper, chocolate-forward blend. A printed tasting card offers suggested brew ratios and space to note aroma and flavor impressions. The coffees are roasted in small batches and sealed in freshness bags. Ideal for sharing a guided tasting or sampling different styles before choosing a larger bag.

title: Weeknight Noodles, Broths & Bowls
description: This practical cookbook brings together 75 recipes for quick noodle suppers, layered broths, and satisfying grain bowls. Chapters cover pantry-friendly sauces, vegetable toppings, and make-ahead components, with clear timing notes for busy evenings. The hardcover edition includes 192 pages, full-color food photography, and a lay-flat binding for easier use at the counter. Recipes draw on ingredients such as miso, toasted sesame, fresh herbs, and seasonal vegetables, with serving suggestions to help turn a simple bowl into a complete meal.

title: Peach Oolong Tea Concentrate
description: This ready-to-dilute tea concentrate combines oolong tea with peach juice and a touch of cane sugar for a smooth, fruity drink. Mix one part concentrate with three parts cold water or sparkling water, or warm it gently for a fragrant tea served hot. The 16-ounce glass bottle makes about eight servings and should be refrigerated after opening. Shake before pouring to redistribute the natural fruit sediment. Serve over ice with a slice of peach or enjoy it plain as an easy afternoon drink.

title: Stackable Stoneware Coffee Canister
description: Keep coffee beans close at hand in this glazed stoneware canister, finished with a snug silicone-sealed lid to help limit exposure to air and kitchen moisture. It holds approximately 1 pound of whole beans and measures about 7 inches tall, with a wide opening for easy filling and scooping.
