The matte charcoal glaze and simple cylindrical shape fit neatly on a shelf or counter. Hand wash the vessel and lid separately, and let the canister dry fully before refilling to protect the beans’ aroma.

title: Rainshadow Peru Cajamarca Medium Roast
description: This medium-roast coffee comes from smallholder farms in Peru’s Cajamarca region, where high-grown lots develop a rounded, sweet cup. Expect notes of milk chocolate, red apple, and toasted pecan, with a smooth finish that works well black or with milk. The whole beans are packed in a resealable 12-ounce bag to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for drip, French press, or espresso, and adjust the grind to suit your method.

title: Osmanthus Apricot White Tea
description: Delicate white tea leaves are blended with dried apricot pieces and fragrant osmanthus blossoms for a gently floral infusion with a soft stone-fruit sweetness. The loose-leaf blend comes in a 2.5-ounce tin, enough for approximately 25 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for three to four minutes. Enjoy it on its own in the afternoon, or serve chilled with a slice of fresh apricot.

title: Insulated Ceramic-Burr Coffee Grinder
description: Prepare freshly ground coffee at home or on the road with this compact manual grinder. Its ceramic burrs offer adjustable settings for French press, pour-over, and finer brews, while the stainless steel body and textured grip make turning the handle comfortable. The grounds container holds enough for one or two cups, and the handle detaches for storage. Rinse the removable parts after use and allow them to dry fully before reassembling.

title: Indigo Brushstroke Porcelain Tea Bowl
description: A wide, gently curved porcelain bowl with hand-painted indigo brushstrokes, made for whisked tea and other small warm drinks. Its 14-ounce capacity leaves room for whisking without splashing, and the smooth glazed interior rinses clean after use. Each bowl has slight variations in the brush pattern, giving every piece its own character. Use it for matcha, broth, or a small serving of dessert; hand-washing is recommended to preserve the decoration.

title: Hard-Anodized Aluminum Milk Pan
description: This compact 1.5-quart milk pan is sized for warming milk, melting butter, and heating small portions of sauce. The hard-anodized aluminum body distributes heat evenly, while a nonstick interior helps prevent scorching and makes cleanup straightforward. A stay-cool handle offers a secure grip, and a pointed pouring lip helps guide liquids into a cup or bowl. Suitable for gas and electric stovetops; use low to medium heat and nonmetal utensils.

title: Beechwood Dough Whisk
description: Stir bread dough, muffin batter, and pancake mix with this simple whisk built around a solid beechwood handle and sturdy stainless steel loops. The open spiral design cuts through thick mixtures without collecting as much dough as a balloon whisk. Its 12-inch length gives comfortable reach into mixing bowls, while a hanging loop makes it easy to store within reach. Hand-wash promptly and dry thoroughly to keep the wood handle in good condition.

title: Maple Sugar Chai Granola
description: Oven-toasted rolled oats, pumpkin seeds, and almonds are seasoned with warming chai spices and lightly sweetened with maple syrup. This crunchy granola is made in small batches and packed in a 12-ounce resealable pouch. Spoon it over yogurt, pour on milk, or add a handful to a bowl of sliced fruit. The blend contains almonds and is made in a kitchen that also handles other tree nuts, so check the ingredient details if you have a food allergy.

title: The Coffee Break Biscuit and Brew Box
description: A ready-to-give pairing for an easy coffee break, featuring a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee and a box of buttery oat biscuits. The coffee has a balanced profile suited to drip or French press, while the biscuits bring a lightly toasted, not-too-sweet crunch. Items arrive nestled in a recyclable kraft gift box with a printed brewing card. Choose whole beans or have the coffee ground for your preferred brewing method when ordering.

title: The Small Batch Jam Kitchen
description: This approachable cookbook explores small-batch preserves for home kitchens, with recipes for seasonal fruit jams, savory relishes, and refrigerator pickles. Clear instructions cover choosing fruit, preparing jars, balancing sweetness, and storing each batch safely. The book includes 80 recipes with metric and US measurements, plus ideas for serving preserves alongside breakfast, cheese, and simple weeknight meals. A compact softcover format makes it easy to keep open on the counter while you cook.

title: Ribbed Borosilicate Tea Infuser Bottle
description: Steep loose-leaf tea at home or on the go in this 16-ounce borosilicate glass bottle. A removable stainless steel infuser basket holds tea leaves securely while allowing room for water to circulate, and the ribbed silicone sleeve provides a comfortable grip. The screw-on lid helps prevent spills during short trips, though the bottle is not intended for vigorous shaking. Remove the infuser to enjoy the tea directly from the glass; hand-wash the lid and sleeve.

title: Canvas Market Tote with Bottle Sleeves
description: Carry groceries, market finds, or picnic supplies in this sturdy cotton-canvas tote with a wide base and reinforced shoulder straps. Two interior sleeves help keep a water bottle or jar upright, while the open main compartment fits produce, a loaf of bread, and pantry staples. The bag measures 15 by 14 inches with a 5-inch gusset and folds flat for storage. Spot-clean with mild soap and air-dry to help maintain its shape.

title: Cindercone Sumatra Mandheling Coffee
description: This full-bodied single-origin coffee is roasted to bring out notes of baker’s chocolate, cedar, and ripe plum, with a mellow finish suited to milk or a straightforward black cup. The beans are sourced from smallholder farms in North Sumatra and roasted in small batches. Choose a 12-ounce or 2-pound bag, sealed in a resealable valve pouch to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for French press, drip, or espresso.

title: Linden Blossom and Lemon Balm Loose Leaf Tea
description: A gentle, caffeine-free herbal infusion blending fragrant linden blossoms with lemon balm, dried apple, and a little lemongrass. The cup is soft and floral, with a fresh citrus finish that works well after dinner or as an afternoon pause. Each tin contains 2.5 ounces of loose tea, enough for about 30 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes.

title: Walnut Base Ceramic Pour-Over Stand
description: A compact pour-over stand pairs a glazed stoneware dripper cradle with a solid walnut base, keeping your brew steady while leaving room beneath for a mug or small server. The opening fits most cone-style drippers, and the base has a recessed channel to catch stray drops. Set it over a cup, add a paper filter and ground coffee, then pour slowly in circles. The stand measures 7 inches tall and wipes clean with a damp cloth.

title: Speckled Celadon Tea Bowl with Pouring Lip
description: Hand-finished stoneware gives this small tea bowl a softly speckled celadon glaze, a comfortable rounded shape, and a subtle pouring lip for sharing tea without drips. It holds 10 ounces, making it useful for loose-leaf infusions, matcha, or a small milky tea. The bowl is made for everyday use and is safe for the dishwasher and microwave. Slight variations in glaze and surface texture are part of its kiln-fired character.

title: Hammered Stainless Steel Dutch Oven
description: Built for soups, beans, braises, and generous batches of pasta, this stainless steel Dutch oven has a hammered exterior, a thick encapsulated base, and a fitted steel lid. Its 5.5-quart capacity suits family meals without taking over the stovetop. Two broad loop handles make it easier to lift with oven mitts, and the pan works on gas, electric, and induction ranges. Handwashing helps maintain the finish, though the pot is also dishwasher safe.

title: Beechwood Tea Bag Squeezer Tongs
description: These small beechwood tongs are shaped to lift and gently press a used tea bag over the cup, keeping fingers away from hot water and drips off the counter. The smooth hinged arms are joined with a simple stainless steel pin and have rounded tips that grip standard tea bags without tearing them. At 5 inches long, they fit easily in a utensil drawer or tea caddy. Wipe clean after use and dry promptly; do not soak.

title: Salted Maple Espresso Brittle
description: Thin shards of crisp brittle combine toasted almonds, maple sugar, and a restrained pinch of flaky sea salt, with finely ground espresso folded through the candy for a roasted aroma. Packed in a 5-ounce paper-lined tin, it is ready to serve alongside coffee or break into pieces over vanilla ice cream. The brittle is made in small batches and contains almonds. Store the tin in a cool, dry cupboard and close it firmly between servings.

title: Coffee and Biscotti Pantry Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give pairing for a quiet coffee break, this box includes a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast Brazil coffee and a 6-ounce pouch of almond-anise biscotti from a neighborhood bakery. The coffee has cocoa and toasted hazelnut notes and suits drip or French press brewing. Biscotti are packed separately to stay crisp, while the coffee arrives whole bean for freshness. A kraft presentation box with paper cushioning makes the set easy to send or bring to a host.

title: The Tea-Infused Table: Simple Seasonal Cooking
description: This hardcover cookbook explores practical ways to use tea in everyday cooking, from green tea rice and smoky black-tea lentils to citrus-steeped cakes and herb-forward broths. The recipes are organized by season and include clear steeping guidance, ingredient notes, and suggestions for pairing each dish with a cup of tea. At 192 pages, it is designed for home cooks who want approachable ideas rather than specialized equipment. Includes a ribbon marker and a recipe index.

title: Cone Filter Paper Refills, 100 Pack
description: A practical refill for daily pour-over brewing, this pack contains 100 unbleached paper filters sized for standard cone drippers. The ridged sides help the filter sit securely in place, while the paper catches fine grounds and oils for a clean-tasting cup. Rinse the filter with hot water before adding coffee to reduce paper flavor and warm your brewer. The filters arrive in a plain recyclable paper sleeve—useful to keep on the shelf, though not much of a present.

title: Sunroom Kenya Kirinyaga AA Coffee
description: Bright and lively, this single-origin coffee comes from the Kirinyaga region of Kenya and is roasted in small batches for a clean, expressive cup. Expect notes of red currant, grapefruit, and panela, with a crisp finish that works especially well as a pour-over. The beans are whole and suitable for home grinding; use a medium grind for filter brewing or a finer setting for espresso. Choose a 12-ounce bag for a fresh supply or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf.

title: Smoky Maple Hojicha Loose Tea
description: This roasted Japanese green tea has a mellow, toasty character with gentle notes of wood smoke and maple. The loose leaves are blended with a small amount of dried maple sugar for a rounded finish without overpowering the tea. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for about two minutes, then enjoy plain or with a splash of milk. Available in a 2-ounce pouch for occasional cups or a 4-ounce pouch for regular brewing.

title: Stainless Steel Espresso Scale with Timer
description: Dial in espresso and pour-over recipes with a compact digital scale designed for everyday brewing. Its stainless steel weighing platform wipes clean easily, while the built-in timer helps track shot times and bloom intervals. The scale reads in 0.1-gram increments and supports up to 2 kilograms, with a rechargeable battery and a simple touch-button interface. Set a portafilter or dripper directly on the platform, then use the timer to keep each brew consistent. A protective silicone mat is included.

title: Indigo Speckle Porcelain Cappuccino Cups
description: A pair of sturdy porcelain cups made for cappuccino, flat white, or a small afternoon tea. Each cup holds 7 ounces and has a gently rounded profile that sits comfortably in the hand; the reactive indigo speckle glaze gives every piece a slightly different pattern. The cups are finished with a smooth, unglazed foot and are suitable for the microwave and dishwasher. Their compact shape fits beneath most home espresso machines and pairs neatly with a small serving plate.

title: Enameled Roasting Pan with Rack
description: Roast vegetables, chicken, or a Sunday joint in this sturdy carbon-steel pan with a smooth porcelain enamel finish. The removable stainless steel rack lifts food above drippings for more even browning and makes it easy to collect juices for gravy. Measuring 16 by 12 inches, the pan fits most standard ovens and has broad handles for a secure grip with oven mitts. Use it for roasting, baking, or carrying a finished dish to the table; hand washing helps preserve the enamel surface.

title: Olivewood Coffee and Tea Measuring Spoon
description: Measure loose tea, ground coffee, or pantry spices with this hand-finished olivewood spoon. Its shallow bowl holds approximately one tablespoon, making it a practical scoop for filling a teapot or adding grounds to a home brewer. The naturally varied grain gives each spoon its own warm pattern, and a short, rounded handle is easy to store in a jar or utensil crock. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry promptly; occasional food-safe mineral oil helps maintain the wood.

title: Orange Blossom Pistachio Halva
description: A tender, crumbly sesame confection made with tahini, roasted pistachios, and a delicate hint of orange blossom. This small-batch halva is cut into bite-sized pieces and packed in a 7-ounce recyclable carton, ready to serve alongside strong coffee or a cup of black tea. Its sweet, nutty flavor also works well crumbled over yogurt or warm fruit. Store sealed in a cool, dry cupboard and allow the halva to come to room temperature before serving for its softest texture.

title: Coffeehouse Pantry Discovery Gift Crate
description: A ready-to-give assortment for a relaxed coffee break, packed in a reusable kraft crate with paper cushioning. Inside are a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a jar of salted honey, and a box of crisp oat biscuits made for dunking. The coffee has a balanced cocoa-and-hazelnut profile and suits drip brewers or French presses. Include the crate as a host gift or open it for an easy weekend treat; a printed card with simple brewing and serving suggestions is tucked inside.

title: The Practical Pour-Over: Coffee at Home
description: A hands-on guide to making better filter coffee with the gear already on your kitchen counter. This 176-page paperback covers grind size, water temperature, brewing ratios, and clear step-by-step methods for cone and flat-bottom drippers. Recipes include classic single-cup brews, iced coffee, and simple milk drinks, with troubleshooting notes for common issues like a slow drawdown or a bitter finish. Compact enough to keep near the grinder, it is designed for curious beginners and home brewers who want repeatable results.

title: Ribbed Brass Tea Infuser Basket
description: Brew a full mug of loose-leaf tea with this fine-mesh stainless steel basket, finished with a warm-toned brass handle and lid. The wide basket gives leaves room to unfurl, while the close mesh keeps small tea particles out of the cup. It fits most standard mugs and small teapots with an opening at least 2.5 inches across. Lift the basket by its cool-touch handle after steeping, then rest it on the included lid to catch drips. Rinse and dry between uses.

title: Cocoa Husk and Fig Brazil Cerrado Coffee
description: Brazil Cerrado beans bring a rounded, low-acidity cup with notes of cocoa husk, dried fig, and toasted pecan. Grown at high elevation and roasted in small batches to a medium profile, they work well in drip brewers, French presses, and espresso machines. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Beans are packed whole in a resealable bag with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness.

title: Lemon Verbena and Cucumber Green Tea
description: This loose-leaf green tea blends gently steamed Chinese green tea with dried lemon verbena and cucumber pieces for a clean, garden-fresh infusion. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for two to three minutes, then enjoy hot or pour over ice. The 2-ounce pouch makes approximately 25 cups; the 4-ounce pouch is suited to regular tea drinkers. Store sealed in a cool, dry cupboard away from strong aromas.

title: Hand-Crank Ceramic Burr Coffee Mill
description: Grind fresh coffee at home or on the road with a compact hand mill featuring adjustable ceramic burrs and a brushed stainless steel body. Turn the top dial to choose a fine setting for espresso or a coarser grind for French press. The clear grounds chamber holds enough for roughly two cups, and the removable handle makes the mill easy to pack. Includes a cleaning brush and protective drawstring pouch; hand wash the body and keep the burrs dry.

title: Speckled Stoneware Espresso Tasting Set
description: Serve small coffees in this pair of wheel-finished stoneware cups, each with a warm ivory glaze and fine charcoal speckles. The rounded shape holds about 3.5 ounces, making the cups a natural fit for espresso, cortados, or a small tea tasting. A lightly textured foot keeps them steady on a saucer or counter. Each cup is glazed by hand, so speckle placement and subtle color variations will differ. Dishwasher safe; avoid sudden temperature changes.

title: Oval Enameled Braising Pan with Lid
description: This oval enameled cast iron pan is made for slow braises, baked beans, and stovetop-to-oven meals. Its tight-fitting lid helps retain moisture, while the smooth cream-colored interior makes it easy to monitor browning and clean after cooking. The 4-quart pan measures 12 inches across and has broad side handles for lifting with oven mitts. Suitable for gas, electric, and induction cooktops, as well as ovens up to 500°F. Hand washing is recommended.

title: Stainless Steel Bench Scraper with Walnut Grip
description: Move chopped vegetables, portion dough, or clean flour from a work surface with this sturdy stainless steel bench scraper. The straight blade measures 6 inches wide and has a softly rounded edge where it meets the handle. A sealed walnut grip offers a comfortable hold, while etched half-inch markings along the blade help divide dough evenly. Wipe the handle clean after use and hand wash the scraper to protect the wood. A practical tool for baking and everyday prep.

title: Pomegranate Molasses and Date Syrup
description: Two concentrated pantry syrups bring sweet-tart depth to dressings, marinades, and desserts. The pomegranate molasses is slowly reduced for a tangy finish, while the date syrup offers a mellow caramel flavor with no added flavorings. Each set includes one 7-ounce glass bottle of each syrup, fitted with a screw cap for easy pouring. Stir pomegranate molasses into vinaigrette or drizzle date syrup over yogurt, porridge, and roasted vegetables. Refrigerate after opening for best quality.

title: The Fireside Coffee and Biscuit Gift Crate
description: A cozy pairing for coffee breaks, this gift crate includes a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a tin of butter shortbread biscuits, and a small jar of orange marmalade. The coffee’s notes of toasted almond and brown sugar complement the crisp biscuits and bright citrus spread. Items arrive nestled in a reusable kraft gift box with paper fill and a simple card for a handwritten message. Please select whole bean or ground coffee when ordering; the other contents remain the same.

title: The Home Baker’s Guide to Tea Cakes
description: This 176-page hardcover cookbook offers a collection of tea cakes, loaf cakes, and simple bakes designed for afternoon tea or a kitchen-counter treat. Recipes include citrus yogurt cake, toasted sesame shortbread, and a spiced pear loaf, with clear ingredient lists and step-by-step instructions. A short opening section covers pantry setup, pan sizes, and basic mixing methods for newer bakers. Full-color photographs accompany selected recipes, and a ribbon marker helps keep your place while baking.

title: Minted Pea and Fennel Seed Crackers
description: Thin-baked savory crackers combine dried mint, cracked fennel seed, and green pea flour for a crisp, gently aromatic bite. Serve them alongside soft cheese, hummus, or a cup of strong black tea. Each 5-ounce recyclable pouch contains a small-batch bake with no artificial colors or flavors. The crackers are made with wheat flour and are not gluten-free. Reseal the pouch between servings, or transfer leftovers to an airtight tin to maintain their crunch.

title: Adjustable Stainless Steel Tea Brewing Basket
description: Give loose-leaf tea room to open with a fine-mesh stainless steel basket that fits a range of mugs and small teapots. Sliding arms adjust from 2.5 to 4.5 inches across, while the deep basket holds enough leaves for a generous single serving. A fitted lid helps retain heat during steeping and doubles as a drip tray when brewing is complete. The basket, lid, and arms detach for rinsing and are dishwasher safe. Designed for everyday use with fine or whole-leaf teas.

title: Blue Hour Guatemala Huehuetenango Coffee
description: This medium-roast whole bean coffee comes from small farms in Guatemala’s Huehuetenango region. Expect a rounded cup with notes of red apple, cocoa, and toasted pecan, suited to both filter brewing and espresso. The 12-ounce bag has a one-way valve and resealable closure to help preserve freshness after opening. Grind just before brewing, and adjust the grind size to match your method. Beans are roasted in small batches and packed without added flavoring.

title: Wild Mint and Lemon Verbena Herbal Tea
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf infusion made with dried peppermint, lemon verbena, and a little lemongrass. The bright, cooling aroma makes it a refreshing after-dinner cup or an easy base for iced tea. Each 2.5-ounce tin contains enough tea for approximately 25 cups, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes, then strain. Store the tin in a cool, dry cupboard.

title: Compact Stainless Steel Gooseneck Kettle
description: A stovetop kettle with a narrow gooseneck spout for controlled pouring over coffee grounds or tea leaves. Its brushed stainless steel body holds 0.8 liters, while a heat-resistant handle provides a steady grip during slow pours. The kettle works on gas, electric, and ceramic cooktops; it is not intended for induction. Use it to wet coffee beds evenly or fill a teapot without splashing. Hand wash and dry after use to keep the finish looking its best.

title: Sage Green Double-Wall Glass Cups
description: These double-wall borosilicate glass cups keep hands comfortable while serving hot coffee, tea, or a small dessert. Each cup holds 8 ounces and has a subtle sage tint that adds color without obscuring the drink. The set includes two cups, each lightweight and shaped with a gently rounded rim. They are suitable for hot and cold beverages; avoid sudden temperature changes and wash by hand. A useful choice for a shared morning coffee or a relaxed tea break.

title: Lidded Stoneware Casserole with Roasting Rack
description: This glazed stoneware casserole is designed for oven-baked vegetables, covered braises, and small roasts. The 3.5-quart dish includes a fitted lid and removable stoneware rack that lifts food above cooking juices. Its cream glaze with a charcoal rim suits both oven-to-table serving and everyday kitchen use. The casserole measures approximately 13 inches across, including handles. Use in a conventional oven up to 450°F, and allow it to cool before washing to avoid thermal shock.

title: Acacia Wood Citrus Reamer
description: A simple hand reamer for extracting juice from lemons, limes, and small oranges. Turn the ridged acacia wood head into a halved fruit over a bowl or measuring cup to catch the juice and loosen the pulp. The tool measures 6 inches long and has a smooth, rounded handle that rests comfortably in the palm. Hand wash promptly and dry thoroughly; occasional food-safe mineral oil helps maintain the wood. A compact addition to a kitchen drawer or bar setup.

title: Rosemary Sea Salt Shortbread
description: Buttery shortbread rounds are lightly seasoned with dried rosemary and flaky sea salt for a savory edge. The cookies are baked with wheat flour, cultured butter, sugar, and rosemary, then packed in a 6-ounce paperboard box to help protect their crisp texture. Serve alongside black tea, espresso, or a cheese board, or crumble over fruit and cream. Contains wheat and dairy; made in a kitchen that also handles nuts. Keep sealed in a cool, dry place and enjoy within two weeks of opening.

title: Slow Morning Coffee and Breakfast Gift Box
description: A breakfast-ready assortment featuring a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a small jar of wildflower honey, and a pack of oat-and-sesame breakfast biscuits. The coffee offers an approachable daily cup, while the honey and biscuits make an easy pairing for a quiet morning. Items are packed in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a simple ingredient card. Coffee is whole bean; biscuits contain wheat and sesame. A thoughtful housewarming or weekend host gift.

title: The Seasonal Soup Pot: Recipes for Every Month
description: This 224-page hardcover cookbook gathers practical soup recipes organized around the changing seasons, from spring pea broth to winter bean and root vegetable stews. Each recipe includes ingredient quantities, clear cooking steps, and suggestions for adapting toppings or using pantry staples. Full-color photographs and a short guide to stocks and soup-making basics make it useful for both newer cooks and confident home chefs. The book measures 8 by 10 inches and fits comfortably on a kitchen shelf or counter.

title: Adjustable Ceramic Burr Hand Grinder
description: A manual coffee grinder with ceramic burrs and adjustable settings for coarse French press grounds through finer espresso-style grinds. The clear catch jar holds about 30 grams of ground coffee, while the detachable crank stores neatly for travel or compact cupboard storage. A nonslip silicone base helps keep the grinder steady on the counter. Brush out the burrs after use and avoid rinsing the grinding mechanism. Its hand-powered design is a practical option for small kitchens and coffee made away from an outlet.

title: North Pier Ethiopia Sidama Natural Coffee
description: This light-roast coffee comes from smallholder lots in Ethiopia’s Sidama region, where natural processing brings forward notes of blueberry, bergamot, and cocoa. The beans are roasted in small batches and packed whole for grinding just before brewing. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday pour-over or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. It works especially well with paper filters and medium-fine grind settings.

title: Roasted Buckwheat and Pear Tea
description: A gently toasted, caffeine-free loose-leaf blend pairing roasted buckwheat with dried pear, apple pieces, and a little cinnamon. The nutty aroma makes it a comforting after-dinner cup, while the fruit keeps the flavor mellow rather than sweet. Each resealable pouch contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for about 25 cups. Steep one heaping teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five minutes, then strain and serve plain or with milk.

title: Stainless Steel Descaling Solution
description: Keep mineral buildup from slowing down your kettle or coffee brewer with this concentrated descaling solution. The citric-acid-based formula is supplied in two 8-ounce bottles and can be diluted according to the appliance instructions before use. It is suitable for many stainless steel and glass brewing appliances; check your manufacturer’s care guidance before treating coated or specialty surfaces. Use periodically in hard-water areas, rinse the appliance thoroughly, and store the bottles upright between cleaning sessions.

title: Fluted Terracotta Tea Cup Pair
description: These two small stoneware cups have a warm terracotta glaze, softly fluted sides, and a comfortable unglazed foot. Each cup holds 7 ounces, making the pair a natural fit for green tea, espresso, or a small afternoon coffee. The sturdy ceramic walls retain warmth without feeling heavy in the hand. Made for everyday use, they are dishwasher safe; allow the cups to cool before rinsing with cold water.

title: Hammered Carbon Steel Wok with Beech Handle
description: A 14-inch carbon steel wok with a hammered bowl and a long beechwood handle, designed for quick stir-fries, fried rice, and searing vegetables over high heat. The flat base sits securely on most home gas and electric ranges, while the lightweight body is easy to lift and toss. It arrives with a protective wax coating that should be washed off before seasoning. Hand wash, dry promptly, and maintain the cooking surface with a thin layer of oil.

title: Olivewood Lemon Zester and Channel Knife
description: A compact hand tool for removing fine citrus zest or cutting narrow decorative strips of peel. The stainless steel head combines a row of small zesting teeth with a channel knife, while the smooth olivewood handle offers a secure grip. At 6.5 inches long, it fits easily in a utensil drawer and is useful for finishing tea cakes, vinaigrettes, cocktails, and marinades. Rinse by hand after use and dry the wooden handle thoroughly.

title: Black Sesame Honey Crunch
description: Thin, crisp clusters of toasted black sesame seeds bound with wildflower honey and a pinch of flaky salt. The 5-ounce pouch makes an easy snack alongside a cup of tea, and the crunchy pieces can also be scattered over yogurt or vanilla ice cream. Made in small batches, the brittle has a deep, nutty flavor with a clean honey finish. Keep the pouch sealed in a cool, dry cupboard to preserve its snap.

title: The Tea Table Citrus and Shortbread Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give tea break set with a 2-ounce pouch of orange peel and ginger black tea, a tin of lemon shortbread cookies, and a stainless steel single-cup infuser. The tea brews into a bright, warming cup that pairs well with the buttery biscuits. Items are packed in a reusable kraft box with paper cushioning and a simple contents card. Makes a thoughtful host gift for tea drinkers, or an easy way to stock an office snack shelf.

title: Replacement Glass Carafe Lid for Drip Brewers
description: A practical replacement lid for compatible 10- to 12-cup glass drip coffee carafes. Molded from heat-resistant black silicone, it sits over the carafe opening to help retain warmth and reduce splashes when pouring. The flexible rim lifts off for cleaning and fits carafes with an opening diameter between 3.1 and 3.3 inches; measure your existing carafe before ordering. Wash by hand with warm, soapy water and let it dry completely before use.

title: Everyday Tea: Blends, Brews, and Small Rituals
description: A practical 192-page guide to making tea part of everyday meals, with clear brewing instructions, seasonal iced tea recipes, and ideas for cooking with loose leaves and pantry spices. Chapters cover black, green, white, and herbal teas, with recipes ranging from tea-poached pears to a savory hojicha rice bowl. The hardcover format includes a ribbon marker and a compact reference chart for water temperature and steeping time. A useful addition to a home cook’s kitchen shelf.

title: Juniper Ridge Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey Process Coffee
description: This medium-light roast is made from 100% Costa Rican arabica grown in the Tarrazú region and processed using the honey method. Expect notes of red apple, panela, and toasted almond, with a rounded body that works well as a pour-over or in a drip brewer. Beans are roasted in small batches and packed whole in a resealable 12-ounce bag with a one-way freshness valve. Grind just before brewing for the clearest sweetness.

title: Pear Blossom Sencha Green Tea
description: Japanese sencha leaves are blended with dried pear pieces and delicate pear blossom for a fresh cup with gentle fruit sweetness. The loose-leaf tea comes in a 2.5-ounce resealable tin, enough for about 35 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for two minutes to keep the green tea bright and smooth. Enjoy it hot in the afternoon or chilled over ice with a slice of pear.

title: Variable-Temperature Stainless Gooseneck Kettle
description: A precise electric kettle for pour-over coffee and loose-leaf tea, with a narrow gooseneck spout for controlled pouring. The stainless steel body holds 0.9 liters, while the digital base adjusts temperature from 104°F to 212°F in one-degree increments. A hold function maintains your selection for up to an hour, and the integrated display shows the current water temperature. Use the removable kettle on its cordless base; the base includes a standard US power cord.

title: Hand-Thrown Ochre Stoneware Latte Mug
description: This generously sized stoneware mug is wheel-thrown and finished in a warm ochre glaze with subtle variations from firing. Its 14-ounce capacity leaves room for a latte, tea, or a long black, and the rounded handle offers a comfortable grip. The mug measures approximately 4 inches tall and is made for everyday use; it is dishwasher- and microwave-safe. Each piece is finished by hand, so glaze patterns and small surface details vary slightly from mug to mug.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Skillet, 10-Inch
description: A sturdy 10-inch cast iron skillet with a smooth enamel coating for browning vegetables, searing chicken, or baking cornbread. The light interior makes it easy to monitor browning, while the dark exterior resists everyday kitchen wear. It holds heat steadily and can move from stovetop to oven up to 500°F. The skillet measures about 10 inches across and includes two short handles for lifting with oven mitts. Hand-wash and dry thoroughly before storing.

title: Stainless Steel Microplane Spice Grater
description: A fine-tooth stainless steel grater designed for fresh nutmeg, cinnamon, citrus zest, and hard cheeses. Its 8-inch grating surface sits in a slim frame with a non-slip handle, and a protective cover keeps the teeth from snagging in a drawer. Use a light stroke to grate directly over a cup of tea or a mixing bowl, then rinse the blade promptly after use. The grater is dishwasher-safe, though hand-washing helps preserve its edge over time.

title: Dark Chocolate Espresso Almonds
description: Whole roasted almonds are coated in dark chocolate and dusted with finely ground espresso for a crisp, bittersweet snack. Made in small batches with cocoa, coffee, almonds, and a touch of cane sugar, they pair naturally with a morning cappuccino or an after-dinner cup of tea. Each 6-ounce pouch has a resealable closure to keep the almonds fresh between servings. Contains almonds and may be made in a facility that handles other tree nuts and dairy.

title: The Coffee & Tea Tasting Flight Gift Set
description: A guided tasting set for exploring two ways to start the day: coffee and tea. The box includes two 4-ounce bags of whole-bean coffee, a 1-ounce tin of fragrant loose-leaf black tea, and a printed tasting card with brewing suggestions and space for notes. Choose a grinder setting and brew each coffee separately to compare aroma and body, then steep the tea to your preferred strength. Packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with crinkle paper; a mug is not included.

title: Everyday Sourdough: A Home Baker’s Notebook
description: A practical guide to maintaining a sourdough starter and baking dependable loaves in a home kitchen. The 176-page paperback covers feeding schedules, dough handling, proofing, and shaping, with step-by-step recipes for country bread, seeded rolls, and crisp crackers. Clear measurements are provided in both grams and cups, alongside notes for adjusting fermentation to room temperature. Use the troubleshooting pages to identify common issues such as dense crumb or over-proofed dough. Printed on uncoated paper for easy note-taking.

title: Double-Wall Glass Tea Cups, Set of Two
description: A pair of clear, double-wall borosilicate glass cups that keep tea warm while the outer wall stays comfortable to hold. Each cup holds 8 ounces and has a gently rounded shape suited to green tea, espresso, or a small latte. The layered glass creates a floating effect for colorful infusions without adding extra weight. Made from heat-resistant glass, the cups are suitable for hot and cold drinks. Hand-wash to protect the delicate rim and avoid sudden temperature changes.

title: Manual Burr Coffee Grinder with Oak Handle
description: This compact hand grinder uses stainless steel conical burrs to produce consistent grounds for pour-over, French press, and travel brewing. A numbered adjustment collar offers multiple grind settings, while the oak crank handle folds down for storage. The grounds chamber holds approximately 25 grams, enough for one generous cup or two smaller brews. Disassemble the burr set for occasional brushing, and keep the grinder dry between uses. Its slim body fits easily into a kitchen drawer or weekend travel bag.

title: Night Ferry Colombia Huila Decaf Coffee
description: This water-processed decaf brings a gentle sweetness to evening coffee without sacrificing a full, rounded cup. Beans from Huila, Colombia, are roasted to a medium profile with notes of cocoa, toasted almond, and dried orange. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a two-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Grind just before brewing for French press, drip, or espresso, and store the beans sealed away from heat and light.

title: Rose Garden Black Tea with Rose Petals
description: A fragrant loose-leaf black tea blended with dried rose petals for a floral, softly sweet cup. The brisk tea base brews well on its own or with a splash of milk, and its rounded character also pairs nicely with a little honey. Each tin contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for roughly 35 cups depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per cup in freshly boiled water for three to four minutes.

title: Copper-Core Pour-Over Coffee Brewer
description: This stainless steel pour-over brewer has a copper-colored core and a fine reusable mesh that lets natural coffee oils pass into the cup. Its conical shape fits most mugs and carafes, while the broad rim sits securely over vessels between 2.5 and 4 inches across. Rinse the filter before adding medium-ground coffee, then pour hot water in slow circles. The brewer disassembles for straightforward cleaning and is dishwasher safe.

title: Dappled Moss Stoneware Tea Mug
description: Hand-finished stoneware gives this generous tea mug a softly dappled moss-green glaze, with natural variation from piece to piece. The rounded handle leaves room for two fingers, and the 14-ounce capacity suits a long breakfast tea or a large coffee. A sturdy foot keeps the mug steady on a desk or kitchen table. It is safe for everyday use in the microwave and dishwasher; small glaze differences are part of its handmade character.

title: Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Sauté Pan with Lid
description: A versatile 10-inch sauté pan built with an aluminum core between layers of stainless steel for even heating across the cooking surface. The straight sides help contain sauces and vegetables, while the fitted stainless lid is useful for simmering grains or finishing a dish with steam. Its riveted handle stays secure through daily use, and the pan works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops. Oven safe to 500°F; hand washing helps preserve its polished finish.

title: Walnut-Handled Brass Coffee Scoop
description: This compact coffee scoop pairs a brushed brass bowl with a smooth walnut handle for a useful tool that looks at home beside the coffee tin. Its one-tablespoon capacity makes it easy to measure grounds for a single cup or scale up for a full pot. A small hanging loop keeps the scoop within reach on a hook. Wipe the brass clean after use and wash the wooden handle by hand; do not leave it soaking in water.

title: Tahini Cocoa Nib Crunch
description: Toasted sesame and cocoa nibs make a savory-sweet brittle with a crisp bite and a deep roasted flavor. Tahini adds a nutty richness, balanced with cane sugar and a pinch of sea salt. Break off a piece for an afternoon treat, crumble it over yogurt, or serve it alongside a cup of strong coffee. The resealable pouch contains 5 ounces. Made in small batches in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts and peanuts.

title: The Slow Brew and Biscuit Gift Box
description: A cozy coffee break in one ready-to-give box: a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast Guatemala coffee, a pair of buttery oat biscuits, and a stainless steel coffee scoop. The coffee is suited to drip brewers and French presses, while the biscuits are individually wrapped to help keep them crisp. Packed in a kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a simple note card, this set is a thoughtful choice for a host, colleague, or weekend visitor.

title: Clay Pot Cooking: Grains, Beans & Slow Simmered Suppers
description: This practical cookbook explores clay-pot cooking through 75 home-friendly recipes for beans, grains, vegetables, and slow-simmered meals. Clear instructions cover soaking, seasoning, and caring for an unglazed clay pot, with alternatives for readers using a Dutch oven or covered casserole. The 192-page hardcover includes ingredient notes and full-color photographs throughout. Recipes range from weekday lentils with greens to a weekend chicken and barley stew, making it a useful companion for cooks who enjoy gentle, steady heat.

title: Crisp Linen and Lemongrass Green Tea
description: Sencha green tea is blended with lemongrass and a touch of dried lime peel for a clean, bright infusion with a lightly citrusy finish. This loose-leaf blend works well hot after a meal or chilled for an afternoon pitcher. The 2.5-ounce resealable pouch makes about 25 servings. Use water just below boiling and steep for two minutes to keep the green tea smooth rather than bitter. Store in a cool, dry cupboard away from strong aromas.

title: Linen-Wrapped Coffee Filter Dripper Set
description: This pour-over set includes a glazed porcelain dripper, a linen storage pouch, and 40 unbleached paper filters sized for the brewer. Three drainage holes provide a steady flow for a balanced cup, and the dripper fits securely over most standard mugs and small carafes. Add a rinsed filter and medium-ground coffee, then pour hot water gradually over the grounds. The porcelain brewer is dishwasher safe; the linen pouch is washable and air-dries quickly.

title: Cinnamon Plum Guatemala Atitlán Coffee
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from small farms around Guatemala’s Lake Atitlán, where cool nights help develop a sweet, balanced cup. Expect notes of ripe plum, cocoa, and cinnamon, with a smooth finish that works well as drip coffee or French press. Each bag contains 12 ounces of freshly roasted beans in a resealable pouch with a one-way valve. Grind just before brewing for the best aroma, and use a slightly finer grind for a more concentrated cup.

title: Insulated Stainless Steel French Press
description: Brew full-bodied coffee or loose-leaf tea in this double-wall French press, made with food-grade stainless steel and a fine-mesh metal filter. The 34-ounce carafe keeps drinks warm at the table without a glass liner, while its sturdy handle stays comfortable to hold. A fitted press lid helps reduce heat loss during steeping. Add coarsely ground coffee and hot water, wait four minutes, then press slowly. Hand wash the body and filter for easy care.

title: Crackle Glaze Stoneware Cortado Cups, Set of Two
description: A pair of compact stoneware cups made for cortados, flat whites, and short servings of tea. Each cup holds 5 ounces and has a rounded profile that sits comfortably in the hand; a warm ivory glaze with fine charcoal crackle lines makes every piece slightly individual. The cups are fired for everyday use and are safe for the microwave and dishwasher. Their low shape also fits neatly beneath most espresso machine group heads when used for a direct pour.

title: Beechwood Coffee Tamper
description: This compact tamper helps level and compress espresso grounds in a portafilter before brewing. The smooth beechwood handle is shaped for a comfortable palm grip, paired with a flat 58-millimeter stainless steel base suitable for many standard espresso baskets. Its balanced weight makes it easy to apply steady pressure without twisting. Wipe the metal base clean after each use and hand wash the wooden handle, drying it promptly. Check your portafilter diameter before ordering to ensure a close fit.

title: Vanilla Bean Coffee Caramels
description: Soft, individually wrapped caramels combine slow-cooked cream and butter with vanilla bean and a touch of finely ground coffee. The coffee adds a mellow roasted note that balances the sweetness without overpowering the caramel. Each box contains 18 pieces, about 6 ounces total, and is packed in a paperboard carton for easy sharing. Pair a piece with an espresso or steeped black tea, or tuck a few into a lunch bag for an after-meal treat.

title: Weekend Brew-at-Home Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give collection for someone who enjoys an unhurried morning cup. The box includes a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a small jar of wildflower honey, and a pair of buttery oat biscuits from a local bakery. Coffee notes of toasted almond and red apple pair naturally with the honey’s floral sweetness. Items arrive nestled in a recyclable kraft gift box with crinkle paper and a printed brewing card. Add a personal note at checkout for gifting.

title: The Home Barista’s Guide to Milk and Foam
description: This practical guide walks through the everyday skills behind café-style milk drinks, from choosing milk and positioning a steam wand to pouring simple hearts and tulips. Clear step-by-step instructions are paired with troubleshooting notes for common issues such as large bubbles, thin foam, and uneven pours. The 160-page paperback includes recipes for cappuccinos, flat whites, and iced drinks, along with a short section on cleaning equipment. It is designed for home espresso users, but the techniques also apply to stovetop milk frothers.

title: Hario V60 Ceramic Dripper, Size 02
description: This ceramic pour-over dripper is designed for brewing one to four cups with standard size 02 cone filters. Spiral ribs along the interior help water flow around the coffee bed, while the wide opening makes it easy to rinse after use. The glazed ceramic body holds heat well when preheated and rests securely over many mugs and servers. Add a paper filter, rinse it, then pour hot water slowly over medium-ground coffee. Includes one dripper; filters and server are sold separately.

title: Enamel Pinch Bowl Trio, Cobalt Rim
description: These three small enamel-on-steel bowls keep measured ingredients close at hand while brewing coffee or preparing a meal. Each bowl is about 3 inches across and holds roughly 4 ounces, making them useful for tea leaves, spices, chopped herbs, or a spoonful of sugar. A cobalt blue rim adds a clean contrast to the white interior. The bowls are lightweight and stack for storage; wash by hand to protect the enamel finish and avoid using them in the microwave.

title: Cedar Grove Guatemala Antigua Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from small farms in Guatemala’s Antigua region, where volcanic soils lend the cup a rounded sweetness. Expect notes of cocoa, toasted pecan, and dried orange, with a smooth finish that works well as drip coffee or espresso. Choose a 12-ounce bag for a fresh weekly brew or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Grind just before brewing and store sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Ginger Pear White Tea with Calendula
description: A light white tea blend with gentle ginger warmth, fragrant pear, and a few calendula petals. The loose leaves are packed in a resealable 2-ounce pouch, enough for about 25 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for three minutes to keep the flavor soft and aromatic. Enjoy it on its own in the afternoon or serve it alongside fruit and simple pastries.

title: Glass French Press with Walnut Handle
description: Brew full-bodied coffee or loose-leaf tea in a clear borosilicate glass carafe framed by a stainless steel mesh plunger. A solid walnut handle and matching collar provide a comfortable grip while keeping the hot vessel easy to pour. The 34-ounce capacity makes about four small mugs. Add coarse-ground coffee and hot water, steep for four minutes, then press slowly. Rinse the filter after each use; the glass carafe lifts out for hand washing.

title: Pale Blue Porcelain Breakfast Mug
description: This everyday porcelain mug has a gently flared rim and a soft pale blue glaze that varies subtly from piece to piece. Its 14-ounce capacity suits a generous pour of coffee, tea, or cocoa, while the sturdy handle leaves room for two fingers. The mug is glazed inside and out and has a smooth foot for stable placement on a desk or breakfast table. Dishwasher and microwave safe for convenient daily use.

title: Matte Black Carbon Steel Paella Pan
description: Made from responsive carbon steel, this wide, shallow pan is designed for paella, seared vegetables, and one-pan rice dishes. The flat cooking surface spreads heat quickly, while two loop handles make it easier to move from stovetop to table with oven mitts. Choose an 11-inch pan for two to three servings or a 14-inch pan for a larger meal. Season before first use and dry thoroughly after washing to protect the naturally darkening surface.

title: Stainless Steel Tea Strainer with Drip Rest
description: This fine-mesh stainless steel strainer catches small tea leaves as you pour from a teapot into your cup. Its broad rim rests securely on most standard mug openings, and the included shallow drip rest keeps the counter tidy between pours. The compact basket is also useful for dusting cocoa or powdered sugar over baked goods. Rinse after use or place it in the dishwasher. Measures 3 inches across and stores easily in a utensil drawer.

title: Crispy Chili-Lime Corn Nuts
description: Roasted corn kernels get a lively coating of lime, smoked paprika, and mild chili for a crunchy snack with a bright, savory finish. Each 5-ounce pouch is made for easy sharing at the table or packing for a walk. Serve by the handful with cold drinks, scatter over a bowl of soup, or add to a snack board with cheese and olives. Keep the resealable bag closed between servings to preserve the crunch.

title: Coffee and Tea Starter Shelf Gift Box
description: A useful introduction to everyday brewing, packed with a 4-ounce bag of medium-roast whole coffee beans, a 1.5-ounce pouch of breakfast black tea, and a stainless steel tea infuser. The coffee offers a balanced cocoa profile, while the tea brews briskly for a familiar morning cup. Contents arrive in a kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a simple brew card. A home grinder is recommended for the coffee; the tea is ready to steep loose.

title: Paper Cone Coffee Filters, 200 Pack
description: A practical refill of 200 unbleached paper filters for cone-style pour-over brewers. The folded seams help the filter hold its shape while hot water passes through, catching fine grounds for a clean, light-bodied cup. Rinse the filter with hot water before adding coffee to reduce paper taste and warm your dripper. These disposable filters fit common size 02 cone brewers; check your brewer’s dimensions before ordering. Store the stack in a dry cupboard.

title: The Everyday Skillet: Cooking with Cast Iron
description: This practical cookbook brings together 80 recipes for cast iron cooking, from skillet cornbread and crisp-edged potatoes to weeknight beans and fruit cobbler. Clear instructions cover preheating, heat control, and simple care for keeping a seasoned pan in good shape. The hardcover edition includes color photographs, a temperature reference, and a compact guide to adapting recipes for different skillet sizes. A useful companion for cooks building confidence with cast iron at home.

title: Replacement Lid for Glass Tea Brewer
description: A replacement lid for the Fieldnote 24-ounce glass tea brewer, made for those small but inconvenient kitchen mishaps. The heat-resistant borosilicate glass lid has a stainless steel rim and a central opening that accommodates the brewer’s removable infuser basket. Set it in place during steeping to help retain warmth, then lift it carefully by the rim before serving. This part is sold individually and is compatible only with the matching Fieldnote glass brewer model.

title: Maple Toffee and Dried Cherry Colombia Tolima Coffee
description: Sweet, balanced whole-bean coffee from Tolima, Colombia, with notes of maple toffee, dried cherry, and toasted pecan. The beans are washed-processed and roasted to a medium profile, suited to drip brewers, pour-over cones, and French presses. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Grind just before brewing for a fuller aroma, and store the beans sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Smoked Apricot and Oolong Tea
description: A loose-leaf oolong blend with a mellow roasted base, dried apricot pieces, and a light touch of smoked tea. The flavor is rounded and gently fruity, making it a good choice for an afternoon cup or a small pot shared after a meal. Each tin contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for about 35 cups when brewed with one teaspoon per 8-ounce serving. Steep at 195°F for three to four minutes.

title: Stovetop Copper-Plated Pour-Over Kettle
description: A compact stovetop kettle with a copper-plated stainless steel body and a narrow gooseneck spout for controlled pouring. The 1-liter capacity is sized for preparing several cups of pour-over coffee or tea without taking up much counter space. A heat-resistant walnut-finish handle provides a comfortable grip, and the fitted lid lifts off for filling and cleaning. Use on gas or electric stovetops; not intended for induction burners. Hand wash to protect the finish.

title: Cream Glaze Stoneware Breakfast Bowl
description: A wide, low breakfast bowl in sturdy stoneware, finished with a warm cream glaze and a fine brown rim. Its 18-ounce capacity suits oatmeal, yogurt with fruit, or a generous café au lait, while the gently curved sides make it easy to hold. Each bowl measures approximately 5.5 inches across and is made for everyday use. Microwave and dishwasher safe; glaze variations are part of the handmade finish.

title: Hard-Anodized Aluminum Saucepan with Pour Spouts
description: A 2-quart hard-anodized aluminum saucepan for simmering grains, warming milk, or making a quick pan sauce. The thick base distributes heat evenly, while small pour spouts on either side help guide liquids into bowls and cups. A stainless steel handle is riveted securely to the pan, and a tempered glass lid lets you check cooking without lifting it. Compatible with gas, electric, and ceramic cooktops; hand wash for a lasting finish.

title: Beechwood and Stainless Steel Dough Whisk
description: This sturdy dough whisk combines a smooth beechwood handle with a stainless steel loop head that cuts through thick mixtures without overworking them. Use it to bring together bread dough, pancake batter, or muffin ingredients in a mixing bowl. The 12-inch handle keeps hands clear of the bowl, and the open-loop design is easy to rinse clean after use. Hand wash and dry promptly; occasional food-safe oil helps maintain the wood.

title: Meyer Lemon and Fennel Seed Marmalade
description: A small-batch marmalade made with Meyer lemons, cane sugar, and lightly crushed fennel seed. It has a bright citrus flavor with a gentle anise finish, suited to buttered toast, scones, or a cheese board. The 8-ounce glass jar is sealed for pantry storage and should be refrigerated after opening. Stir a spoonful into plain yogurt or use it as a glaze for roasted carrots. Made in small batches with no artificial colors or flavors.

title: The Sunday Table Coffee and Biscotti Box
description: A ready-to-give pairing for a relaxed coffee break, packed with a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast house coffee and two sleeves of almond-orange biscotti. The whole beans can be brewed in a drip machine, French press, or pour-over; biscotti are crisp enough for dunking and individually wrapped to keep them fresh. Items arrive together in a recyclable kraft gift box with a printed brewing card. Coffee is roasted in small batches, and the box ships without a mug.

title: Saffron Tomato and Chickpea Stew
description: A practical collection of 80 plant-forward recipes centered on beans, grains, and vegetables, with clear instructions for weeknight cooking and slower weekend meals. The hardcover edition includes a saffron tomato and chickpea stew, pantry guides, and suggestions for adapting recipes to what is on hand. At 192 pages, it fits easily on a kitchen shelf and is designed for cooks comfortable with basic chopping and stovetop techniques. Includes a small selection of color photographs and a useful index.

title: Honeycomb Pattern Glass Tea Pitcher
description: A clear borosilicate glass pitcher for brewing and serving iced tea, cold brew, or fruit-infused water. The 1.2-liter vessel has a honeycomb-textured grip and a stainless steel lid with a fine mesh insert to hold back loose tea leaves and citrus slices. Add tea and cool water, steep in the refrigerator, then pour directly from the pitcher. The glass is heat resistant for warm brewing, but allow it to cool before refrigerating. Hand wash the lid and mesh.

title: Redwood Peak Peru Cajamarca Washed Coffee
description: These medium-roast beans come from small farms in Peru’s Cajamarca region and are processed with a washed method for a clean, balanced cup. Expect notes of red apple, panela, and toasted almond, with a gentle cocoa finish. The 12-ounce bag is sealed with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Brew it as a pour-over or in a drip machine, and adjust the grind for your method. Whole beans are best ground just before brewing.

title: Citrus Grove Assam Breakfast Tea
description: A brisk Assam black tea blended with dried orange peel and a small amount of cardamom for a bright, warming morning cup. The loose-leaf blend comes in a resealable 3-ounce tin, enough for approximately 35 cups when measured by the teaspoon. Steep one teaspoon per eight ounces of freshly boiled water for three to four minutes. Enjoy it plain, or add milk for a fuller brew. Store away from heat and moisture to keep the citrus aroma lively.

title: Ribbed Porcelain Coffee Cone Brewer
description: This single-cup pour-over cone is made from glazed porcelain with deep interior ribs that help maintain space between the paper filter and brewer wall. Its 4.5-inch opening fits most standard mugs and small carafes, while the wide base provides a stable seat during brewing. Use size 02 cone filters and add medium-ground coffee in a slow, circular pour. The smooth glaze rinses clean between brews; allow the cone to cool before washing after use.

title: Amber Glass Cappuccino Cups, Set of Two
description: Serve cappuccinos, flat whites, or herbal tea in this pair of amber-tinted borosilicate glass cups. Each cup holds 8 ounces and has a rounded handle sized for a comfortable grip. The sturdy glass shows off layered drinks while remaining light enough for everyday use. A matching saucer is not included. Hand-wash with warm soapy water to protect the finish, and avoid sudden temperature changes. The set arrives in a protective cardboard gift box.

title: Lidded Stoneware Dutch Oven, 5 Quart
description: Built for soups, braises, and one-pot meals, this 5-quart stoneware Dutch oven has a cream-speckled glaze and a snug-fitting lid. The thick ceramic body holds heat steadily for slow cooking and keeps food warm at the table. Its two side handles make it easier to lift with oven mitts, and the interior accommodates a family-size batch of beans or stew. Suitable for oven use up to 450°F; use a trivet on counters and let the pot cool before washing.

title: Beechwood Tea and Coffee Measuring Scoop
description: This compact measuring scoop is turned from smooth, unfinished beechwood and shaped to hold roughly one tablespoon of loose tea or ground coffee. A short, rounded handle fits easily inside most storage jars, while the shallow bowl makes it simple to level a portion by hand. Use it at the brew station or keep it with your favorite tea tin. Hand-wash and dry promptly; occasional food-safe oil helps maintain the wood’s natural surface.

title: Salted Maple Pecan Biscotti
description: Twice-baked biscotti combine toasted pecans, maple syrup, and a pinch of flaky salt for a crisp treat made to dunk. Each resealable pouch contains eight individually shaped cookies, approximately 6 ounces in total. The firm texture pairs especially well with black coffee or a malty breakfast tea. Made with wheat, eggs, butter, and tree nuts; packed in a kitchen that also handles peanuts. Keep the pouch sealed between servings and enjoy within two weeks of opening.

title: The Tea and Toasted Honey Gift Chest
description: A ready-to-give assortment for slow breakfasts and afternoon breaks. This kraft gift chest includes a 2-ounce tin of Earl Grey loose-leaf tea, a small jar of wildflower honey, and a 4-ounce bag of crisp honey oat biscuits. The tea’s bergamot aroma pairs naturally with the biscuits, while the honey can be stirred into a hot cup or spread on toast. Items are packed in recyclable paper cushioning and arrive together in a lidded box with a simple cotton ribbon.

title: Small Batch Coffee: Roasting at Home
description: This practical guide introduces home coffee roasting with clear explanations of bean selection, roast development, and safe equipment setup. The 176-page paperback includes step-by-step profiles for light, medium, and dark roasts, plus notes for recording batch times and tasting results. Photographs and diagrams help readers understand color changes and airflow without assuming professional experience. It is designed for curious coffee drinkers using small countertop roasters or stovetop methods, and makes a useful reference beside a home brewing station.

title: Velvet Night Rwanda Nyamasheke Coffee
description: Single-origin beans from Rwanda’s Nyamasheke district are roasted to a medium-dark profile for a rounded, satisfying cup. The flavor leans toward blackberry jam, dark chocolate, and a hint of baking spice, with a smooth finish that works well with milk. This 10-ounce bag contains whole beans sourced from a washed lot and packed shortly after roasting. Try it in an espresso machine, moka pot, or French press; use a slightly finer grind for espresso and adjust to taste.

title: Hand-Crank Stainless Steel Coffee Mill
description: Grind whole beans at home or on the road with this hand-crank mill, featuring a stainless steel body and adjustable ceramic burrs. A locking dial offers settings from coarse French press to fine espresso, while the removable handle stores alongside the grinder in its drawstring pouch. The lower grounds cup holds enough for one or two servings. Brush out the burr chamber after use and keep the grinder dry; it is intended for coffee beans only, not spices or oily seeds.

title: Blue Heron Kenya Kirinyaga Washed Coffee
description: These whole beans come from small lots in Kenya’s Kirinyaga region and are roasted to bring out notes of blackcurrant, red plum, and cocoa. The washed process gives the cup a clean finish, suited to pour-over, drip, or AeroPress brewing. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a two-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Store the beans sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing for the freshest aroma.

title: Toasted Rice and Yuzu Green Tea
description: A loose-leaf green tea blend pairing grassy Japanese sencha with toasted rice and fragrant yuzu peel. The rice adds a mellow, nutty aroma, while citrus keeps each cup bright and refreshing. Brew one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for two minutes, then adjust to taste. Packed in a resealable 2.5-ounce pouch, this tea works well as a warm afternoon drink or lightly chilled over ice.

title: Compact Electric Coffee Scale with Timer
description: Measure coffee and water accurately with this compact digital scale, designed for pour-over and espresso routines. Its 0.1-gram increments and built-in timer make it easy to track dose and brew time on the same display. The slim ABS housing has a wipe-clean surface, a silicone mat for heat protection, and a rechargeable USB-C battery. It measures 5.2 by 4.3 inches, fitting comfortably beneath most drippers and small espresso cups.

title: Speckled Seafoam Porcelain Tea Cup
description: This porcelain tea cup has a softly rounded profile and a seafoam glaze scattered with fine charcoal speckles. A comfortable curved handle leaves room for a relaxed grip, while the sturdy foot keeps the cup steady on a desk or breakfast table. It holds 11 ounces and measures about 3.5 inches tall. The cup is safe for microwave and dishwasher use, making it practical for daily tea, coffee, or a small serving of warm milk.

title: Hard-Anodized Nonstick Crepe Pan, 9-Inch
description: Make thin crepes, omelets, and pancakes in this lightweight 9-inch pan with a hard-anodized aluminum body and durable nonstick interior. Its low sloped sides help a spatula slide beneath delicate foods, while the riveted stainless steel handle stays secure during everyday use. The pan is compatible with gas, electric, and ceramic cooktops and should be washed by hand to preserve the coating. Use low to medium heat and a small amount of butter or oil.

title: Beechwood Flat-Edge Dough Scraper
description: A sturdy flat-edge scraper for portioning dough, gathering chopped ingredients, and cleaning flour from a work surface. The blade is made from food-safe stainless steel, with a smooth beechwood handle shaped for a steady grip. A measurement guide along the blade marks inches and centimeters for dividing pastry or bread dough evenly. It measures 6 inches across and should be hand-washed and dried promptly to protect the wood handle.

title: Blood Orange and Cardamom Marmalade
description: Small-batch marmalade made with blood oranges, cane sugar, lemon juice, and freshly ground cardamom. The fruit is cooked in short batches to keep the peel tender and the citrus flavor lively, with cardamom adding a warm, aromatic finish. Spread it on toast, serve it alongside a cheese board, or spoon a little into plain yogurt. Each 8-ounce glass jar is sealed for pantry storage; refrigerate after opening and use a clean spoon.

title: Pour-Over and Citrus Biscuit Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give pairing for an unhurried coffee break, packed in a kraft gift box with crinkle paper and a simple note card. Inside are one 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a small batch of citrus butter biscuits, and a reusable stainless steel coffee scoop. The coffee’s caramel and orange notes complement the crisp, lightly sweet biscuits. Choose whole bean or have the coffee ground for drip brewing before the box is packed.

title: A Baker’s Pantry: Simple Cakes, Tarts, and Tea Breads
description: A practical home-baking cookbook focused on cakes, tarts, and tea breads made with familiar pantry ingredients. Clear instructions cover mixing methods, pan preparation, baking cues, and simple finishing ideas, with recipes ranging from a plain yogurt loaf to a seasonal fruit tart. The hardcover edition includes 176 pages, a ribbon marker, and full-color photographs throughout. Keep it near the kitchen counter for weekend baking, afternoon tea, or an uncomplicated homemade dessert.

title: Clover Honey and Cacao Husk Herbal Infusion
description: A caffeine-free herbal infusion of roasted cacao husks, rooibos, and dried apple, with a separate sachet of clover honey granules for gentle sweetness. The brewed cup has a mellow chocolate aroma and a rounded, fruit-like finish without containing coffee or chocolate pieces. Steep one tablespoon of the blend in freshly boiled water for five minutes, then sweeten as desired. Each tin holds 2.8 ounces of loose tea and closes with a fitted lid to help preserve its aroma.

title: Recycled Glass Carafe with Cork Collar
description: Serve batch-brewed coffee, iced tea, or infused water from this clear recycled-glass carafe, shaped with a narrow neck for a comfortable pour. A natural cork collar provides a secure grip and helps protect hands when the carafe holds a warm beverage. It has a 1-liter capacity and fits easily on a refrigerator shelf. Hand-wash the glass and remove the collar before cleaning; the cork should be kept dry between uses.

title: Sunlit Orchard Ethiopia Guji Natural Coffee Beans
description: These whole beans come from smallholder lots in Ethiopia’s Guji region and are dry-processed for a rounded, fruit-forward cup. Expect notes of blueberry, cocoa, and ripe peach, with a gentle sweetness that works well in a French press or pour-over. The 12-ounce bag is sealed with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness; grind just before brewing for the clearest aroma. Roasted in small batches, these beans suit slow weekend mornings as readily as a daily cup.

title: Replacement Paper Filters for Cone Brewers, 100 Pack
description: Keep your daily pour-over routine stocked with these unbleached paper filters, sized for most cone brewers that take a medium, size 02 filter. The ridged walls encourage an even flow while holding back fine grounds, and the folded seam helps each filter sit neatly in the dripper. Rinse with hot water before adding coffee to reduce any paper taste. This no-frills refill contains 100 disposable filters in a compact paper sleeve.

title: Speckled Terracotta Espresso Cup
description: Made from sturdy terracotta clay, this small espresso cup has a warm rust glaze scattered with subtle cream speckles. Its rounded profile feels comfortable in hand and holds about 3 ounces, making it a tidy fit for a single or doppio. The unglazed foot keeps the cup stable on a saucer, while the glazed interior is easy to rinse after use. Each cup is finished by hand, so the pattern and glaze variation will differ slightly.

title: Brushed Stainless Steel Stockpot, 6 Quart
description: This 6-quart stainless steel stockpot is sized for soup, pasta, beans, and small-batch stock. Its brushed exterior resists showing everyday scuffs, while the encapsulated base distributes heat across gas, electric, and induction cooktops. Riveted side handles provide a steady grip when the pot is full, and the tempered glass lid lets you check a simmer without lifting it. The pot and lid are dishwasher safe; use a low-to-medium flame for steady, controlled cooking.

title: Acacia Wood Butter Spreader
description: Spread soft butter, jam, or nut butter with this compact acacia wood knife. The gently rounded blade is broad enough for toast but blunt at the edge for everyday table use. A smooth, tapered handle offers a comfortable grip, and the natural grain gives each piece its own character. Measuring about 7 inches long, it stores easily in a utensil crock or drawer. Hand wash and dry promptly; occasional food-safe oil helps keep the wood looking its best.

title: Roasted Garlic and Thyme White Bean Spread
description: Creamy cannellini beans are blended with roasted garlic, olive oil, and dried thyme for a savory spread with a soft, spoonable texture. Serve it on toast, alongside cut vegetables, or as a quick layer in a sandwich. The 7-ounce glass jar is shelf-stable until opened and is made in small batches without artificial colors. Refrigerate after opening and use within a week. A simple pantry staple for lunches, snacks, and easy appetizer plates.

title: The Weeknight Coffee Break Gift Box
description: This practical set pairs a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee with a box of crisp oat biscuits and a small ceramic coffee measure. The coffee has a mellow cocoa profile suited to drip brewers and French presses, while the biscuits offer a lightly sweet snack for the side of the cup. Packed in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper cushioning, it is ready to give for a housewarming or thank-you. Include a grinder if the recipient prefers pre-ground coffee.

title: Tea for One: Pots, Leaves, and Quiet Afternoons
description: This illustrated cookbook brings together recipes and serving ideas centered on the small pleasures of tea time. Inside are instructions for steeping different tea styles, plus recipes for savory scones, citrus loaf, jammy oat bars, and simple tea sandwiches. Practical notes cover scaling portions, choosing teaware, and planning a relaxed afternoon spread without elaborate equipment. The 176-page hardcover includes color photographs throughout and is designed for home cooks who enjoy pairing a well-brewed cup with something homemade.

title: Citrus-Scented Espresso Machine Descaler
description: Use this citric-acid-based descaling concentrate to help remove mineral buildup from compatible home espresso machines and hot-water appliances. The 8-ounce bottle makes up to four treatments when diluted according to the included instructions. Run the solution through the machine’s descaling cycle, then rinse thoroughly with fresh water before brewing again. A mild citrus scent makes the cleaning process more pleasant without leaving a flavor when used as directed. Check your appliance manual before use, especially for machines that require a specific descaler.

title: Rainshadow Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey-Process Coffee
description: This medium-roast coffee comes from Tarrazú, Costa Rica, where a honey process leaves some fruit mucilage on the beans as they dry. Expect a rounded cup with notes of yellow plum, cocoa, and toasted almond. The 12-ounce bag contains whole beans with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for pour-over, drip, or French press; a medium grind brings out its sweet, balanced character.

title: Wild Blueberry and Linden Herbal Tea
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf infusion made with dried blueberry, linden flowers, hibiscus, and a touch of lemon peel. The blend brews a deep ruby cup with a mellow berry aroma and a gently tart finish. Each 2.5-ounce pouch makes approximately 25 cups. Use one heaping teaspoon per eight ounces of freshly boiled water and steep for five to seven minutes. Enjoy it hot after dinner or chill a strong brew for iced tea.

title: Variable-Temperature Gooseneck Kettle
description: A 1-liter electric kettle with a narrow gooseneck spout for controlled pouring over coffee grounds or tea leaves. Select temperatures from 140 to 212°F on the handle display, or use the hold function to maintain your setting for up to 30 minutes. The stainless steel interior resists lingering flavors, while the matte charcoal exterior and walnut-look handle suit a kitchen counter. Includes a removable base and a standard household plug.

title: Speckled Sage Porcelain Tea-for-Two Set
description: This coordinating tea set includes a 12-ounce porcelain teapot and two 7-ounce cups, each finished with a soft sage glaze and fine iron speckles. The pot has a fitted lid and a curved spout for steady pouring; its removable stainless steel infuser holds loose leaves without crowding them. Porcelain retains heat while remaining light in the hand. Use the set for a shared pot of morning tea or serve herbal infusions after a meal.

title: Hammered Stainless Steel Roasting Pan with Rack
description: A sturdy 16-by-12-inch roasting pan made from heavy-gauge stainless steel, paired with a removable wire rack that lifts food above the pan juices. The broad handles provide a secure grip when moving a roast or tray of vegetables in and out of the oven. Its gently sloped sides make it easy to baste and collect drippings for gravy. Suitable for oven use and hand washing; dry thoroughly after cleaning to keep the finish bright.

title: Olivewood Citrus Reamer
description: A hand-carved olivewood reamer for squeezing lemons, limes, and small oranges directly into a bowl or glass. Its tapered ridges press out juice while helping keep larger seeds near the fruit rather than in your recipe. The 6-inch handle is comfortable to grip and easy to store in a utensil crock. Natural wood grain varies from piece to piece. Rinse promptly after use, wash by hand, and occasionally condition with food-safe mineral oil.

title: Brown Butter Shortbread with Earl Grey
description: Tender shortbread made with browned butter, finely ground Earl Grey tea, flour, sugar, and a pinch of sea salt. The tea adds a light bergamot fragrance that pairs well with coffee or a pot of black tea. Each 6-ounce box contains twelve individually wrapped rectangular biscuits, ready to serve alongside an afternoon cup or pack for a snack. Store in a cool, dry place and enjoy within two weeks of opening.

title: The Morning Market Coffee and Jam Gift Crate
description: A breakfast-ready assortment with a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a 5-ounce jar of strawberry-rhubarb jam, and a set of two crisp cotton tea towels. The coffee brews with notes of caramel and red fruit, while the small-batch jam is made with fruit, sugar, and lemon juice. Packed in a reusable kraft crate with paper fill, it’s suited to new-home gifts, weekend brunches, or a thoughtful thank-you. Coffee is best used within a month of opening.

title: A Cup at a Time: Tea Blending for the Home
description: A practical guide to building balanced tea blends in a home kitchen, with recipes for black, green, and caffeine-free infusions. Chapters explain how to combine leaves, flowers, spices, and dried fruit, along with steeping temperatures and storage basics. The 176-page paperback includes 45 blend formulas, tasting notes, and suggestions for adjusting strength to suit your cup. Use it as a starting point for everyday brewing or for assembling personalized tea gifts.

title: Handblown Ribbed Glass Coffee Server
description: A 600-milliliter handblown borosilicate glass server designed to sit beneath most cone-style pour-over brewers. Raised ribs around the body provide a steady grip and help indicate how much coffee remains, while the wide handle leaves room for fingers when pouring. The heat-resistant glass shows the color of the brew and rinses clean between uses. Use it to serve two or three cups at the table; hand washing is recommended to protect its delicate form.

title: Stone-Ground Almond Butter with Espresso and Sea Salt
