description: Roasted almonds are stone-ground into a creamy spread and blended with finely ground espresso and a measured pinch of flaky sea salt. The 9-ounce glass jar offers a rich, nutty flavor with a gentle coffee finish, suited to toast, oatmeal, or apple slices. Stir well before serving, since natural oil may rise to the surface. Made in small batches without palm oil; refrigerate after opening for the freshest flavor and texture.

title: Night Orchard Sumatra Mandheling Coffee Beans
description: These whole beans from North Sumatra brew a full-bodied cup with notes of dark chocolate, cedar, and dried fig. The wet-hulled coffee is roasted in small batches to bring out its earthy sweetness, making it a good match for a French press, moka pot, or espresso machine. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Store sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing.

title: Rosehip, Hibiscus and Blood Orange Tisane
description: A bright, caffeine-free herbal blend of tart hibiscus petals, rosehips, orange peel, and natural blood orange flavor. The loose leaves brew to a vivid ruby color with a fruity aroma and a clean, tangy finish. Use one heaping teaspoon per cup and steep in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes. Packed in a resealable 3-ounce pouch, it can be enjoyed hot or chilled over ice for an easy afternoon drink.

title: Countertop Burr Coffee Grinder with 30 Settings
description: A compact electric burr grinder for dialing in coffee from coarse French press to fine espresso. Its stainless steel conical burrs and 30 stepped settings provide consistent grounds, while the removable hopper holds up to 8 ounces of whole beans. A simple front dial controls the grind and a catch cup keeps the counter tidy. The grinder measures 6 by 8 by 13 inches and includes a cleaning brush and power cord; wipe the housing with a dry cloth.

title: Hand-Thrown Speckled Clay Cappuccino Mug
description: Made by hand from durable stoneware, this rounded cappuccino mug has a warm ivory glaze scattered with small charcoal speckles. Its comfortable loop handle leaves room for a thumb, and the gently tapered shape suits cappuccino, tea, or a generous flat white. Each mug holds 12 ounces and measures about 4 inches tall; slight variations in glaze and form are part of its handmade character. Microwave and dishwasher safe for everyday use.

title: Blue Enamel Cast Iron Braiser, 3.5 Quart
description: This enameled cast iron braiser is sized for shallow braises, pan-roasted vegetables, and one-pot dinners. The 3.5-quart pot has a wide 11-inch cooking surface, a fitted lid, and sturdy side handles for moving it from stovetop to table. A smooth cream interior makes browning and cleaning straightforward, while the deep blue exterior adds a bright note to the kitchen. Suitable for gas, electric, and induction cooktops, and oven safe to 500°F.

title: Stainless Steel Bench Scraper with Measurement Guide
description: A sturdy stainless steel bench scraper for dividing dough, lifting chopped vegetables, and clearing flour from a work surface. The broad 6-inch blade has a straight cutting edge and rounded top corners, with inch and centimeter markings etched along one side for quick portioning. A nonslip polymer handle gives a secure grip during repetitive prep. Rinse after use or place it in the dishwasher; dry promptly to keep the blade looking its best.

title: Rosemary Sea Salt Sourdough Crackers
description: Thin, crisp sourdough crackers baked with extra-virgin olive oil, dried rosemary, and flaky sea salt. Their savory flavor pairs well with soft cheeses, hummus, or a bowl of tomato soup, and the sturdy texture makes them easy to serve on a snack board. Each 5-ounce pouch is baked in small batches and sealed for freshness. Contains wheat; store in a cool, dry cupboard and enjoy soon after opening for the best crunch.

title: Coffeehouse Morning Pantry Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give breakfast bundle with a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast whole bean coffee, a 4-ounce jar of wildflower honey, and a 5-ounce packet of buttery oat shortbread. The coffee brings gentle caramel and toasted almond notes, while the honey and cookies make an easy pairing for a slow morning. Items arrive nestled in a recyclable kraft gift box with a printed brew card and space for a short gift note. Coffee is supplied whole bean.

title: The Cast Iron Table: One-Pan Meals for Every Season
description: A practical collection of 85 recipes built around the dependable cast iron skillet, from crisp-edged cornbread and skillet greens to roasted chicken and fruit cobblers. The instructions include pan-size guidance, heat cues, and simple substitutions for seasonal ingredients, making the book useful for new cooks and experienced home chefs alike. This 192-page hardcover includes full-color food photography, a conversion chart, and a short care guide for seasoning and cleaning cast iron cookware.

title: Stoneware Matcha Bowl and Bamboo Whisk Set
description: A compact matcha preparation set with a 16-ounce stoneware bowl, a bamboo whisk, and a small ceramic whisk stand. The bowl has a wide opening that makes whisking easier and a subtly ridged foot for a steady hold. Add sifted matcha and warm water, then whisk in a quick zigzag motion until lightly foamy. The bowl is finished with a satin celadon glaze; hand-washing is recommended, while the bamboo pieces should be rinsed and air-dried after use.

title: Brass and Acacia Wood Tea Caddy Spoon
description: A small measuring spoon designed for scooping loose tea from a tin or pouch. Its polished brass bowl holds about one teaspoon, while the smooth acacia wood handle provides a comfortable grip and a warm contrast to the metal. At 4.5 inches long, it fits neatly in most tea caddies and can also measure spices or coffee grounds. Hand-wash with mild soap and dry immediately; occasional food-safe oil helps maintain the wood’s finish.

title: Cocoa Nib and Red Currant Ethiopia Sidama Coffee
description: These single-origin beans from Ethiopia’s Sidama region are roasted to a medium profile, bringing out notes of cocoa nib, red currant, and black tea. The 12-ounce bag contains whole beans with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Brew them as a balanced pour-over or use a slightly finer grind for a bright, fruit-forward French press. Roast date and origin details are printed on each bag.

title: Roasted Buckwheat and Peach Black Tea
description: A full-bodied black tea blend layered with roasted buckwheat, dried peach, and a touch of calendula. The loose leaves come in a resealable 3-ounce pouch, enough for approximately 35 cups when measured at one teaspoon per serving. Steep in freshly boiled water for four minutes, then enjoy plain or with a splash of milk. The toasted grain aroma makes this an easy choice for an afternoon cup.

title: Stainless Steel Siphon Coffee Brewer
description: This stovetop siphon brewer combines heat-resistant borosilicate glass chambers with a stainless steel stand and reusable cloth filter. It brews up to 600 milliliters, or about five small cups, using vapor pressure to draw water through the coffee grounds. Add medium-ground coffee to the upper chamber, heat the water below, and let the brew settle before serving. A measuring spoon and cloth filter are included; use on a gas or electric stovetop.

title: Hand-Painted Celadon Stoneware Latte Cup
description: A generously sized stoneware cup for lattes, tea, or a slow morning coffee. Each 14-ounce cup is wheel-thrown and finished in a soft celadon glaze with subtle hand-painted brush marks, so patterns vary from piece to piece. The rounded handle leaves room for a comfortable grip, while the sturdy foot keeps the cup steady on a table. Dishwasher- and microwave-safe; small glaze variations are part of its handmade finish.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Bread Cloche
description: Bake crusty round loaves at home with this enameled cast iron bread cloche, designed to hold heat and trap steam during the first part of baking. The 5-quart base measures 10 inches across and pairs with a domed lid that can also be used as a shallow roasting pan. Its cream enamel interior needs no seasoning and cleans up with warm, soapy water. Suitable for oven use up to 500°F; not intended for stovetop cooking.

title: Beechwood Spiral Citrus Zester
description: A compact hand tool for removing fine curls of zest from lemons, limes, and oranges without taking much of the bitter white pith. The stainless steel cutting head is set into a smooth beechwood handle measuring 6 inches long, with a hanging loop at the end for easy storage. Use the narrow channel to add citrus ribbons to cakes, salads, or drinks. Hand wash and dry promptly to protect the wood handle.

title: Dark Chocolate Espresso Hazelnut Clusters
description: Roasted hazelnuts and crisp espresso beans are folded into dark chocolate for a crunchy, bittersweet snack. Each 5-ounce pouch is sealed to keep the clusters fresh and is packed in small batches. Serve a few alongside coffee, crumble them over vanilla ice cream, or tuck the bag into a picnic basket. Contains hazelnuts, dairy, and soy; made in a kitchen that also handles peanuts and other tree nuts.

title: Pour-Over Traveler’s Tasting Box
description: A compact coffee gift set for exploring different brew profiles at home or on the road. The box contains three 4-ounce bags of whole-bean coffee—one light roast, one medium roast, and one decaf—plus a stainless steel travel dripper that fits most standard mugs. Each coffee is packed separately with origin, tasting notes, and a simple brew suggestion. A reusable cotton drawstring pouch keeps the dripper and accessories together between trips.

title: The Little Book of Tea-Time Bakes
description: A practical baking collection focused on treats that pair well with tea, from sesame shortbread and jam thumbprints to a tender lemon loaf. The 160-page hardcover includes clear ingredient lists, step-by-step instructions, and notes for making several recipes ahead. Most recipes use familiar pantry staples and standard home baking equipment. Finished with color photographs and a ribbon bookmark, it is sized to sit comfortably on a kitchen counter while you work.

title: Fluted Borosilicate Tea Infuser Bottle
description: Brew loose-leaf tea on the go with a 16-ounce borosilicate glass bottle fitted with a removable stainless steel infuser basket. The double-wall glass helps keep the outside comfortable to hold, while the screw-top lid has a silicone seal to reduce leaks during upright travel. Add tea and hot water directly to the basket, then remove it when the steep is complete. Hand washing is recommended; the bottle is not designed for use with carbonated drinks.

title: Harborlight Guatemala Huehuetenango Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from smallholder farms in Guatemala’s Huehuetenango region. Expect a rounded cup with notes of cocoa, red apple, and toasted almond, suited to drip coffee, French press, or espresso. Each resealable bag contains 12 ounces of freshly roasted beans; grind just before brewing for the clearest flavor. Choose a single bag or a two-bag bundle to keep your coffee shelf stocked.

title: Ribbed Borosilicate Glass French Press
description: Brew full-bodied coffee or loose-leaf tea in this clear borosilicate glass French press, framed by a removable ribbed silicone sleeve for a steadier grip. The press holds 34 ounces and includes a stainless steel mesh filter, plunger, and lid. Add coarsely ground coffee and hot water, steep for four minutes, then press slowly. Hand-wash the glass vessel; the filter assembly comes apart for rinsing.

title: Two-Tone Speckle Stoneware Mug
description: A gently tapered stoneware mug with a warm cream interior, deep green exterior glaze, and scattered iron-speckle finish. Its comfortable handle leaves room for two fingers, while the 13-ounce capacity suits a morning coffee, black tea, or a generous hot chocolate. Each mug is kiln-fired and has slight variations in glaze and speckling. Microwave and dishwasher safe for everyday use.

title: Acacia Wood Coffee Knock Box
description: Keep espresso pucks off the counter with this compact knock box, made with an acacia wood frame and a removable stainless steel bar wrapped in a food-safe rubber sleeve. The inner bin lifts out for emptying and rinsing, while the padded base helps it stay put during use. It measures approximately 6 inches wide and fits neatly beside a home espresso machine. Wipe the wood exterior with a damp cloth.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Tea Cake Mix
description: A ready-to-bake mix for a tender lemon tea cake with poppy seeds and a lightly crisp edge. The 16-ounce pouch combines wheat flour, sugar, poppy seeds, and dried lemon peel; add eggs, butter, and milk from your kitchen. Pour the batter into a standard loaf pan and bake until golden, then serve in slices with tea or coffee. Contains wheat; packed in a facility that also handles tree nuts.

title: Coffee Break Biscuit and Brew Gift Set
description: A compact coffee pairing for a relaxed afternoon, packed in a kraft gift box with crinkle-paper cushioning. Inside are one 8-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a 6-ounce tin of butter biscuits, and a printed brew card with French press and drip instructions. The biscuits are individually wrapped to stay crisp. Select a whole-bean or medium-ground coffee option when ordering; ingredients and roast details are included on the enclosed labels.

title: The Small Kitchen Pasta Book
description: This approachable hardcover cookbook focuses on pasta meals that work in a home kitchen, from hand-cut egg noodles to weeknight sauces made with pantry staples. It includes 80 recipes, step-by-step technique notes, and serving suggestions for different shapes and sauces. The 192-page book measures 7 by 9 inches, making it easy to keep near the counter. A useful reference for cooks building confidence with fresh pasta and simple dinners.

title: Espresso Machine Cleaning Tablets
description: These concentrated cleaning tablets help remove coffee oils from compatible home espresso machine group heads and portafilter baskets. The jar contains 30 tablets, each individually shaped for easy dosing; follow your machine’s backflush or cleaning instructions, since compatibility and cycle steps vary by model. Do not use on aluminum parts unless the manufacturer approves it. Store the closed jar in a dry cupboard, away from children and food preparation surfaces.

title: Highland Cocoa Guatemala Antigua Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from small farms in Guatemala’s Antigua region, where volcanic soil and cool nights encourage a steady, sweet cup. Expect notes of cocoa, toasted almond, and a gentle dried-fruit finish. The 12-ounce bag is packed shortly after roasting and fitted with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for drip coffee, French press, or espresso; the balanced profile also works well in milk-based drinks.

title: Jasmine Pear White Tea
description: A light loose-leaf white tea scented with jasmine blossoms and blended with small pieces of dried pear. The cup is delicate and floral, with a soft fruit sweetness that needs no added sugar. This 2-ounce tin contains enough tea for about 25 cups, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for three to four minutes, then enjoy on its own or alongside a simple afternoon snack.

title: Insulated Stainless Steel Pour-Over Brewer
description: Brew directly into this double-wall stainless steel dripper for a compact setup that travels easily from kitchen counter to campsite. Its tapered interior and evenly spaced openings encourage a steady drawdown with standard cone filters. The brewer measures 4.5 inches tall and fits over most mugs and small carafes. Add a paper filter, rinse it with hot water, then brew with a medium-fine grind and slow circular pours. Hand-wash to keep the brushed finish looking its best.

title: Hand-Painted Blue Finch Stoneware Mug
description: A sturdy stoneware mug finished with a satin cream glaze and a hand-painted blue finch on one side. Each 12-ounce cup is formed and glazed in small batches, so the bird’s brushwork and subtle glaze variations may differ slightly. The rounded handle leaves room for a comfortable grip, while the straight-sided shape suits coffee, tea, or warm milk. It is microwave safe for reheating and dishwasher safe for everyday cleanup.

title: Walnut Handle Fine Zester
description: A slim stainless steel zesting blade is paired with a smooth walnut handle for a comfortable grip and a warm, natural finish. The fine teeth produce delicate citrus zest for cakes, dressings, and tea, and can also grate hard cheese, ginger, or whole nutmeg. At 12 inches long, it reaches neatly across a mixing bowl without taking up much drawer space. Rinse the blade promptly after use and dry the wooden handle by hand.

title: Maple Chai Granola with Pumpkin Seeds
description: Small-batch rolled oat granola baked with maple syrup, pumpkin seeds, and a warming blend of cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, and cloves. The clusters are lightly crisp rather than overly sweet, making them an easy topping for yogurt or a snack straight from the jar. Each 10-ounce resealable pouch contains oats, sunflower oil, pumpkin seeds, maple syrup, and spices. Store in a cool, dry cupboard and fold the pouch closed between servings.

title: Coffee and Citrus Kitchen Starter Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give set for an easy morning ritual, packed with a 6-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a jar of blood orange curd, and a pair of crisp butter shortbread rounds. The coffee brings notes of caramel and red apple, while the curd adds a bright citrus spread for toast or scones. Items arrive nestled in a kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a printed contents card. The coffee is whole bean; a grinder is not included.

title: The Home Brewer’s Guide to Better Coffee
description: A practical kitchen guide to making more consistent coffee with the equipment you already own. This 176-page paperback covers grind size, water temperature, brew ratios, and step-by-step methods for French press, pour-over, and stovetop brewing. Clear diagrams and recipe-style brew cards make it easy to compare adjustments and keep notes from one cup to the next. The book is designed for curious home drinkers, from first-time brewers to those refining a familiar morning routine.

title: Smoky Paprika and Sea Salt Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas seasoned with smoked paprika, flaky sea salt, and a little garlic for a savory pantry snack. The 5-ounce pouch is made for lunch boxes, road trips, or scattering over a bowl of soup and salad in place of croutons. Chickpeas are roasted in small batches with sunflower oil to keep the texture crisp and the ingredient list straightforward. Reseal the bag after opening and enjoy within a few days for the best crunch.

title: Golden Hour Colombia Huila Pink Bourbon Coffee
description: These whole beans come from small lots in Colombia’s Huila region, where Pink Bourbon cherries develop a lively cup with notes of ripe peach, panela, and soft florals. The coffee is washed and roasted in small batches for filter brewing, with enough sweetness to work well as espresso, too. Choose a 10-ounce bag for a fresh rotation or a 2-pound bag for daily brewing. Store sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before use.

title: Meadow Mint Sencha Green Tea
description: A refreshing loose-leaf blend of Japanese sencha, spearmint, and a touch of lemon verbena, made for a clean, gently sweet cup. The green tea leaves bring grassy depth, while mint keeps the finish cool without added flavoring. Packaged in a resealable 2.5-ounce pouch, it makes about 30 cups depending on your preferred strength. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for two to three minutes, then enjoy hot or pour over ice.

title: Copper Coil Stovetop Tea Kettle
description: This stovetop kettle pairs a brushed stainless-steel body with a copper-toned handle and a balanced, easy-pour spout. Its 1.5-quart capacity is suited to tea service or filling a pour-over brewer, and the hinged lid opens wide for straightforward cleaning. A removable whistle cap lets you choose a quiet pour or an audible boil. Compatible with gas and electric ranges; use a low-to-medium flame and keep the handle clear of direct heat.

title: Carved Birch Espresso Cups, Set of Four
description: A set of four small stoneware cups with softly carved vertical lines and a satin cream glaze. Each cup holds 3 ounces, making the size practical for espresso, cortado service, or a small tea tasting. The rounded walls feel comfortable in hand, while the unglazed foot gives each piece a grounded, handmade look. Cups are microwave- and dishwasher-safe. Slight variations in glaze and carving are part of the finish, so no two sets are exactly alike.

title: Carbon Steel Paella Pan with Helper Handles
description: This wide, shallow carbon-steel pan is designed for paella, seared vegetables, and other dishes that benefit from an even layer of heat. The 14-inch cooking surface serves four to six, while two sturdy helper handles make it easier to move from stovetop to table. The pan arrives with a light protective coating that should be washed off before seasoning. Suitable for gas, electric, and outdoor grills; dry thoroughly and apply a thin coat of oil after use.

title: Walnut-Handled Stainless Steel Chai Strainer
description: A fine-mesh stainless-steel strainer catches tea leaves and whole spices when pouring chai, loose-leaf tea, or infused broth. Its walnut handle stays comfortable to hold and includes a small hanging loop for storage near the kettle. The 3-inch basket fits most mugs and small teapots, and the compact shape rinses clean without taking up drawer space. Hand-wash the wooden handle and dry promptly; the mesh basket is suitable for everyday use.

title: Tahini Date and Sesame Crunch Bites
description: These crisp little bites combine toasted sesame seeds, creamy tahini, and chopped dates for a nutty, caramel-like snack with a light crunch. Made in small batches, they pair naturally with afternoon tea or a short coffee and can also be crumbled over yogurt. Each 5-ounce pouch contains bite-size pieces and reseals to help preserve freshness. The recipe contains sesame and may be handled in a facility that processes tree nuts.

title: Slow Sunday Coffee and Waffle Gift Set
description: A relaxed breakfast bundle with a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a jar of vanilla bean waffle mix, and a small tin of cinnamon sugar. The coffee brews with rounded cocoa and toasted almond notes, while the mix makes crisp-edged waffles with a tender center. Packed in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper padding and a printed brewing card. Choose whole bean or have the coffee ground for drip brewing before it ships.

title: The Practical Guide to Handcrafted Noodles
description: This approachable cookbook walks home cooks through mixing, resting, rolling, and shaping fresh noodles with simple equipment. It includes step-by-step instructions for hand-cut wheat noodles, filled dumplings, and a range of sauces built from pantry staples. Clear process notes help readers adjust dough for humidity and different flours, while serving suggestions pair each shape with an easy meal. The hardcover edition has 176 pages and measures 7 by 9 inches, making it easy to keep open on a kitchen counter.

title: Saffron Honey Black Tea
description: A fragrant loose-leaf black tea blended with saffron threads, dried orange peel, and a measured touch of honey granules for a warm, rounded finish. The base brews brisk and full-bodied, with citrus brightness and a subtle floral aroma rather than strong sweetness. The 3-ounce tin keeps the leaves protected from light and moisture and yields roughly 35 cups. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for three to four minutes; add milk if you like a softer cup.

title: Maple Ridge Peru Cajamarca Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast Arabica beans come from small farms in Peru’s Cajamarca region and are roasted in small batches for a balanced everyday cup. Expect notes of milk chocolate, toasted pecan, and dried apple, with a rounded body that works well as drip coffee or espresso. Each bag contains 12 ounces of whole beans in a resealable pouch to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing and adjust the dose to suit your preferred method.

title: Smoked Plum and Vanilla Rooibos Tea
description: A caffeine-free rooibos blend brings together South African red tea, dried plum, vanilla pieces, and a touch of cinnamon. The infusion has a mellow, gently sweet flavor with a soft fruit finish, and it can be enjoyed plain or with a splash of milk. The loose-leaf tea comes in a 3-ounce resealable pouch, enough for approximately 35 cups depending on your measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to six minutes.

title: Ceramic Flat-Bottom Dripper with Walnut Stand
description: This ceramic pour-over dripper is designed for a steady, direct brew into a mug or server. Its flat-bottom opening and three drainage channels support an even drawdown, while the removable walnut stand keeps the hot ceramic off the counter between brews. The dripper fits standard flat-bottom paper filters and measures about 5 inches across. Rinse it with hot water before brewing, add medium-ground coffee, and pour slowly in several passes. Hand-wash the wooden stand.

title: Amber Glass Cortado Cups, Set of Two
description: These small, double-wall borosilicate glass cups are sized for cortados, flat whites, or a short serving of tea. The amber tint gives the clear glass a warm tone while leaving the drink visible, and the insulated walls help reduce heat transfer to your hands. Each cup holds 5 ounces and measures roughly 3 inches tall. The set includes two cups, both suitable for hand-washing; avoid sudden temperature changes to protect the glass.

title: Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Saucier, 2 Quart
description: This 2-quart saucier has rounded interior corners that make it easier to whisk custards, sauces, and grains without leaving food trapped along the edge. A tri-ply construction pairs a stainless-steel cooking surface with an aluminum core for responsive, even heating. The long stay-cool handle is securely riveted, and the fitted stainless lid helps retain heat. It works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops and is dishwasher-safe, though hand-washing helps keep the finish bright.

title: Stainless Steel Herb Scissors with Cleaning Comb
description: Five sharp stainless-steel blades cut fresh herbs into fine pieces with a few quick snips, making these scissors useful for chives, parsley, and mint. Soft-touch handles provide a comfortable grip, and the included comb helps dislodge leaves caught between the blades after use. The scissors measure 7 inches long and come with a protective blade cover for drawer storage. Rinse promptly after cutting herbs, then dry thoroughly; the blades are not intended for hard stems or bones.

title: Miso Sesame Savory Granola
description: Oats, pumpkin seeds, sesame, and crunchy rice are baked with white miso, tamari, and a light touch of maple for a savory snack with balanced salt and sweetness. Sprinkle it over soup, roasted vegetables, or a bowl of yogurt, or eat it straight from the bag. The 7-ounce pouch is packed in small batches and reseals between servings. Contains sesame and soy; made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts.

title: The Slow Morning Coffee and Biscotti Box
description: A relaxed coffee break in one ready-to-gift box: a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a small ceramic coffee scoop, and a pair of almond-orange biscotti. The coffee offers caramel and citrus notes and is roasted for filter brewing. Biscotti are individually wrapped to keep them crisp, while the scoop measures approximately one tablespoon. Packed in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper cushioning, this set is suited to a home brewer or anyone who enjoys a simple morning ritual.

title: The Everyday Wok: Fast Meals from a Hot Pan
description: This practical cookbook focuses on weeknight cooking with a carbon-steel or cast-iron wok, from quick vegetable stir-fries to noodle dishes and crisp-edged dumplings. The 192-page paperback includes clear timing notes, sauce formulas, and guidance on heating and seasoning a wok. Recipes use accessible ingredients and are organized by cooking technique, with a short section on pantry staples and substitutions. A useful reference for cooks who want to build confidence with high-heat meals at home.

title: Brushed Brass Coffee Scoop with Clip
description: This single-piece stainless-steel scoop has a brushed brass-colored finish and a spring clip at the handle end for closing a coffee bag. The bowl holds approximately two tablespoons, making it convenient for measuring ground coffee, tea leaves, or dry pantry staples. At 6 inches long, it reaches easily into most bags and jars. Wipe clean after use and dry promptly; the decorative finish is not intended for dishwasher cleaning or prolonged soaking.

title: Cardamom Cocoa Guatemala Acatenango Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans from Guatemala’s Acatenango region brew with notes of cocoa, toasted almond, and sweet cardamom. The 12-ounce bag is roasted in small batches and sealed in a valve pouch to help preserve freshness. Try them in a drip brewer or French press, or grind fine for a rounded espresso. The coffee is grown at high elevation and works well as an everyday cup for drinkers who prefer gentle sweetness over bright acidity.

title: Lemon Verbena and Ginger Green Tea
description: A lively loose-leaf green tea blended with dried lemon verbena, ginger pieces, and a touch of lemongrass. Each 2.5-ounce tin makes about 25 cups, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for two to three minutes to keep the flavor fresh and balanced. The citrus aroma and warming ginger make it a good choice for an afternoon cup, served plain or with a little honey.

title: Replacement Glass Carafe Lid for Pour-Over Servers
description: A practical replacement lid for compatible 600–800 ml glass coffee servers, made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass with a food-safe silicone ring. The low-profile knob is easy to lift, while the fitted edge helps retain warmth between pours. Measure your server’s opening before ordering; this lid is designed for a 7.5 cm opening and is not a universal fit. Rinse after use and wash by hand to keep the silicone seal in good condition.

title: Pine Green Stoneware Flat White Cup, Set of Two
description: These compact stoneware cups are sized for flat whites, cortados, and small servings of tea. Each holds 6 ounces and has a gently rounded handle that leaves room for a comfortable grip. A glossy pine-green glaze covers the outside, with subtle variations from the firing process; the interiors are smooth and easy to rinse. The pair is microwave- and dishwasher-safe, and the sturdy foot helps protect tabletops from heat.

title: Hard-Anodized Aluminum Tarte Tatin Pan
description: This 10-inch hard-anodized aluminum pan is built for caramelizing fruit on the stovetop and finishing a tarte tatin in the oven. Its heavy base distributes heat steadily, and the wide stainless steel handles provide a secure grip with oven mitts. The pan holds roughly 2 quarts and is oven-safe to 450°F. Use it for upside-down cakes, shallow braises, or skillet-roasted vegetables; hand-washing helps preserve the dark, nonstick interior.

title: Stainless Steel Coffee Dosing Funnel, 58 mm
description: This reusable dosing funnel sits on 58 mm espresso portafilters to guide ground coffee into the basket and reduce countertop spills. It is made from food-grade stainless steel with a smooth, rolled rim and a low-profile magnetic base that stays in place while you distribute grounds. The 1.2-inch height fits beneath most home grinders, though clearance can vary by machine. Rinse after each use or place it in the dishwasher for easy cleanup.

title: Orange Blossom Almond Biscotti
description: Twice-baked almond biscotti flavored with orange zest and a light touch of orange blossom water. The crisp, 6-ounce batch is made with wheat flour, whole almonds, butter, and eggs, then packed in a resealable paper pouch to keep it crunchy. Enjoy a piece alongside espresso or black tea, or dip it briefly into a milky coffee. Contains wheat, dairy, eggs, and tree nuts; store in a cool, dry place after opening.

title: Descaling Solution for Coffee and Tea Appliances
description: A straightforward maintenance solution for removing mineral scale from compatible drip coffee makers, kettles, and espresso machines. The 16-ounce bottle contains a citric-acid-based formula and includes clear dilution directions for routine cleaning. Follow the appliance maker’s instructions, run the recommended rinse cycles, and avoid using the solution on surfaces not approved for descaling. This is a useful pantry-side refill for keeping equipment in working order, rather than a decorative addition to a gift box.

title: Market Morning Coffee and Pancake Gift Box
description: A breakfast-ready assortment with a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a jar of blueberry-lavender pancake syrup, and a cotton tea towel printed with a simple produce-market motif. The coffee offers notes of brown sugar and dried fruit, while the syrup brings a floral berry finish to pancakes or yogurt. Items arrive packed in a kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a blank note card. Choose this set for a host, a new home, or an unhurried weekend breakfast.

title: The Everyday Sourdough Table
description: A practical cookbook for home bakers who want to make sourdough part of everyday meals, not just weekend loaves. The 192-page paperback covers starter care, mixing and shaping, and recipes for seeded sandwich bread, skillet flatbreads, crackers, and bread pudding. Clear ingredient weights and schedule notes help readers plan around a working day. Includes color photographs, a troubleshooting section, and a pantry guide for flour and grains. A useful reference for new bakers and experienced starter keepers alike.

title: Unbleached Cone Coffee Filters, 200 Count

Fold the seam before placing a filter in the dripper, then compost used grounds and paper where local facilities accept them. A useful household refill, not a display piece.

title: Cedar Grove Rwanda Nyamasheke Bourbon Coffee Beans
description: These whole beans come from Bourbon coffee grown in Rwanda’s Nyamasheke district and are roasted to bring out notes of red apple, cocoa, and black tea. The 12-ounce bag is sealed with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness and includes a roast date on the back. Brew them in a drip machine, pour-over, or French press; use a medium grind for most filter methods. A balanced everyday coffee with enough brightness to pair well with breakfast.

title: Roasted Fig and Ceylon Cinnamon Black Tea
description: A warming loose-leaf black tea blended with dried fig pieces, Ceylon cinnamon, and a touch of orange peel. The 3-ounce pouch makes about 35 cups, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon per eight ounces of freshly boiled water for four to five minutes, then enjoy plain or with a splash of milk. The fruit and spice make this a satisfying afternoon cup, and it also works well as the base for a gently sweet iced tea.

title: Compact Ceramic Burr Hand Coffee Grinder
description: Grind fresh coffee at home or on the road with this hand-operated burr grinder, fitted with adjustable ceramic burrs and a stainless steel crank. The glass grounds jar holds enough for roughly two cups, while the screw-top lid keeps beans secure between uses. Turn the adjustment collar to move from coarse French press grounds to a finer setting for pour-over. Its compact 7-inch body fits easily in a cupboard or travel bag; hand wash the glass jar and brush out the burrs after use.

title: Glazed Stoneware Diner Mug in Oatmeal
description: A sturdy stoneware mug with a softly rounded handle and a warm oatmeal glaze that varies slightly from piece to piece. It holds 14 ounces, making it a comfortable size for filter coffee, tea, or a generous latte. The smooth glazed interior rinses clean easily, while the substantial base feels steady on a desk or breakfast table. Suitable for the dishwasher and microwave. Pair it with everyday tableware or keep it by the kettle for a dependable morning cup.

title: Blue Carbon Steel Crepe Pan, 10 Inch
description: This lightweight 10-inch crepe pan is made from blue carbon steel, with a shallow profile that makes flipping pancakes and releasing delicate crepes simple. A welded steel handle offers a secure grip while cooking on gas, electric, or induction stovetops. The pan arrives with a protective coating that should be washed off and seasoned before first use; regular seasoning builds a naturally slick cooking surface. Use medium heat, dry thoroughly after washing, and apply a thin layer of oil before storing.

title: Stainless Steel Tea and Spice Measuring Spoon
description: Measure loose tea, ground spices, or coffee with this compact stainless steel spoon, sized to hold one level tablespoon. Its narrow handle reaches neatly into small tins and resealable pouches, and a hanging loop keeps it close to your tea station. The polished bowl is easy to rinse between ingredients and is dishwasher safe. Use it for consistent portions when steeping a pot of tea or measuring cinnamon into baking recipes. Made from food-grade stainless steel with no coating to chip or peel.

title: Candied Ginger and Dark Chocolate Coffee Bark
description: Thin sheets of dark chocolate are finished with chewy candied ginger and a light sprinkle of toasted cacao nibs for a crisp, warmly spiced treat. Each 4-ounce box contains hand-broken bark pieces packed in a paper-lined carton. Serve alongside black coffee or a malty cup of tea, or crumble a piece over vanilla ice cream. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Made in small batches; the irregular shapes are part of the bark’s simple, handmade presentation.

title: Tea Garden Host Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give collection for someone who likes to slow down over a pot of tea. Tea and honey are packed separately for easy storage.

title: The Weeknight Pantry: Simple Suppers with Beans, Grains, and Greens
description: A practical cookbook of approachable dinners built around pantry staples and seasonal produce. The 192-page paperback includes ingredient notes, flexible substitutions, and clear instructions suited to home cooks with basic equipment. Recipes are organized by the time and effort they require, making it easy to find a meal for a busy evening. A useful companion for stocking and cooking from a small pantry.

title: Insulated Double-Wall Glass Tea Tumblers, Set of Two
description: These 10-ounce borosilicate glass tumblers have double walls that help keep hot tea warm while the outer surface stays comfortable to hold. The clear sides show off layered tea, coffee, or iced drinks, and the gently rounded rims make them pleasant for everyday sipping. Each tumbler measures about 4 inches tall and is lightweight but sturdy for careful daily use. Hand wash to protect the glass and avoid sudden temperature changes. The set includes two tumblers packed in a protective box.

title: Adjustable Stainless Steel Pour-Over Dripper Stand
description: This counter-friendly stand holds a pour-over cone above a mug or server, with an adjustable platform that fits vessels from 3 to 6 inches tall. A stainless steel frame provides a stable base, and the silicone-lined support ring helps keep ceramic and glass drippers in place. Position the platform to suit your cup, add a filter and coffee, then pour slowly over the grounds. The stand disassembles for compact storage and wipes clean with a damp cloth. Dripper, mug, and server are sold separately.

title: Sunlit Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey Process Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast beans come from Costa Rica’s Tarrazú region, where a honey-process drying method brings out notes of apricot, panela, and toasted almond. Grind just before brewing and use with a drip machine, pour-over, or French press.

title: Linden Blossom and Apricot Herbal Tea
description: A fragrant caffeine-free blend of linden flowers, dried apricot, lemon balm, and a little fennel seed. title: Lever-Action Espresso Tamper with Walnut Handle
description: This calibrated tamper helps apply even pressure to a filled espresso basket, with a spring-loaded mechanism designed to keep each press consistent.
