Set the tamper squarely on the coffee bed, press until the spring engages, and wipe the base clean after use.

title: Pressed Glass Pebble Tea Cups, Set of Four
description: These small pressed-glass cups have a pebble-textured exterior that offers a comfortable grip while showing off the color of tea or espresso. Each cup holds 6 ounces and measures about 3 inches across, making the set useful for tasting flights, short coffees, or serving juice. Made from clear soda-lime glass, they are dishwasher safe for everyday cleanup. The four cups arrive nested in a recyclable paperboard box.

title: Hammered Copper-Core Stainless Steel Stockpot, 6 Quart
description: A versatile 6-quart stockpot for simmering broth, cooking pasta, or preparing a batch of beans. Its stainless-steel cooking surface surrounds an aluminum-and-copper core for responsive, even heating, while the hammered exterior adds a subtle kitchen-ready finish. Riveted loop handles provide a secure hold, and the fitted stainless lid helps retain heat. The pot works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops and is oven safe to 500°F; hand washing helps preserve its finish.

title: Olivewood Spatula with Rounded Bowl
description: Carved from solid olivewood, this 12-inch spatula has a shallow rounded bowl for stirring sauces, scraping the sides of a saucepan, or folding batter. Natural grain makes each piece distinct, while the smooth, tapered handle is comfortable for everyday use. The wood is finished with food-safe oil and is suitable for nonstick cookware. Hand wash and dry promptly; an occasional coat of mineral oil helps maintain the wood’s warm color and smooth surface.

title: Meyer Lemon and Pistachio Shortbread
description: Buttery shortbread rounds are baked with finely chopped pistachios and fragrant Meyer lemon zest for a bright, lightly nutty bite. The cookies are made in small batches with wheat flour, cultured butter, sugar, pistachios, and real citrus zest. A 7-ounce tin holds approximately 14 cookies, packed in a parchment liner to help keep them crisp. Serve alongside black tea or coffee, or open the tin as an easy dessert after dinner.

title: Tea and Citrus Marmalade Brunch Gift Box
description: A cheerful brunch assortment with a tin of loose-leaf English breakfast tea, a jar of small-batch orange and bergamot marmalade, and a cotton tea towel in a simple stripe. The tea tin contains 2 ounces, while the 8-ounce marmalade is made with citrus, sugar, and lemon juice. Packed in a sturdy kraft gift box with paper cushioning, it is ready to give for a housewarming or weekend visit. Add hot water and toast for an easy morning spread.

title: The Open-Fire Kitchen: Skillets, Coals, and Simple Suppers
description: This practical cookbook explores cooking over a backyard fire pit, charcoal grill, or a bed of embers, with recipes arranged by heat and technique. Find instructions for skillet cornbread, coal-roasted vegetables, grilled flatbreads, and simple fruit desserts, along with guidance on managing fire and choosing cast iron. The hardcover includes 160 pages, full-color photographs, and a lay-flat binding for use at the counter. It suits curious home cooks who want to take weeknight meals outdoors.

title: Stackable Stoneware Coffee Tasting Set
description: Designed for comparing brews, this set includes three stackable stoneware cups with a matte sand glaze and a contrasting dark clay foot. Each cup holds 4 ounces, a useful size for espresso, coffee cuppings, or a small after-dinner tea. The sturdy ceramic walls retain warmth without making the cups cumbersome to hold. Microwave and dishwasher safe, the cups nest together for compact storage and arrive in a protective box suitable for gifting.

title: Hand-Cranked Stainless Steel Tea Roller
description: This compact hand-cranked roller helps shape homemade tea leaves or crush dried herbs for a more even infusion. A stainless steel drum turns against a stable base, while the removable handle stores flat for a tidy drawer. The roller measures 7 inches long and includes a small cleaning brush for clearing leaf fragments from the drum. Use it with thoroughly dried leaves on a clean surface, then wash the removable parts by hand and dry fully before storage.

title: Toasted Pecan and Molasses Brazil Cerrado Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast Brazil Cerrado beans bring notes of toasted pecan, cocoa, and dark molasses, with a rounded body that works well in drip coffee and espresso. The 12-ounce bag contains whole beans roasted in small batches and packed in a resealable, one-way-valve pouch to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for the most aromatic cup. A smooth, low-acidity profile makes this a versatile choice for everyday coffee or milk-based drinks.

title: Wild Blueberry and Lemon Balm White Tea
description: A light, fragrant loose-leaf white tea blended with dried wild blueberries, lemon balm, and a touch of orange peel. The delicate cup has soft berry notes and a fresh herbal finish without added flavoring or sweetener. Each tin contains 2.5 ounces of tea, enough for approximately 30 cups depending on the amount used. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for three to four minutes, then enjoy plain or with a little honey.

title: Precision Gooseneck Kettle with Built-In Thermometer
description: Pour water in a controlled, steady stream with this stainless steel gooseneck kettle, designed for pour-over coffee and carefully steeped tea. Its narrow spout offers precise flow, while the lid-mounted thermometer makes it easy to monitor water temperature at a glance. The kettle holds 1 liter and has a heat-resistant handle with a balanced grip. Suitable for stovetop use on gas and electric burners; hand washing is recommended to keep the brushed finish looking its best.

title: Speckled Stoneware Cappuccino Bowl
description: This wide stoneware cup is shaped for cappuccino, café au lait, or a generous serving of tea. A warm cream glaze with charcoal speckles gives each piece a slightly varied, handmade character, while the rounded handle leaves room for a comfortable grip. The cup holds 10 ounces and measures about 3.5 inches across. It is finished with a durable, food-safe glaze and is suitable for the microwave and dishwasher for easy everyday use.

title: Hammered Stainless Steel Milk Pan, 1.5 Quart
description: Warm milk, melt butter, or prepare a small batch of sauce in this 1.5-quart stainless steel pan. Its softly hammered exterior adds texture, while the smooth interior makes it easy to stir and clean. A long riveted handle provides a secure grip, and a rolled rim helps pour liquids neatly. The compact pan works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops. Hand wash with mild detergent and dry promptly to maintain its polished finish.

title: Flexible Silicone Bowl Scraper, Set of Three
description: Scrape dough from mixing bowls, fold batters, and smooth frosting with this set of three flexible bowl scrapers. Each scraper is made from food-grade silicone with a firm edge that bends to follow curved bowls without scratching them. The set includes one each in rust, sage, and cream, with a small hanging hole for convenient storage. Heat resistant to 400°F, they can also be used to spread soft fillings and are safe for the dishwasher.

title: Rosemary Sea Salt Focaccia Crackers
description: Thin, crisp crackers made with wheat flour, olive oil, dried rosemary, and flaky sea salt. Their savory herb flavor pairs well with soft cheeses, hummus, or a cup of strong coffee for an afternoon snack. Each 5-ounce bag is baked in small batches and packed in a resealable pouch to help retain its crunch. Serve them straight from the bag or arrange on a cheese board with olives and seasonal fruit.

title: Coffeehouse Brunch Pantry Gift Crate
description: A ready-to-give collection for relaxed weekend breakfasts, packed in a reusable kraft-paper crate. It includes a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a jar of wildflower honey, a small-batch strawberry preserve, and a packet of buttermilk pancake mix. The assortment serves as an easy brunch starter for two to four people; coffee is best brewed fresh, and opened pantry items should be refrigerated as directed on their labels. A printed contents card is included.

title: The Modern Home Tea Table: Infusions, Pairings, and Rituals
description: This approachable guide explores how to brew and serve tea at home, from choosing water and steeping temperatures to building balanced tea-and-food pairings. More than 60 recipes include iced infusions, simple tea cakes, savory snacks, and seasonal drinks. The hardcover book has 176 illustrated pages, a lay-flat binding, and practical brewing charts for common tea styles. It is suited to curious beginners as well as regular tea drinkers looking to bring more variety to their daily cup.

title: Single-Origin Decaf Mexico Chiapas Mountain Water Coffee
description: Enjoy a full-flavored cup without the caffeine with these medium-dark roasted beans from Chiapas, Mexico. The beans are decaffeinated using a mountain water process and offer notes of baker’s chocolate, toasted almond, and gentle brown sugar. Choose a 10-ounce or 2-pound bag of whole beans to suit your coffee routine. This balanced decaf is suitable for French press, drip, and espresso brewing; grind to match your method just before making a pot.

title: Linen-Blend Coffee Filter Storage Roll
description: Keep reusable cloth coffee filters clean and close at hand with this roll-up storage pouch, sewn from a sturdy linen-cotton blend. Three stitched pockets hold flat or cone-shaped filters up to 6 inches wide, while a cotton tie secures the roll in a drawer or on a hook. The pouch measures 12 by 8 inches when open and folds down for compact storage. It is intended for dry, clean filters and can be machine washed on a gentle cycle.

title: Night Ferry Kenya Kirinyaga AA Coffee Beans
description: These washed Kenya Kirinyaga AA beans brew a lively cup with blackcurrant, ruby grapefruit, and a honeyed finish. Roasted in small batches for filter brewing, they suit pour-over, drip machines, and immersion brewers. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Keep the beans sealed in a cool, dry place and grind just before brewing for the clearest fruit notes.

title: Roasted Barley and Yuzu Peel Herbal Infusion
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf infusion combining toasted barley, dried yuzu peel, and a little roasted chicory. The cup is gently nutty with a bright citrus aroma, suited to an after-dinner pot or an iced brew on warm afternoons. Each tin contains 3.5 ounces of tea, enough for about 35 servings. Steep one rounded teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five minutes, then strain; add honey if you prefer a softer finish.

title: Stainless Steel Paper Filter Refills, 200 Pack
description: A practical refill of 200 disposable paper filters for flat-bottom pour-over brewers. The unbleached, chlorine-free paper helps catch fine grounds while allowing coffee oils to pass into the cup. Each filter measures 185 millimeters across and fits compatible brewers with a wide, flat base; check your dripper dimensions before ordering. Rinse the filter with hot water, add ground coffee, and brew as usual. This bulk pack is designed for regular home or office use.

title: Fluted Porcelain Demitasse Cup and Saucer
description: This compact demitasse set pairs a fluted porcelain cup with a matching saucer, sized for espresso, Turkish coffee, or a small tea service. The cup holds 3 ounces and has a gently curved handle that leaves room for a comfortable grip. Fired porcelain gives the set a smooth, durable glaze, while its simple ivory finish sits easily with everyday tableware. Dishwasher safe; use the saucer to catch a spoon or a small square of chocolate.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Bread Oven, 5 Quart
description: Designed for crusty home-baked loaves, this 5-quart enameled cast iron bread oven holds steady heat and traps steam beneath its domed lid. The oval shape accommodates a standard boule or batard, while the cream enamel interior makes browning easy to monitor. Use it in ovens up to 500°F; preheat the base and lid carefully with dry oven mitts. The enamel surface needs no seasoning and cleans with warm water and a soft sponge.

title: Beechwood Dough Whisk with Stainless Steel Loop
description: This sturdy dough whisk combines a smooth beechwood handle with a stainless steel loop for mixing thick batters and bread doughs. Its open shape works through flour and liquid without packing ingredients into a balloon whisk, and the 12-inch length keeps hands clear of the bowl. Use it for pancake batter, sourdough starters, or quick mixing of a small loaf. Hand wash and dry promptly to preserve the wood handle; not intended for soaking.

title: Sour Cherry and Rye Crumble Biscotti
description: Twice-baked biscotti made with toasted rye flour, dried sour cherries, sliced almonds, and a touch of orange zest. The crisp, sturdy pieces are made for dipping into coffee or black tea, but are also easy to serve alongside a bowl of fruit. Each resealable pouch contains eight individually sized biscotti, baked in small batches and packed for freshness. Store in a cool, dry cupboard and enjoy within two weeks of opening.

title: The First Cup Breakfast and Brew Gift Crate
description: A ready-to-give breakfast crate with a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast coffee, a jar of wildflower honey, and a small batch of buttermilk pancake mix. The coffee has a round, chocolate-and-pecan profile suited to drip brewers and French presses. Pancake mix makes about 12 pancakes, while the honey adds an easy finishing touch at the table. Packed in a reusable kraft gift crate with a printed brew and cooking card; recipient supplies milk, eggs, and butter.

title: Everyday Stainless Steel Coffee Filter Basket
description: A reusable fine-mesh filter basket for single-cup coffee makers and compatible pour-over drippers. The 304 stainless steel mesh lets more natural coffee oils through than paper filters, producing a fuller-bodied cup without disposable liners. It measures 4.3 inches across at the rim and 3 inches deep; compare those dimensions with your brewer before use. Rinse grounds into compost after brewing, then wash with warm soapy water. A useful replacement for worn baskets or a low-waste daily brewing setup.

title: The Art of the Tea Tray: Brewing and Small Bites
description: This illustrated 192-page cookbook explores relaxed tea service at home, from steeping loose leaves to assembling savory and sweet bites for a small gathering. Recipes include sesame cucumber sandwiches, miso shortbread, and poached pear with black tea syrup, with practical guidance on timing and portions. A short reference section covers water temperature, leaf amounts, and teaware choices for common tea styles. Softcover format measures 7.5 by 9 inches and lies flat enough for kitchen-counter reading.

title: Replacement Silicone Seal Ring for Tea Infuser Flask
description: A replacement food-grade silicone seal ring for the screw-top lid of compatible 16-ounce glass tea infuser flasks. The ring helps reduce leaks when carrying brewed tea in a bag or lunch tote, and can be removed for cleaning. Check your flask model and compare the 2.1-inch outer diameter before purchasing, as this part is not universal. Wash by hand with mild dish soap and let it dry fully before fitting into the lid groove. Sold individually.

title: Cocoa Nib and Blood Orange Ethiopia Guji Coffee Beans
description: These whole beans from Ethiopia’s Guji zone are roasted to a medium profile that keeps their lively citrus character in balance with cocoa-like sweetness. Expect notes of blood orange, cacao nib, and a soft honey finish. The 12-ounce bag has a one-way valve and a resealable closure to help preserve freshness after opening. Grind just before brewing for pour-over, drip, or French press; use a slightly finer grind for espresso. Roast date and origin details are printed on the back.

title: Rose Petal and Lychee White Peony Tea
description: A loose-leaf white tea blend pairing delicate white peony leaves with rose petals and fragrant lychee pieces. The cup is lightly floral and gently sweet, suited to a quiet afternoon or a simple dessert pairing. Each 2.5-ounce pouch makes about 25 cups, depending on how much leaf you use. Steep one teaspoon per cup in water just below boiling for three to four minutes. Reseal the pouch between uses and store it away from heat and direct sunlight.

title: Borosilicate Glass Immersion Coffee Brewer, 700 ml
description: Brew a full pot or a generous pair of cups with this immersion coffee brewer, made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass with a stainless steel mesh filter. Its 700 ml capacity suits coarse-ground coffee steeped directly in the vessel, then poured through the filter for a clean, full-bodied cup. The removable filter and glass body separate for hand washing, and the broad handle provides a steady grip when serving. Includes the brewer and fitted lid; coffee and serving cups are sold separately.

title: Terracotta Stripe Porcelain Tea Mug, Set of Two
description: This pair of porcelain mugs has a warm terracotta stripe applied around the lower half, with a clear glaze over the drinking surface. Each mug holds 12 ounces and has a comfortable loop handle sized for an easy everyday grip. The gently tapered shape works for tea, filter coffee, or a generous serving of hot chocolate. Made for regular use, the mugs are dishwasher safe; avoid sudden temperature changes to help protect the ceramic. Set includes two matching mugs.

title: Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven with Lid, 5.5 Quart
description: A 5.5-quart enameled cast iron Dutch oven for slow braises, soups, beans, and crusty no-knead bread. The heavy pot retains heat steadily, while the smooth cream-colored enamel interior makes it easy to monitor browning and clean after cooking. A fitted lid helps hold moisture, and two side handles make lifting manageable with oven mitts. Suitable for stovetop and oven use up to 450°F; use on low to medium heat and choose a burner close to the pot’s base diameter. Hand washing is recommended.

title: Stainless Steel Citrus Press with Hinged Handles
description: Extract juice from lemons and small limes without seeds or a bulky countertop juicer. This handheld press is made from polished stainless steel with a hinged bowl and long handles that provide leverage during use. Place a halved fruit cut-side down in the bowl and squeeze over a glass, mixing bowl, or pan. The compact tool measures about 8 inches long and stores easily in a utensil drawer. Rinse after pressing and wash by hand or in the dishwasher; dry promptly to keep the finish bright.

title: Coffee and Tea Tasting Flight Gift Box
description: A tasting set for curious drinkers, with two 4-ounce bags of whole-bean coffee and two 1-ounce pouches of loose-leaf tea. The coffee selections offer contrasting roast profiles, while the teas include one black blend and one herbal infusion; current varieties and tasting notes are listed on the box insert. Packaged in a sturdy kraft gift box with a simple brewing guide and tasting cards. A thoughtful pick for a host, new home, or weekend brunch. Includes no brewing equipment or cups.

title: The Pantry Pasta Book: Fresh Shapes and Everyday Sauces
description: This approachable cookbook brings together recipes for fresh pasta shapes, pantry-friendly sauces, and simple seasonal accompaniments. It includes step-by-step instructions for mixing and rolling dough by hand, plus guidance for matching shapes with sauces. Recipes range from quick weeknight tomato butter to weekend filled pasta, with ingredient notes for common flour and egg substitutions. The hardcover edition has 192 pages and color photography throughout. A useful reference for home cooks who want to make pasta without specialized equipment beyond a rolling pin and a sharp knife.

title: Foldable Walnut Pour-Over Coffee Stand
description: A compact pour-over stand made from solid walnut, designed to hold a dripper above a mug, carafe, or server. Its hinged frame folds flat for storage or travel, while the crossbar supports a variety of small and medium drippers. The stand measures 7 inches tall when open and fits vessels up to about 4.5 inches wide. Use it with your preferred paper or reusable filter and pour slowly over freshly ground coffee. Wipe clean with a damp cloth; dripper, filter, and serving vessel are not included.

title: Hearthside Colombia Huila Washed Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from small farms in Colombia’s Huila region, where washed processing brings a clean, rounded cup. Expect notes of red apple, milk chocolate, and toasted almond, with enough sweetness for both filter coffee and espresso. Each bag contains 12 ounces of freshly roasted beans in a resealable, one-way valve pouch. Grind just before brewing and adjust the grind to suit your method, from a paper-filter dripper to a moka pot.

title: Bergamot Pear and Sage Green Tea
description: A fragrant loose-leaf green tea blended with dried pear, bergamot peel, and a small amount of culinary sage. The pear softens the tea’s fresh vegetal character, while citrusy bergamot adds a bright finish. Packaged in a resealable 2.5-ounce tin, it makes approximately 25 cups when measured at one teaspoon per serving. Steep in water just below boiling for two to three minutes, then serve plain or alongside a light pastry.

title: Stainless Steel Siphon Coffee Brewer, 5 Cup
description: Brew a clear, aromatic cup with this tabletop siphon coffee brewer, made with heat-resistant borosilicate glass, stainless steel fittings, and a reusable cloth filter. The 5-cup capacity yields about 20 ounces of coffee, suitable for sharing or serving a few small pours. Add water to the lower chamber and ground coffee to the upper globe, then heat and stir as the water rises. Includes a stand, filter, and cloth storage clip; burner sold separately.

title: Hand-Thrown Stoneware Tea Bowl in Moss
description: A gently curved stoneware bowl for matcha, loose-leaf tea, or a small serving of coffee. Each 12-ounce cup is thrown and glazed by hand, with a moss-green exterior and a soft cream interior; subtle variations in glaze and shape make every piece distinct. The rounded profile feels comfortable in the hands and leaves room for whisking matcha. Food-safe and suitable for microwave use, it should be hand-washed to preserve its finish.

title: Enamel-on-Steel Roasting Pan with Rack
description: Roast vegetables, chicken, or a small joint of meat in this sturdy enamel-on-steel pan. The 14-by-10-inch pan includes a removable stainless steel rack that lifts food above drippings and helps air circulate during cooking. Its cream enamel interior releases food easily and wipes clean after use, while broad side handles make it easier to move with oven mitts. Suitable for ovens up to 450°F; allow the pan to cool before washing and avoid abrasive cleaners.

title: Beechwood Coffee Tamper and Distribution Tool
description: Prepare espresso grounds with this two-in-one tool, featuring a flat stainless steel tamper on one end and a short distribution needle on the other. The smooth beechwood handle is shaped for a comfortable grip, and the 51 mm tamper base fits many home espresso baskets; check your portafilter measurement before ordering. Use the needles to break up clumps, then turn the tool over to tamp evenly. Wipe clean after each use and keep the wood handle dry.

title: Crispy Chickpeas with Aleppo Pepper and Lime
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas seasoned with warm Aleppo pepper, dried lime, and a touch of sea salt. This 5-ounce pouch makes an easy snack alongside tea or coffee and can also add texture to salads, soups, and grain bowls. The chickpeas are roasted in small batches and packed in a resealable bag to help preserve their crispness after opening. Contains chickpeas; made in a facility that also handles sesame and tree nuts.

title: Evening Tea and Honey Pairing Gift Box
description: A calming tea-time assortment packed in a recyclable kraft box, with a 1.5-ounce tin of chamomile and lemon balm herbal infusion, a 4-ounce jar of wildflower honey, and a small stainless steel tea infuser. The infusion is naturally caffeine-free and brews into a soft, floral cup that pairs well with the honey. A printed card gives steeping directions and serving suggestions. The box is ready to give for a host, a quiet-night ritual, or a thoughtful thank-you.

title: The Home Coffee Bar: A Guide to Brewing and Serving
description: A practical, illustrated guide to setting up a home coffee station and making dependable drinks with everyday equipment. The book covers grind size, water temperature, pour-over technique, French press, cold brew, and simple milk drinks, with recipes scaled for one or two servings. A troubleshooting section helps readers adjust a brew that tastes weak, bitter, or uneven. Softcover, 192 pages, with step-by-step photographs and a compact equipment checklist for beginners and curious coffee drinkers alike.

title: Cedar-Handle Stainless Steel Tea Kettle, 1.2 L
description: A compact stovetop kettle with a brushed stainless steel body and a warm cedarwood handle and lid knob. Its 1.2-liter capacity is sized for several cups of tea or a small pour-over session, and the narrow spout helps direct water steadily into a teapot or dripper. A hinged lid opens wide for filling and rinsing. Suitable for gas and electric stovetops; use a low to medium flame and keep the wooden handle away from direct heat.

title: Roasted Hazelnut and Pear Coffee Syrup
description: A small-batch coffee syrup made with ripe pear, toasted hazelnut, cane sugar, and a pinch of salt. Stir a spoonful into hot or iced coffee, drizzle over oatmeal, or use it to sweeten a latte or dessert. Each 8-ounce glass bottle includes a pour-control insert for measured servings. The syrup is made without artificial coloring and should be refrigerated after opening. Shake gently before use, as natural settling may occur over time.

title: Rainshadow Peru Cajamarca Washed Coffee Beans
description: These single-origin arabica beans come from high-altitude farms in Peru’s Cajamarca region, where a washed process keeps the cup clear and balanced. Expect notes of red apple, panela, and cocoa with a rounded finish. Choose a 12-ounce bag for a steady everyday brew or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Grind just before brewing and use with a pour-over, drip machine, or French press. The beans are roasted in small batches and packed in a resealable valve bag.

title: Saffron Peach and Rooibos Evening Tea
description: A naturally caffeine-free loose-leaf blend of South African rooibos, dried peach, calendula, and a delicate touch of saffron. The infusion is mellow and honeyed, with ripe fruit aroma and a gentle floral finish. Each tin contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for about 35 cups when brewed with one teaspoon per 8-ounce serving. Steep in freshly boiled water for five to six minutes, then enjoy plain or with a little milk. Store sealed in a cool, dry cupboard.

title: Countertop Burr Coffee Grinder with Oak Dial
description: Grind beans for filter coffee, French press, or espresso with this compact electric burr grinder. Its stainless steel conical burrs offer 30 stepped settings, while the oak adjustment dial makes changes easy to see and turn. The removable hopper holds 250 grams of whole beans, and the grounds cup is sized for a full batch of drip coffee. A low-speed motor helps limit heat during grinding. Wipe the exterior with a soft cloth and brush the burr chamber regularly.

title: Cobalt Blue Porcelain Espresso Cups, Set of Two
description: These small porcelain cups bring a saturated cobalt glaze to espresso service without taking up much cupboard space. Each cup holds 3 ounces and has a gently tapered shape that fits comfortably in the hand. The durable porcelain body retains warmth between pulls, and the glazed finish is suitable for the dishwasher and microwave. A pair makes a practical addition to a home espresso setup or a thoughtful gift for someone who enjoys short coffee breaks. Includes two matching cups.

title: Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Sauté Pan with Glass Lid
description: This 11-inch sauté pan pairs a stainless steel cooking surface with an aluminum core for responsive, even heating. Its straight sides provide room for searing vegetables, simmering sauces, or cooking grains, while the fitted tempered-glass lid makes it easy to check food as it cooks. The long riveted handle stays steady during stovetop use, and the pan works on gas, electric, and induction ranges. It has a 3-quart capacity and can go in the oven up to 400°F without its lid.

title: Acacia Wood Tea Scoop with Ceramic Rest
description: Measure loose-leaf tea with a smooth acacia wood scoop designed to hold roughly one teaspoon of leaves. The short handle makes it easy to reach into a tea tin, and a small glazed ceramic rest keeps the scoop off the counter between servings. Natural wood grain varies from piece to piece, giving each scoop a slightly different appearance. Hand wash the wood with mild soap and dry promptly; the ceramic rest is dishwasher safe. A simple everyday tool for a tea station.

title: Maple Chili Espresso Brownie Bites
description: Rich cocoa brownie bites get a lift from finely ground espresso, maple sugar, and a restrained pinch of chili. The soft-centered pieces are baked in small batches and packed in a 6-ounce paper-lined tin, ready to share with coffee or tuck into a lunch bag. They contain wheat, eggs, and dairy, and are made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts. Serve at room temperature, or warm briefly for a softer texture. Keep sealed and enjoy within five days of opening.

title: Coffee Break for Two Gift Box
description: Set up an easy coffee break with a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast house beans, two handmade stoneware snack plates, and a small pouch of salted oat cookies. The coffee is roasted for balanced drip and French press brewing, with notes of caramel and toasted almond. Each plate measures 6 inches across and has a softly speckled glaze; slight variations are part of the finish. Packed in a recyclable kraft box with paper cushioning, this set is ready to give for a housewarming or thank-you.

title: The Practical Guide to Tea Blending at Home
description: This illustrated paperback introduces the building blocks of flavorful tea blends, from choosing a base leaf to balancing herbs, citrus peel, spices, and flowers. Clear recipes include a roasted barley and mint blend, a warming ginger chai, and a gentle evening infusion, with steeping guidance for each. A pantry chapter covers storage, measuring, and sourcing ingredients in small quantities. At 176 pages, it is sized for a kitchen shelf and useful for beginners as well as tea drinkers ready to create their own combinations.

title: Handblown Glass Coffee Server, 600 ml
description: Serve pour-over coffee or loose-leaf tea in this clear, handblown borosilicate glass server. Its 600 ml capacity holds about two generous mugs, and the curved spout pours neatly into cups without a separate lid. A narrow neck provides a secure grip, while the flat base sits steadily on a countertop or warming plate. The glass can handle hot brewed beverages and is dishwasher safe, though hand washing helps preserve its clarity. Each server may show subtle variations from the glassblowing process.

title: Acacia and Stainless Steel Pasta Tongs
description: Lift long pasta, turn vegetables, or serve salad with these 9-inch tongs, made with stainless steel gripping ends and smooth acacia handles. The scalloped tips hold slippery noodles securely, while the spring hinge gives a comfortable opening and closing action. A locking tab keeps the tongs compact in a drawer, and a hanging loop offers another storage option. Hand wash and dry promptly to protect the wood handles. A useful everyday utensil for stovetop cooking and serving straight from the pan.

title: Maple Campfire Guatemala Huehuetenango Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from small farms in Guatemala’s Huehuetenango highlands. Expect a rounded cup with notes of maple, baked apple, and cocoa, suited to drip brewers, French presses, and espresso. Each bag contains 12 ounces of freshly roasted beans in a resealable kraft pouch with a one-way valve. Grind just before brewing and adjust the dose to your preferred strength. Roast dates are printed on the package so you can choose beans at their freshest.

title: Lemon Verbena and Green Cardamom Loose Leaf Tea
description: Bright lemon verbena meets warming green cardamom in this loose-leaf herbal blend, balanced with a little lemongrass. The caffeine-free infusion makes an easy after-dinner cup or a refreshing iced tea. A 2.5-ounce resealable tin provides approximately 25 servings, depending on how generously you measure. Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for five to seven minutes, then strain. The blend is made for a clear, aromatic brew without added sweeteners or flavor syrups.

title: Replacement Glass Carafe Lid for 600 ml Coffee Server
description: A practical replacement lid for compatible 600 ml glass coffee servers, designed to help keep dust out between pours. The clear borosilicate glass sits neatly in the server’s neck and has a small knob for easy lifting. It measures approximately 2.5 inches across; check your server opening before ordering, as fit varies by maker. This is a single spare part, not a complete carafe. Hand-wash with warm, soapy water and handle carefully around hard surfaces.

title: Cobalt Speckle Stoneware Latte Cup
description: This generously sized stoneware cup has a soft ivory glaze scattered with cobalt-blue speckles and a comfortable loop handle. Its 14-ounce capacity suits lattes, long blacks, or a generous serving of tea. The rounded shape helps retain heat while leaving room for milk foam, and the sturdy base sits securely on a desk or breakfast table. Each cup is approximately 4 inches tall. Dishwasher- and microwave-safe, it is made for regular use rather than display alone.

title: Hard-Anodized Aluminum Saucepan with Pouring Rim, 2 Quart
description: A compact 2-quart saucepan for warming milk, simmering grains, or making a small batch of sauce. The hard-anodized aluminum body heats evenly, while the stainless steel handle stays firmly riveted for a steady grip. A shaped pouring rim helps guide liquids into cups and bowls with less dribbling. The pan measures about 6.5 inches across and includes a tempered glass lid with a steam vent. Compatible with gas and electric cooktops; hand-wash to protect the finish.

title: Stainless Steel Bench Scraper with Measurement Marks
description: This sturdy bench scraper helps portion bread dough, divide pastry, and gather chopped vegetables from a cutting board. Its stainless steel blade measures 6 by 3.5 inches and has etched inch markings along the top edge for quick reference. A broad, nonslip handle offers room for a comfortable grip, while the straight edge cleans flour and scraps from counters. Rinse promptly after use and wash by hand or in the dishwasher. A simple, useful tool for home bakers and everyday prep.

title: Honey Sesame Espresso Brittle
description: Thin sheets of buttery brittle combine toasted sesame seeds, local-style wildflower honey, and a measured touch of espresso. The result is crisp and lightly bittersweet, made for nibbling alongside coffee or crumbling over vanilla ice cream. Each 5-ounce pouch contains irregular pieces packed in a resealable, food-safe bag to help preserve their crunch. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Contains sesame, dairy, and may contain traces of peanuts from shared production equipment.

title: Slow Sunday Coffee and Waffle Gift Box
description: A breakfast-ready assortment for an unhurried morning, packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with crinkle paper and a printed note card. Inside are a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a small jar of blueberry preserves, and a 12-ounce pouch of buttermilk waffle mix. The coffee has notes of caramel and toasted almond and can be ground at home for any brew method. Add your own milk, eggs, and butter when preparing the waffles. Contents are listed on the enclosed ingredient cards.

title: The Small-Batch Pickle Kitchen: Brines, Ferments, and Quick Pickles
description: This 192-page cookbook focuses on pickling vegetables at home, from quick refrigerator cucumbers to naturally fermented carrots and seasonal relishes. Clear instructions cover salt ratios, jar preparation, storage, and ways to use each batch alongside everyday meals. Recipes are organized by method and produce, with pantry notes and simple serving ideas throughout. The paperback measures 7 by 9 inches and includes full-color photographs. It is designed for curious home cooks, with options ranging from same-day pickles to longer ferments.

title: Stainless Steel Pour-Over Filter Paper, 100 Count
description: A refill pack of 100 unbleached paper filters for compatible flat-bottom pour-over drippers. The filters are made from chlorine-free paper and fold along the seam for a snug fit before brewing. Rinse each filter with hot water to reduce papery taste and warm your brewer, then add ground coffee and pour slowly. This listing is for consumable refills only; dripper and coffee are not included. Store the stack in a dry cupboard to keep the papers clean and ready for daily use.

title: Cocoa Dusk Sumatra Gayo Wet-Hulled Coffee Beans
description: These single-origin beans from the Gayo Highlands of Sumatra are wet-hulled for a full-bodied cup with notes of cocoa, cedar, and dried plum. The medium-dark roast works well in a French press, drip brewer, or espresso machine. Choose a 12-ounce bag for everyday brewing or a 2-pound bag for a well-stocked coffee shelf. Beans are packed whole in a resealable, light-blocking pouch to help preserve freshness between brews.

title: Cucumber Mint and Sencha Green Tea
description: A crisp loose-leaf blend of Japanese sencha, dried cucumber, and spearmint makes a refreshing cup hot or chilled. The green tea base brings a clean, grassy flavor, while cucumber and mint add a cool finish without added sweetener. Each tin contains 3 ounces of tea, enough for approximately 35 cups when brewed with one teaspoon per 8-ounce serving. Steep in water just below boiling for two to three minutes.

title: Compact Ceramic Burr Coffee Grinder
description: This hand-powered burr grinder offers adjustable settings for espresso, pour-over, and French press. Ceramic conical burrs grind beans evenly, while the stainless steel crank folds down for compact storage. Its clear grounds chamber holds up to 30 grams, and the silicone grip helps keep the grinder steady during use. Remove the crank and chamber for brushing out loose grounds; the burr assembly is not intended for washing under water.

title: Celadon Stoneware Cortado Cups, Set of Two
description: These small stoneware cups are sized for cortados, macchiatos, and tasting pours. Each holds 4 ounces and has a gently curved rim that feels comfortable for sipping without a handle. A soft celadon glaze varies subtly from cup to cup, with an unglazed foot for a steady tabletop finish. The pair is microwave- and dishwasher-safe, and arrives nestled in a recyclable kraft box for easy gifting.

title: Beechwood Tea Chest with Six Compartments
description: Keep tea sachets organized in this lidded beechwood chest, divided into six compartments for sorting by blend or occasion. The clear acrylic window lets you see the contents without opening the box, while simple brass-tone hinges allow the lid to lift smoothly. It measures 12 by 8 inches and fits most individually wrapped tea bags. Wipe the wood with a soft, dry cloth; tea bags are not included.

title: Smoked Maple Coffee-Glazed Almonds
description: Whole roasted almonds are coated with a thin coffee glaze made with brewed coffee, maple syrup, and a touch of smoked salt. The result is a crunchy snack with a balanced sweet-and-bitter finish, suitable alongside a morning cup or packed for an afternoon break. Each 6-ounce resealable pouch contains approximately six servings. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts and dairy; store sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Sunday Brew and Biscuit Gift Box
description: This ready-to-give box pairs a 12-ounce bag of medium-roast coffee with a ceramic pour-over cone and a small batch of buttery oat biscuits. The coffee offers caramel and toasted almond notes and is packed whole bean for grinding at home. The cone fits standard mugs and uses size 02 paper filters, sold separately. Items are arranged in a kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a printed card for your message.

title: The Everyday Broth Kitchen: Bowls, Stocks, and Seasonal Meals
description: This practical cookbook explores homemade broth as a starting point for weeknight cooking, with recipes for vegetable, chicken, and mushroom stocks alongside soups, rice dishes, and noodle bowls. Clear step-by-step instructions include storage guidance and options for using pantry ingredients. The 192-page paperback features color photographs, a seasonal recipe index, and measurements in both US customary and metric units. A useful kitchen reference for cooks building meals around a pot of broth.

title: Double-Wall Stainless Steel Tea Infuser Bottle
description: Brew loose-leaf tea on the go with this insulated stainless steel bottle, which includes a removable fine-mesh infuser basket. The 16-ounce capacity suits a long commute or a desk-side refill, and the double-wall construction helps keep drinks warm without making the exterior hot to hold. Use the infuser for tea or remove it for water and iced drinks. The screw-top lid has a silicone seal; hand-wash the bottle and basket for easier care.

title: Black Sesame and Matcha Tea Cake Mix
description: This pantry-friendly mix makes a tender tea cake with earthy matcha and toasted black sesame. Add eggs, milk, and melted butter, then stir and bake in a standard loaf pan for a simple afternoon treat. The 14-ounce pouch includes the dry ingredients and a small packet of sesame seeds for the top; wet ingredients and pan are not included. Serve plain with tea or lightly dusted with powdered sugar. Store unopened in a cool, dry cupboard.

title: Apricot Jam and Cacao Nib El Salvador Apaneca Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast whole beans come from El Salvador’s Apaneca region, where high-grown coffee develops a rounded sweetness. Expect notes of dried apricot, cacao nib, and soft caramel, with a smooth finish suited to everyday brewing. The 12-ounce bag is sealed with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing for pour-over, drip, or French press; use a slightly finer grind for espresso. Store the bag in a cool, dry cupboard and reseal after opening.

title: Smoked Plum and Ginger Black Tea
description: A loose-leaf black tea blend layered with dried plum, ginger pieces, and a restrained touch of natural smoke. The brisk Assam and Chinese black tea base makes a full-bodied cup that pairs well with breakfast or a late-afternoon snack. Each 3-ounce pouch brews approximately 35 cups, depending on leaf quantity. Steep one teaspoon per 8 ounces of water just off the boil for three to four minutes. Enjoy plain, or add a splash of milk for a rounder finish.

title: Stainless Steel Flat-Bottom Coffee Dripper with Walnut Handle
description: This reusable pour-over dripper pairs a fine perforated stainless steel brewing cone with a removable walnut handle that stays comfortable during pouring. Its flat-bottom design helps water spread evenly through the grounds, while the open construction makes it easy to rinse clean. Sized for one to four cups, it fits most standard mugs and carafes. Add medium-ground coffee, pour hot water in slow circles, and let the brew drain directly into your serving vessel. Hand wash and dry the wood handle promptly.

title: Hand-Glazed Stoneware Tea Cup in Juniper Blue
description: A comfortably rounded stoneware cup finished in a deep juniper-blue glaze with subtle tonal variation from piece to piece. The 10-ounce capacity suits loose-leaf tea, an americano, or a small serving of hot chocolate. A gently curved handle leaves room for two fingers, while the sturdy base sits securely on a desk or bedside table. Fired stoneware retains warmth without feeling overly heavy. Suitable for the dishwasher and microwave; avoid sudden temperature changes to protect the ceramic.

title: Carbon Steel Crepe and Pancake Pan, 10 Inch
description: Made from 2 mm carbon steel, this shallow 10-inch pan heats quickly and develops a naturally slick cooking surface with regular seasoning. The low, gently sloped sides make it easy to spread batter thinly and flip crepes, pancakes, or omelets. A riveted steel handle provides a secure grip and works on gas, electric, and induction cooktops. The pan arrives with a light protective coating that should be washed off before first use. Dry thoroughly after cleaning and apply a thin layer of cooking oil.

title: Stainless Steel Herb Scissors with Five Blades
description: Five parallel stainless steel blades cut fresh herbs into fine pieces with a few quick snips, reducing the need for a cutting board and knife. The comfortable molded handles include a soft grip for steady use, and a small cleaning comb is included to clear leaves caught between blades. Scissors measure 7 inches long and work well for parsley, chives, dill, and mint. Rinse promptly after cutting herbs, especially if they are damp, and dry before storing. Not intended for stems thicker than a pencil.

title: Dark Chocolate Dipped Ginger Coins
description: Thin slices of tender crystallized ginger are dipped halfway in bittersweet dark chocolate for a treat that balances warm spice with a clean cocoa finish. The 4-ounce resealable pouch is packed in small batches and is easy to keep near the coffee station or tuck into a lunch bag. Serve alongside black tea, espresso, or a cheese board, or chop a few coins into cookie dough. Contains ginger and soy; made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts. Store sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Pour-Over Morning Starter Gift Box
description: A practical set for getting started with manual coffee brewing, packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with paper cushioning. It includes a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee, a ceramic cone dripper sized for one to two cups, a reusable stainless steel scoop, and a printed brew guide. The ceramic dripper has a warm sand glaze and fits over most standard mugs. Add freshly ground coffee, pour hot water slowly, and brew directly into the cup. Coffee origin may vary with seasonal availability.

title: Cast Iron Tea Light Food Warmer with Glass Teapot Stand
description: Keep a pot of tea warm at the table with a compact cast iron stand designed to hold a small unscented tea light beneath a glass teapot. The open sides allow airflow, while the broad top ring supports teapots with a flat base up to 5 inches across. Measuring 6 inches wide and 3.5 inches high, it is suited to leisurely servings rather than boiling water. Place the warmer on a heat-resistant surface, use only while attended, and allow the metal to cool fully before handling.

title: The Weeknight Rice Bowl: Grains, Toppings, and Quick Sauces
description: This 192-page cookbook offers flexible rice bowl recipes built around pantry-friendly grains, crisp vegetables, and quick sauces. Chapters cover stovetop rice, brown rice, and other grains, followed by combinations such as miso mushroom bowls, sesame chicken with cucumber, and roasted squash with lentils. Each recipe includes a practical prep timeline and suggestions for swapping ingredients based on what is on hand. The paperback measures 7 by 9 inches and lies flat enough for counter use. A useful guide for quick lunches and weeknight dinners.

title: Vanilla Bean and Toasted Coconut Chai Concentrate
description: A small-batch chai concentrate made with black tea, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, cracked pepper, vanilla bean, and toasted coconut. The 16-ounce glass bottle makes about eight servings when mixed with an equal amount of milk or a non-dairy alternative. Warm the mixture gently for a cozy drink, or pour it over ice for a quick chilled chai. Shake before opening to distribute the spices. Refrigerate after opening and use within two weeks; this concentrate is sweetened lightly with cane sugar.

title: Citrus Grove Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey Process Coffee Beans
description: These medium-roast beans come from Tarrazú, Costa Rica, where honey processing leaves a gentle sweetness on the cup. Expect notes of orange marmalade, almond, and panela, with a rounded body that works well as drip coffee or pour-over. The whole beans are packed in a resealable 12-ounce bag with a one-way valve to help preserve freshness. Grind just before brewing and adjust the dose to suit your brewer.

title: Meadow Mint and Lemon Balm Herbal Tea
description: A caffeine-free loose-leaf blend of peppermint, spearmint, lemon balm, and a little lemongrass, made for a clear, cooling cup. The cut leaves and herbs come in a 2.5-ounce recyclable tin with a fitted lid. Use one heaping teaspoon per eight ounces of freshly boiled water and steep for five to seven minutes; it is also pleasant chilled over ice. Keep the tin closed between uses to protect the aroma.

title: Stovetop Copper Moka Pot, 6 Cup
description: This six-cup moka pot brews concentrated coffee on a stovetop using a simple, three-part design. Its polished copper-finish aluminum body includes a removable funnel filter, a silicone gasket, and a heat-resistant handle and knob. Fill the lower chamber with water, add medium-fine grounds to the basket, and heat until coffee flows into the upper chamber. It holds about 10 fluid ounces; hand wash and dry thoroughly after brewing.

title: Speckled Stoneware Cappuccino Cup, Set of Two
description: Made for cappuccino, flat white, or a small serving of hot chocolate, these stoneware cups have a warm ivory glaze with charcoal speckles. Each cup holds 7 fluid ounces and has a rounded handle sized for a comfortable grip. The pair is kiln-fired for everyday use and stacks neatly in a cupboard. Suitable for the microwave and dishwasher; slight variations in glaze and speckling are part of the handmade finish.

title: Blue Carbon Steel Wok with Birch Handle, 12 Inch
description: This 12-inch carbon steel wok heats quickly for stir-frying vegetables, noodles, and thinly sliced meats. The rounded cooking surface is paired with a riveted birchwood handle and a small steel helper handle for lifting. At 2.6 pounds, it is easy to maneuver over a gas burner or outdoor flame. Season the pan before first use, cook with a little oil, and dry it promptly after washing to maintain its protective surface.

title: Olivewood Coffee Measuring Scoop
description: Measure whole beans or ground coffee with this single-bowl scoop carved from olivewood. It holds approximately one tablespoon, making it a handy companion for a canister or countertop grinder. The smooth handle is shaped for a comfortable pinch grip, while the distinctive grain means each scoop has its own natural pattern. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry immediately; occasional food-safe mineral oil helps preserve the wood.

title: Blackcurrant and Thyme Drinking Chocolate
description: Dark cocoa, tart blackcurrant, and a subtle hint of thyme make this drinking chocolate an aromatic alternative to a plain hot cocoa. The 8-ounce pouch contains finely milled chocolate powder that dissolves into warm milk or a plant-based drink. Whisk two tablespoons into a small saucepan of liquid, heat gently, and serve in a mug. The resealable pouch keeps the blend ready for after-dinner cups and chilly afternoons.

title: Slow Steep Coffee and Citrus Marmalade Gift Set
description: A thoughtful pairing for leisurely breakfasts, this gift set brings together a 10-ounce bag of medium-roast whole-bean coffee and a 7-ounce jar of small-batch orange marmalade. The coffee has a smooth, nutty profile that complements the marmalade’s bright citrus peel. Both items are packed in a recyclable kraft gift box with paper cushioning and a simple brew-and-serve card. A grinder is not included, so choose ground coffee if you are gifting to a drip brewer.

title: The Sunday Table: Simple Baking for Coffee and Tea
description: This 192-page hardcover cookbook gathers approachable bakes suited to a slow morning or an afternoon pot of tea. Recipes include brown butter oat scones, cardamom plum cake, sesame shortbread, and savory cheddar biscuits, with clear measurements and notes for make-ahead steps. A short pantry section covers flour, leaveners, and common substitutions. The book measures 7.5 by 9.5 inches, making it comfortable to keep open on a kitchen counter while you bake.

title: Brushed Brass Tea Infuser Basket with Rest
description: This fine-mesh stainless steel basket fits most standard mugs and small teapots, giving loose leaves room to unfurl as they steep. A brushed brass-colored finish adds a warm accent, and the included ceramic rest catches drips between infusions. The basket measures 2.8 inches across and has twin handles to balance on a cup rim. Lift it out when the tea reaches your preferred strength, then rinse promptly after use.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Shortbread Tin
description: These crisp, buttery shortbread rounds are baked with lemon zest and poppy seeds for a bright, lightly nutty bite alongside coffee or tea. The 6-ounce tin contains individually packed biscuits to help keep them fresh after opening. Serve them as a simple afternoon treat or add a few to a dessert plate with fruit and yogurt. Store in a cool, dry cupboard and reseal the inner pouch between servings.

title: Toasted Rice and Yuzu Kukicha Tea
description: This Japanese-style kukicha blends green tea stems with toasted rice and dried yuzu peel for a gentle, savory-citrus infusion. The loose-leaf tea is packed in a 2.5-ounce resealable pouch, enough for roughly 25 cups depending on your scoop. Steep one teaspoon in water just below boiling for two to three minutes; a shorter infusion keeps the rice notes mellow and the yuzu bright. It works well hot or chilled over ice.
